## COB Stacked Capacitor & Tungsten Bitline Contact Integration Routing
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$ / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip) | **Action Type**: Make  
**Document Link**: [`docs/sop_cob_stacked_capacitor_tungsten_bitline.md`](docs/sop_cob_stacked_capacitor_tungsten_bitline.md)

---

### 1. Structural Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Access Transistor    │
│     Active & Gate:     │
│    L=180nm, W=220nm    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Bitline Contact     │
│   Shared Formation:    │
│       W-Plug Via       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Bitline Routing:    │
│   Pitch 360nm-400nm,   │
│     C_b 150-250fF      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   ILD & Storage Node   │
│     W-Plug Contact     │
       Formation        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Crown MIM/Poly     │
│   Stacked Capacitor:   │
│  Ta2O5/ONO, EOT 3-4nm  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Plate Line Node     │
│     Integration &      │
│     C_b/C_s Ratio      │
│      Verification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Access Transistor Channel Sizing & Cell Matrix Layout**:
   - Fabricate 1T1C access NMOS with gate physical length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Grow gate dielectric thermally using dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Layout cell array following folded bitline footprint: $8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ (or $6F^2 = 0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$ for open bitline).

2. **Bitline Contact (BLC) Tungsten Via Formation**:
   - Open contact via shared between two adjacent memory cells landing directly on the common drain junction.
   - Deposit and chemical-mechanical planarize (CMP) a tungsten plug (W-plug) to establish low-resistance ohmic contact.

3. **Bitline (BL) Metallization & Routing (Below Capacitor)**:
   - Pattern bitline routing runs below the storage capacitor tier (Capacitor-Over-Bitline / COB layout).
   - Maintain bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$ (matching wordline pitch at $360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$).
   - Keep total parasitic bitline capacitance ($C_b$) within $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline subarray segment.

4. **Storage Node Contact (SNC) W-Plug Via Integration**:
   - Deposit Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) isolating the bitline stack.
   - Etch vertical vias through ILD landing on the access transistor source nodes, avoiding bitlines.
   - Deposit tungsten contact plug (W-plug) extending up to the base of the storage capacitor.

5. **Crown Stacked Capacitor Fabrication & Plate Integration**:
   - Form crown-shaped polysilicon or Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) bottom electrode storage nodes over the bitlines.
   - Deposit high-$\kappa$ dielectric layer consisting of $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack ($\kappa > 15$) or triple ONO ($\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4/\text{SiO}_2$) with Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Deposit common top plate electrode enclosing the crown arrays.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  Capacitance & Ratio Constraints     
             ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░░░░░░░░░░░░                           │

             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
C_s Retention┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  C_s Nominal┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓   │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓   │
      C_s Min┤█████████████████████████████████      │
             │█████████████████████████████████      │
             └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
             0.0       7.5     15.0      22.5    30.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value / Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28\text{ fF}$ nominal ($\ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$) | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Automated C-V probe on test macro |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1$ to $9:1$ (Strict Max: $< 10:1$) | Dimensionless ratio | In-line parametric read-margin extraction |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Temperature-controlled probe station |
| **Cell Retention Time** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Refresh interval pass/fail test vector |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - Shared bitline contact via W-plug; crown polysilicon / MIM structure over bitline (COB).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, ONO); minimum $28\text{ fF}$ capacitance; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ cell architecture; $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell target; data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - EOT $= 3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide dry oxidation thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) and open bitline $6F^2$ area ($0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
  - Nominal $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$; $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells); $C_b / C_s$ ratio constraint between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shared Bitline Contact Patterning & Tungsten Plug CVD Routing (180nm 1T1C Node)

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Shared BL Contact    │
│    Photolithography    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   High-Aspect-Ratio    │
│      Contact RIE       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ti/TiN Liner CVD/ALD  │
│       Deposition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  WF6/H2 Tungsten Plug  │
│        CVD Fill        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       W Chemical       │
│  Mechanical Polishing  │
│          CMP           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) Deposition & Planarization**:
   - Deposit Pre-Metal Dielectric (PMD/ILD-0) stack covering access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Planarize via oxide CMP to ensure consistent depth to active shared drain/source regions.
2. **Shared Bitline Contact Patterning (Photolithography)**:
   - Apply deep UV (DUV) photoresist with bottom anti-reflective coating (BARC).
   - Expose shared bitline contact hole centered between adjacent access gates at the array design pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
3. **High-Aspect-Ratio Contact (HARC) Reactive Ion Etching (RIE)**:
   - Perform anisotropic oxide dry etch selective to underlying active silicon/salicide and gate spacer nitride.
   - Clean etch polymers with solvent clean and post-etch in-situ plasma strip.
4. **Adhesion & Barrier Liner Deposition**:
   - Deposit thin conformable $\text{Ti}/\text{TiN}$ barrier layer ($< 10\text{ nm}$) using CVD/ALD to prevent $\text{WF}_6$ encroachment ("wormholes") into silicon active junctions and provide ohmic contact.
5. **Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) CVD Fill**:
   - Initiate silane ($\text{SiH}_4$) or germane nucleation seed step.
   - Perform bulk tungsten plug deposition via hydrogen reduction of tungsten hexafluoride ($\text{WF}_6 + 3\text{H}_2 \rightarrow \text{W} + 6\text{HF}$) until full contact fill and seam-free closure are achieved.
6. **W Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP)**:
   - Polish overburden bulk tungsten and $\text{Ti}/\text{TiN}$ liner stopping selectivity on the ILD oxide.
   - Post-CMP cleaning to prevent residual tungsten nanoparticle contamination prior to bitline/stacked capacitor routing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │█████████████████████████████████████│
    Pitch (BL/WL)┤█████████████████████████████████████│
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░               │
     Transistor W┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░               │
     Transistor L┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                   │
Max Leakage (85C)┤▓                                    │
                 │▓                                    │
  Min Storage Cap┤████                                 │
                 │████                                 │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       95       190      285     380 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | `360 to 400` | $\text{nm}$ | Inline Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) |
| **Transistor Geometry ($L \times W$)** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Cross-Sectional TEM / CD-SEM |
| **Minimum Cell Capacitance Budget** | $\ge 25 \text{ to } 30$ (min $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Prober $C$-$V$ Metrology |
| **Max Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parametric Analyzer / Automated Refresh Interval Test |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Validates unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - Confirms shared bitline contact architecture between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Specifies tungsten plug (W-plug) connection routing to crown/MIM capacitor stack.
  - Establishes minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance budget and junction/sub-threshold leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Validates $8\text{F}^2$ and $6\text{F}^2$ 1T1C layout footprint.
  - Confirms bitline and wordline array pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms baseline storage capacitor requirement of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shared Bitline Contact Photolithography and Anisotropic Oxide Plasma Etch
**Module:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip Architecture & Integration  
**Hierarchy:** Gen 2 (µm) | Circuit Design / Photolithography & Etch  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    HMDS Vapor Prime    │
│       at 120°C         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Photoresist Coat &   │
│        Softbake        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  DUV Reticle Exposure  │
│ (Shared Bitline Node)  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Post-Exposure Bake &  │
│   Aqueous Developer    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Anisotropic Oxide Etch │
│ (BOE / Fluorine Plasma)│
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Ash / Strip Resist &  │
│ CD-SEM / In-line Metro │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Vapor Prime**:
   - Transfer wafer into the adhesion promoter chamber.
   - Perform Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) vapor prime at **120°C** to dehydrate the oxide surface and promote photoresist adhesion prior to coating.
   - *Safety Precaution:* Ensure calcium gluconate gel is accessible in the wet chemical safety station adjacent to etching and cleaning stations.

2. **Photoresist Coating & Softbake**:
   - Dispense high-resolution positive photoresist across the wafer on the automated track coater.
   - Spin-coat at programmed RPM to achieve uniform thickness covering the inter-layer dielectric (ILD).
   - Execute standard hotplate softbake to drive off casting solvents.

3. **Photolithographic Exposure (Shared Bitline Contact Hole)**:
   - Load wafer into the lithography exposure tool (stepper/scanner).
   - Align reticle to active area alignment marks for the 180nm cell matrix targeting the shared bitline node between two adjacent access transistors (nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Expose contact hole array defining the bitline landing pads.

4. **Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) & Development**:
   - Perform PEB on hotplate track to activate photo-acid generators and eliminate standing waves.
   - Puddle-develop with standard aqueous developer, rinse with deionized (DI) water, and spin dry.
   - Inspect critical dimension (CD) of the contact openings via optical/CD-SEM inspection.

5. **Anisotropic Oxide Etch & Wet Contact Clear**:
   - Transfer wafer to the dry plasma etch chamber (anisotropic fluorocarbon RIE) to etch vertical contact vias down toward the active shared node with high anisotropy.
   - For chemical oxide cleanup/etching or wet etch calibration, utilize **BOE (6:1)** (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$) with **0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad** wetting agent added to prevent micro-bubble entrapment in micro-trenches/contact holes. Maintain bath at **25°C**.

6. **Photoresist Strip & Post-Clean**:
   - Strip patterned resist via downstream $\text{O}_2$ plasma ashing followed by wet solvent clean.
   - DI water rinse until resistivity $> 18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ and spin-rinse dry under heated $\text{N}_2$.
   - Route wafer to Tungsten (W) plug chemical vapor deposition (CVD) pre-clean.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Target Metric | Specification Target | Verification Method / Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Vapor Prime Adhesion Temperature** | **$120^\circ\text{C}$** | Integrated thermal sensor / Hotplate RTD |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate (BOE at 25°C)** | **$100\text{ nm/min}$** ($\pm 10\%$) | In-line Spectroscopic Ellipsometer |
| **BOE Solution Bath Temperature** | **$25^\circ\text{C}$** | Automated wet bench bath RTD |
| **Wetting Agent Concentration in BOE** | **$0.1\%$** Triton X-100 or Fluorad | Chemical delivery mass-flow dosing / titration |
| **Cell Transistor Dimensions (Design Ref)** | **$L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$** | CD-SEM metrology |

---

### 3. Context Source Citations

- **HMDS Adhesion & Temperature**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — specifies HMDS vapor prime at **120°C** prior to resist coating to ensure resist adhesion.
- **BOE Chemistry & Thermal Oxide Etch Rate**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — defines **BOE 6:1** (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$), etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at **25°C** as approximately **$100\text{ nm/min}$** ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
- **Surfactant / Wetting Agent Specification**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — dictates addition of **0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad** wetting agent to prevent bubble entrapment in micro-trenches.
- **Safety Protocol**: Source: *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — dictates calcium gluconate gel presence for hydrofluoric acid safety.
- **Shared Bitline Node Geometry**: Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — establishes 180nm unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and shared bitline contact arrangement between two adjacent memory cells.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Ti/TiN Adhesion Barrier Sputter and Tungsten Plug CVD Contact Fill

**Context Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > COB Stacked Capacitor & Tungsten Bitline Contact Integration Routing > Shared Bitline Contact Patterning & Tungsten Plug Chemical Vapor Deposition Routing  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This procedure details the deposition of the physical vapor deposition (PVD) Titanium (Ti) adhesion layer, reactive PVD Titanium Nitride (TiN) barrier layer, and chemical vapor deposition (CVD) Tungsten (W) fill to form the shared bitline and cell contacts contacting the access transistor (channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) beneath the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) topology.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Metal Clean & Degas
1. Transfer the patterned wafer cassette into the load-lock chamber.
2. Pump down the load-lock to high vacuum with a base pressure $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ using a cryopump or turbomolecular pump to eliminate moisture and atmospheric oxygen.
3. Transfer wafer to the pre-clean/degas chamber; perform soft argon plasma sputter etch to remove native oxide at the silicon contact bottoms without damaging active junctions.

#### Step 2: PVD Ti Adhesion Layer Sputter
1. Transfer wafer to the DC magnetron sputter chamber under high vacuum.
2. Establish chamber base pressure $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ before gas introduction.
3. Flow high-purity Argon gas ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$) to set working process pressure between $3\text{ mTorr}$ and $5\text{ mTorr}$.
4. Strike DC magnetron plasma on a high-purity Titanium target (5N / 99.999%) using DC power between $1.5\text{ kW}$ and $3.0\text{ kW}$.
5. Deposit thin Ti seed layer to ensure low contact resistance to the transistor drain/source silicon regions.

#### Step 3: Reactive PVD TiN Diffusion Barrier Sputter
1. Without breaking vacuum, transition or index wafer to the reactive TiN PVD station.
2. Maintain process working pressure at $3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$ with high-purity $\text{Ar}$ ($99.999\%$) and inject controlled high-purity $\text{N}_2$ gas.
3. Apply DC magnetron target power between $1.5\text{ kW}$ and $3.0\text{ kW}$ to deposit conformal, stoichiometric TiN acting as an adhesion/barrier against $\text{WF}_6$ precursor attack and fluorine penetration.

#### Step 4: CVD Tungsten (W-Plug) Fill
1. Transfer wafer to the cold-wall CVD Tungsten deposition chamber.
2. Initiate silane ($\text{SiH}_4$) reduction nucleation step ($\text{WF}_6 + \text{SiH}_4$) to establish a continuous W seed layer over the Ti/TiN barrier.
3. Transition to standard hydrogen reduction bulk CVD growth ($\text{WF}_6 + \text{H}_2$) to achieve complete, void-free contact fill across the contact pitch ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$) and contact geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
4. Pump down, vent load-lock to $\text{N}_2$, and transfer wafer cassette to Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) for tungsten recess and planarization.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ | Maximum limit | In-situ Ion Gauge / Cryopump controller |
| **Sputter Working Gas Pressure (Ar)** | $4.0\text{ mTorr}$ | $3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer |
| **DC Magnetron Power** | $2.25\text{ kW}$ | $1.5\text{ to } 3.0\text{ kW}$ | DC Magnetron Generator readout |
| **Contact Dimension Matching Target** | $180\text{ nm}$ | Matching nominal gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects:**
  - Base pressure requirement: $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ via turbomolecular or cryopump.
  - Sputtering process gas: High-purity Argon ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$) at $3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$ working pressure.
  - Sputter target power: DC magnetron power supply operating at $1.5\text{ to } 3.0\text{ kW}$.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Contact connection architecture: Drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) to stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Transistor gate critical dimensions: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with shared bitline contact.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Interconnect and contact dimensional constraints: Bitline and wordline pitch approximately $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects (Vossen & Kern - Thin Film Processes)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Tungsten CMP Planarization and Contact Resistance Kelvin Metrology
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm-domain)  
**Classification:** Make / In-line Metrology & Planarization  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > COB Stacked Capacitor & Tungsten Bitline Contact Integration Routing > Shared Bitline Contact Patterning & Tungsten Plug Chemical Vapor Deposition Routing > Tungsten CMP Planarization and Contact Resistance Kelvin Metrology

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```
[ W-CVD Overburden Post-Deposition ]
                  │
                  ▼
[ Multi-Platen Tungsten CMP Planarization ]
   ├── Platen 1: Bulk W Removal (Alumina/Silica Slurry)
   ├── Platen 2: Ti/TiN Liner Polish & Optical Endpoint Detection
   └── Platen 3: Oxide Buff Clean & Erosion Suppression
                  │
                  ▼
[ Post-CMP Brush Scrub Clean & Megasonic Rinse ]
                  │
                  ▼
[ In-Line Kelvin Contact Resistance & Sheet Resistance Metrology ]
   └── Collinear 4-Point Probe (Outer I, Inner V) & In-Die Kelvin Structures
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-CMP Inspection & Wafer Loading**:
   - Inspect wafer lot following chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of the shared bitline contact tungsten plug (W-plug) and Ti/TiN barrier liner over the 180 nm 1T1C array (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Load wafers onto the automated carrier heads of the multi-platen rotary CMP polishing system.

2. **Bulk Tungsten Removal (Platen 1)**:
   - Apply acidic alumina- or silica-based slurry with an oxidizing agent ($H_2O_2$) at controlled platen/carrier rotational speeds.
   - Remove the bulk tungsten overburden across the shared bitline contact field down to the underlying adhesion barrier.

3. **Liner Clear & Optical End-Point Detection (Platen 2)**:
   - Polish through the Ti/TiN adhesion liner using high-selectivity slurry towards the interlayer dielectric (ILD oxide).
   - Use in-situ motor current sensing and optical eddy-current/reflectance end-point detection (EPD) to detect the tungsten-to-oxide transition and prevent dishing in the shared bitline contact and erosion across array boundaries.

4. **Buff Polish & Post-CMP Clean (Platen 3 & Cleaner Module)**:
   - Perform a soft-pad deionized water (DIW) or dilute chemical buff to eliminate residual slurry particles and metallic contamination.
   - Transfer wafer directly to the integrated double-sided PVA brush scrubber with megasonic agitation and spin-rinse drying.

5. **Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) & Kelvin Contact Resistance Metrology**:
   - Transfer dry wafer to the automated collinear 4-point probe / micro-Kelvin metrology station.
   - Align collinear tungsten carbide tips ($s = 1.0\text{ mm}$ spacing, tip radius $50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$) over test monitor fields.
   - Inject constant DC current $I = 1\text{ mA to } 10\text{ mA}$ through the outer probes (pins 1 and 4) and measure the floating potential drop $V$ across the inner probes (pins 2 and 3).
   - Calculate sheet resistance via $R_s = 4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I}\ [\Omega/\square]$ incorporating geometric correction factors $F(d/s)$ for finite wafer edge boundary proximity.
   - Perform 4-terminal Kelvin resistance measurements on scribe-line test structures embedded in bitline contact test chains to verify plug interface resistance prior to stacked capacitor formation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Collinear Probe Spacing ($s$)** | $1.0 \pm 0.01$ | $\text{mm}$ | In-line Stage Optical Alignment / Tool Spec |
| **Probe Tip Radius** | $50\text{ to }100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Metrology Probe Tip Profilometry |
| **Forced DC Metrology Current ($I$)** | $1.0\text{ to }10.0$ | $\text{mA}$ | Precision DC Source Measurement Unit (SMU) |
| **Bitline Cell Transistor Footprint** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / Review SEM |
| **Post-Integration Cell Retention Leakage** | $< 1.0$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated Wafer-Level Parametric Test (p-cell) |

---

### 4. Context References

- **Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**: Collinear tungsten carbide tip spacing ($s = 1.0\text{ mm}$), tip radius ($50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$), forced current range ($I = 1\text{ mA to } 10\text{ mA}$), outer-probe excitation (1 & 4), inner-probe voltage sensing (2 & 3), and sheet resistance relationship ($R_s = 4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I}\ [\Omega/\square]$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 180 nm access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact architecture, tungsten plug (W-plug) routing, and cell leakage target ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C stacked capacitor integration rules, bitline/wordline matrix constraints, and retention qualification baseline ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance (ASTM Standard F84 & Semiconductor Material Characterization)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Crown-Shaped Stacked Capacitor Dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$) ALD Deposition Recipe Integration

- **Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m node)
- **Architecture Level:** Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) Crown Structure
- **Action Type:** Make / Thin Film Deposition

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Prep & Surface  │
│         Clean          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Al2O3 ALD Interface   │
│      Passivation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Ta2O5 ALD Bulk     │
│   High-k Deposition    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Al2O3 ALD Capping    │
│         Layer          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Post-Deposition     │
│     Annealing PDA      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Metrology & Leakage   │
│       Validation       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-ALD Surface Preparation & In-Situ Degas:**
   - Transfer wafer with etched crown storage node polysilicon/MIM electrodes into the ALD load-lock chamber.
   - Pump down chamber to base pressure $< 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$; transfer to reactor maintained at $300^\circ\text{C}$ to $350^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Perform mild remote in-situ $\text{O}_2 / \text{N}_2$ plasma pretreatment for 30 s to eliminate organic residues and stabilize surface dangling bonds.

2. **Interface Passivation Layer Deposition ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Sub-layer):**
   - **Precursors:** Trimethylaluminum ($\text{TMA}$, $\text{Al(CH}_3)_3$) and deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ / $\text{O}_3$.
   - **ALD Cycle:**
     - Pulse TMA: $0.2\text{ s}$
     - Purge $\text{N}_2$ ($> 99.999\%$ purity): $2.0\text{ s}$ at $100\text{ sccm}$
     - Pulse $\text{O}_3$ / $\text{H}_2\text{O}$: $0.3\text{ s}$
     - Purge $\text{N}_2$: $2.5\text{ s}$
   - **Target Thickness:** $0.5\text{ nm} - 1.0\text{ nm}$ (~5 to 10 cycles) to passivate the bottom electrode interface and suppress lower-band offset injection.

3. **Bulk High-$\kappa$ Dielectric Deposition ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$):**
   - **Precursors:** Tantalum pentaethoxide ($\text{TAETO}$, $\text{Ta(OC}_2\text{H}_5)_5$) heated in bubbler at $120^\circ\text{C}$ and $\text{H}_2\text{O} / \text{O}_3$ oxidizer.
   - **ALD Cycle:**
     - Pulse $\text{Ta(OC}_2\text{H}_5)_5$ vapor (carried by $\text{Ar}$ or $\text{N}_2$ at $50\text{ sccm}$): $1.0\text{ s}$
     - Purge $\text{N}_2$: $3.0\text{ s}$
     - Pulse $\text{O}_3$: $1.2\text{ s}$
     - Purge $\text{N}_2$: $3.0\text{ s}$
   - **Target Physical Thickness:** Adjusted to deliver Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ across the 3D crown sidewalls with step coverage $> 95\%$.

4. **Top Capping Dielectric Deposition ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Top Layer):**
   - Execute 5 to 10 cycles of $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ ALD ($0.5\text{ nm} - 1.0\text{ nm}$) to seal bulk oxygen vacancies and balance mechanical stress before top electrode deposition.

5. **Post-Deposition Annealing (PDA):**
   - Transfer wafer to rapid thermal annealing (RTA) chamber.
   - Anneal at $400^\circ\text{C} - 450^\circ\text{C}$ in ambient $\text{O}_2 / \text{N}_2\text{ (1:4)}$ for $60\text{ s}$ to eliminate fixed charge traps and crystallize/densify the stack without exceeding back-end thermal budgets.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / High-frequency $C$-$V$ |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$)** | $> 15$ | Dimensionless | Calculated from $C$-$V$ accumulation & physical thickness |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (acceptable baseline: $25 - 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated in-line parametric tester ($C$-$V$ at $100\text{ kHz}$) |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | In-line picoammeter probe array at operating cell bias |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - High-$\kappa$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Storage capacitance budget requirement: minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ (protects against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling).
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder type) targets storage capacitance of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee refresh data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Target equivalent oxide thickness ($\text{EOT}$) for $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-$\kappa$ dielectrics: $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-180-CRW-004`  
**Title:** Crown Storage Node Pre-Clean & Native Oxide Wet Strip (DHF/SC-1)  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (1T1C COB Architecture, 8F²/6F² Cell Matrix)  
**Module:** Wet Chemical Processing & Surface Preparation  
**Target Structure:** Poly-Si / Metallic Crown Storage Electrode prior to High-k ALD ($Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      1. Stage &       │
│      Inspection       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  2. DHF Native Oxide  │
│         Strip         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   3. Megasonic QDR    │
│         Rinse         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   4. SC-1 Particle    │
│         Clean         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  5. Marangoni Dry &   │
│     Q-Time Queue      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Staging:**
   - Verify safety readiness: Calcium gluconate antidote gel must be present and verified at the bench before any HF handling.
   - Stage wafer lot containing the formed crown capacitor structures (erected above drain contacts via tungsten plugs / W-plugs).

2. **Native Oxide Wet Strip (DHF / BOE):**
   - Immerse cassette into the oxide strip immersion bath using standard Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1: 6 parts 40% $NH_4F$ to 1 part 49% $HF$) or Dilute HF (DHF 100:1) with $0.1\%$ wetting surfactant (Fluorad or Triton X-100) to ensure zero micro-bubble entrapment within high-aspect-ratio 180nm crown cavities.
   - Maintain bath temperature at precisely $25^\circ\text{C}$. Etch thermally grown / native $SiO_2$ at the calibrated rate of $100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) to fully clear the native interface oxide.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR):**
   - Transfer wafers immediately into the ambient Quick Dump Rinse tank with continuous Megasonic agitation ($1.0\text{ MHz}$) using Ultra-Pure DI Water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) for 4 cycles.

4. **Organic & Particle Removal (SC-1 Clean):**
   - Transfer cassette into the Standard Clean 1 (SC-1) bath formulated at $NH_4OH : H_2O_2 : H_2O = 1 : 1 : 5$.
   - Maintain solution temperature at $65^\circ\text{C} - 70^\circ\text{C}$ for an immersion period of $10\text{ minutes}$ under gentle megasonic power to eliminate trace organics and dislodge particulate matter from the inner crown walls.

5. **Final Rinse & Marangoni Surface Drying:**
   - Transfer to cascade DI water overflow tank until bath resistivity recovers to $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - Pull wafers into the Marangoni / IPA vapor dry chamber to avoid capillary pattern collapse of the deep crown storage node cylinders.

6. **ALD Queue-Time Control:**
   - Vacuum pack or purge transfer cassette under continuous $N_2$ mini-environment.
   - Transfer immediately to the ALD thin-film cluster for $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ dielectric deposition within a maximum queue time ($Q\text{-time}$) of $< 2\text{ hours}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oxide Etch Rate ($SiO_2$)** | $100$ ($1000$) | $\pm 5\%$ | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (monitor wafer) |
| **BOE / DHF Bath Temperature** | $25$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ RTD Immersion Sensor |
| **Post-Strip Native Oxide Thickness** | $< 0.2$ | Max | $\text{nm}$ | Angle-Resolved In-line XPS / Ellipsometry |
| **W-Plug Drain Contact & Junction Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | Max (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated In-line Parametric Test (PCM) |
| **Pre-ALD Queue Time ($Q$-Time)** | $< 120$ | Max | $\text{minutes}$ | MES Automated Timer Tracking |

---

### Literature & Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Stacked capacitor crown topology over drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - High-k dielectric stack ($Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$) target providing effective $\kappa > 15$, capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and junction/sub-threshold leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C architecture, 8F²/6F² cell layout with target storage capacitance of $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Crown-shaped high-k dielectric stack with EOT of $3 - 4\text{ nm}$.
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
  - Formulation ratio: 6 parts $40\% NH_4F$ : 1 part $49\% HF$.
  - Calibrated etch rate: $100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) for thermal $SiO_2$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Addition of $0.1\%$ wetting surfactant (Triton X-100 / Fluorad) to prevent micro-bubble entrapment in micro-trenches/cavities.
  - HF chemical safety protocol: Mandatory availability of calcium gluconate gel.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Nanolaminate Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) Recipe Execution
**Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip $\rightarrow$ 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout $\rightarrow$ COB Stacked Capacitor & Tungsten Bitline Contact Integration Routing $\rightarrow$ Crown-Shaped Stacked Capacitor Dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$) ALD Deposition Recipe Integration $\rightarrow$ **$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Nanolaminate ALD Recipe Execution**  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Pre-Clean &      │
│    Substrate Load     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Al2O3 Interfacial   │
│      Buffer ALD       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Ta2O5 High-k Core   │
│          ALD          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Al2O3 Capping Layer  │
│          ALD          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    In-situ Purge &    │
│    Post-Dep Anneal    │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Conditioning & Chamber Loading**:
   - Transfer wafer batch with crown-shaped storage nodes (formed above tungsten plugs/W-plugs) into the ALD load-lock chamber.
   - Pump down the process chamber to base vacuum and stabilize thermal zones for thermal ALD regime.
   - Establish high-purity carrier/purge gas flow ($\text{N}_2$ or $\text{Ar}$, $99.999\%$ purity) to maintain continuous laminar exhaust sweep.

2. **Interfacial $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Buffer Layer Deposition**:
   - Pulse aluminum precursor (e.g., trimethylaluminum / TMA) into the reaction zone to form a self-saturating monolayer on the bottom electrode surface.
   - Execute inert gas purge pulse to thoroughly evacuate unreacted precursor vapor and volatile byproducts.
   - Pulse coreactant oxidant ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$ vapor / $\text{O}_3$) to complete the ligand-exchange surface reaction.
   - Execute second purge pulse. Repeat the sequence for calibrated cycles to yield the required sub-nanometer $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ interfacial barrier.

3. **$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ High-$\kappa$ Core Nanolaminate Cycling**:
   - Alternate the precursor delivery to the tantalum source (e.g., $\text{Ta(OEt)}_5$ or alkylamido-tantalum precursor) using carrier gas injection.
   - Perform purge step, followed by oxidant dose ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$ / $\text{O}_3$) and subsequent purge.
   - Interleave tailored sub-cycles of $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ and bulk $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ to suppress crystallization grain boundaries and suppress leakage path formation throughout the film stack.

4. **Protective Top $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Cap & Post-Deposition Anneal (PDA)**:
   - Terminate the nanolaminate stack with final $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ barrier cycles to protect the $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ core from top-electrode metal diffusion.
   - Perform final pump-purge pump-down to remove all residual precursor condensation.
   - Unload under inert atmosphere to annealing module for crystallization/passivation treatment.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry & CV dot profiling |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$)** | $> 15$ | dimensionless | Extracted from high-frequency C-V |
| **Per-Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 25\text{ to }30$ (Minimum budget: $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated parametric tester (LCR meter) |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parametric I-V characterization at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Literature Citations & Traceability
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Validates crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture erected above tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Confirms $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ dielectric stack requirement with $\kappa > 15$.
  - Specifies capacitance budget minimum of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ and leakage current limit of $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - Confirms stacked capacitor (crown/cylinder type) target capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Confirms equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) requirement of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ for $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$-based dielectrics.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-HIK01`  
**Title:** High-k Dielectric EOT, Step Coverage & Leakage Metrology (XRR / TEM / C-V)  
**Node Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Process Step Category:** Metrology / Quality Inspection  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

## 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Infeed: Crown  │
│         Stack         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      XRR: Planar      │
│  Thickness & Density  │
│         Fitting       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    FIB-TEM: Crown     │
│   Sidewall / Bottom   │
│     Step Coverage     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  C-V & I-V Probing:   │
│  EOT, Capacitance &   │
│     Leakage @ 85°C    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance Gating &  │
│       Pass/Fail       │
│      Disposition      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Metrology Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Measurement Inspection & Lot Loading
1. Transfer post-ALD $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ crown-capacitor lot to the metrology cleanroom bay under class 1 environment.
2. Verify wafer alignment notch/flat orientation and ensure surface particles do not contaminate probe pads or test monitor sites.

### Step 2: X-Ray Reflectometry (XRR) Thickness & Density Verification
1. Load test monitor wafer onto the high-resolution XRR stage.
2. Perform specular $\theta - 2\theta$ scans across grazing incident angles ($0.2^\circ \le \theta \le 4.0^\circ$) on planar scribe-line monitor pads.
3. Fit interference fringe periodicity and critical angle ($\theta_c$) to extract physical layer thickness ($t_{\text{phys}}$) and material density of the high-k stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).

### Step 3: Dual-Beam FIB Sample Prep & Cross-Sectional TEM Metrology
1. Target array test cell containing high-aspect-ratio crown-shaped stacked capacitors.
2. Deposit protective electron-beam followed by ion-beam Pt strap.
3. Perform focused ion beam (FIB) micro-milling to prepare an ultra-thin cross-sectional lamella (<50 nm thickness).
4. Transfer lamella to high-resolution Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) operating at 200 kV.
5. Acquire bright-field and high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF-STEM) images across the crown top, sidewall (mid-depth), and bottom cup regions.
6. Calculate conformational step coverage:
   $$\text{Step Coverage (\%)} = \frac{t_{\text{bottom}}}{t_{\text{top}}} \times 100\%$$

### Step 4: C-V & I-V Electrical Parameter Extraction
1. Mount wafer onto thermal probe station chuck heated to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to replicate worst-case DRAM refresh conditions.
2. Connect Kelvin probes to memory array test capacitor test structures with top/bottom electrodes.
3. Execute high-frequency C-V sweep (100 kHz – 1 MHz, $-1.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.5\text{ V}$):
   - Measure accumulated cell capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$).
   - Extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):
     $$\text{EOT} = t_{\text{high-k}} \cdot \frac{\kappa_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\kappa_{\text{high-k}}}$$
4. Perform DC I-V leakage characterization at operating bias conditions at $85^\circ\text{C}$:
   - Measure sub-threshold, junction, and capacitor dielectric leakage current per cell ($I_{\text{leak}}$).

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Tolerance / Range | Measurement Tool | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ | C-V Prober / Quasistatic Extraction | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ | Minimum $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ | HF C-V Impedance Analyzer ($85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | Max $1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (I-V @ $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Dielectric Effective Permittivity ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$)** | $> 15$ | $\kappa > 15$ | Derived from C-V + TEM Physical Thickness | Dimensionless |

---

## 4. Literature & Context Sources

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Context:* Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling; $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$; leakage current target kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh retention intervals.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Context:* Storage capacitor must maintain $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; crown-type stacked capacitor high-k dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$) requires Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.

# SOP: COB Storage Node Capacitance & Sub-fA Cell Leakage Metrology Validation

**Module**: Metrology & Characterization  
**Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > COB Stacked Capacitor & Tungsten Bitline Contact Integration Routing > Metrology  
**Technology Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Process Action**: Make (Electrical Metrology & Parametric Characterization)

---

### Metrology Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Chuck Thermal   │
│  Stabilization at 85   │
│         deg C          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  W-Plug Storage Node   │
│  Contact Resistance &  │
│     Kelvin Nulling     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Array Storage      │
│      Capacitance       │
│   Extraction at 100    │
│      kHz - 1 MHz       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Sub-fA Access      │
│  Transistor Off-State  │
│   & Junction Leakage   │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Cb / Cs Ratio & Read  │
│   Margin Compliance    │
│      Verification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Capacitance Budget & Operating Boundaries

```text
                 ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░                                │
Cb/Cs Ratio Upper┤░░░                                │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  BL Parasitic Cb┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    Min Cs Budget┤▓▓▓▓▓                              │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓                              │
       Nominal Cs┤██████                             │
                 │██████                             │
                 └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                  0       50      100      150    200 
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Wafer Test Setup & Thermal Chamber Stabilization
1. Mount the 180nm processed test wafer onto the triaxial parametric probe station chuck.
2. Configure the thermal chuck to **85°C ± 0.5°C** to measure worst-case thermal leakage and guarantee data retention testing under operational specification.
3. Purge the probe enclosure with dry $N_2$ (dew point $< -40^\circ\text{C}$) to prevent condensation or leakage across probe needles.
4. Execute open/short/load calibration and triaxial guard nulling on the parametric analyzer (down to femtoampere noise floor).

### Step 2: Storage Node Contact Kelvin Nulling & Continuity Check
1. Land low-leakage Kelvin probes onto the test vehicle's Storage Node contact pad arrays connected to the tungsten plug (W-plug).
2. Apply a low bias ($\pm 50\text{ mV}$) across the W-plug drain contact to verify ohmic continuity and de-embed parasitic contact routing resistance prior to AC C-V sweeps.

### Step 3: Array C-V Storage Node Capacitance Extraction ($C_s$)
1. Connect the LCR meter / precision impedance analyzer to a $1024$-cell or $2048$-cell parallel test array structure (crown/cylinder stacked capacitor over bitline with high-$k$ dielectric such as $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO stack, $\kappa > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$).
2. Apply an AC oscillation voltage $V_{\text{osc}} = 25\text{ mV}$ RMS at frequencies from **$100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$**.
3. Sweep the DC plate bias across the cell plate voltage range ($0\text{ V}$ to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$).
4. Calculate single-cell capacitance $C_s$:
   $$C_s = \frac{C_{\text{measured, array}} - C_{\text{open\_deembed}}}{N_{\text{cells}}}$$
   Ensure $C_s$ satisfies the nominal target of **$28\text{ fF}$** (minimum $\ge 25\text{ fF}$).

### Step 4: Sub-fA Access Transistor & Junction Leakage Extraction
1. Bias the access NMOS transistor ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) into the off-state:
   - Wordline (Gate) bias: $V_{WL} = 0.0\text{ V}$ (or negative wordline hold bias).
   - Bitline contact: $V_{BL} = 0.0\text{ V}$.
   - Storage Node: Precharge to $V_{SN} = V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
2. Measure leakage current integrating over an extended integration aperture (long integration mode with triaxial guards active) at **$85^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. De-convolve the combined drain junction reverse leakage and sub-threshold leakage per unit cell. Confirm the measured leakage does not exceed **$1.0\text{ fA/cell}$**.

### Step 5: Bitline Capacitance ($C_b$) and Ratio Validation
1. Measure bitline capacitance on array blocks containing **256 or 512 cells per bitline**.
2. Extract total bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ (target range **$150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$**).
3. Compute the bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$:
   - Verify that the ratio stays strictly between **$5:1$ and $9:1$** (never exceeding **$10:1$**), ensuring adequate sensing signal margin before bitline sense-amplifier latching.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Acceptable Limits | Engineering Units | Validation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | AC Multi-frequency C-V extraction ($100\text{ kHz} - 1\text{ MHz}$) |
| **Total Cell Off-State Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 0.8$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Triaxial SMU integration at $V_{SN} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $200.0$ | $150.0 \le C_b \le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Block parasitic C-V sweep (256/512 cells/BL) |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $7.0 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9.0 : 1$ (Max $10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless | Ratio calculation for read signal margin |

---

## 3. Literature Context Citations

1. **Capacitance & Dielectric Metrics**:
   - Nominal storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (nominally $28\text{ fF}$) with ONO/$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-$k$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$).  
     *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench; Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering.*
2. **Access Transistor Dimensions & Off-State Leakage**:
   - Access NMOS $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $T_{ox} \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, with sub-threshold/junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ guaranteeing retention $> 64\text{ ms}$.  
     *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench; Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering.*
3. **Array Parasitics & Margin Constraint**:
   - Array bitline block with 256 or 512 cells exhibiting $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$, requiring $C_b / C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (degrading severely if exceeding $10:1$).  
     *Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets.*
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets (Keeth, Baker, Johnson, Lin - DRAM Circuit Design: Fundamental and High-Speed Topics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Test Structure Kelvin Array & Guard-Ring Pad Design for Sub-fA Probing

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Kelvin Force/Sense   │
│    Core Pad Layout     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Active Driven      │
│  Guard-Ring Enclosure  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Array Multiplexing &  │
│   Dummy Terminations   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Sub-fA Triaxial     │
│      Electrometer      │
│      Interconnect      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Cryo/Thermal      │
│  Metrology Chamber at  │
│        85 deg C        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **4-Terminal Kelvin Pad Geometry Definition**:
   - Layout dual force/sense pad pairs for bitline and storage node metrology to isolate parasitic series resistance from prober tips, probe needles, and routing metals.
   - Separate force and sense lines directly down to the lowest metallization layer (Metal 1) adjacent to the access transistor channel ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

2. **Driven Guard-Ring Topology & Dielectric Shielding**:
   - Enclose all sensitive DUT nodes (cell node test pad and sub-threshold leakage sense lines) with an active driven guard ring.
   - Route guard rings on all metal levels surrounding the signal line, connected to an active unity-gain buffer matching the inner signal potential to eliminate lateral oxide leakage ($I = \Delta V / R_{\text{ox}} \to 0$).

3. **Kelvin Array Array Matrix Routing**:
   - Route bitline and wordline test buses conforming to the technology pitch: wordline/bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Place array boundary dummy cells around the Kelvin test cell matrix to match optical proximity effects (OPC) and stacked capacitor etch planarization.

4. **Triaxial Pad Interface & High-k Dielectric Leakage Probing**:
   - Interface pad structures with low-noise triaxial probe configurations (Center: Force/Sense Signal, Inner Shield: Active Guard, Outer Shield: Ground/Chassis).
   - Configure parameter analyzer/electrometer integration time to validate stacked capacitor dielectric leakage and access transistor off-state current at wafer-chuck temperature set to $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
       Key Physical Cell Targets (180nm COB Node)
                             ┌─────────────────────────┐
                             │░░░░░░░░                 │
 Storage Cap Budget (fF/cell)┤░░░░░░░░                 │
Target Leakage @85C (fA/cell)┤▒                        │
                             │▒                        │
    Sense Amp BL Delta V (mV)┤█████████████████████████│
                             │█████████████████████████│
                             └┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                              0    25    50    75   100 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Machine-Measurable Target | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold and junction leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ wafer chuck |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (min $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | High-frequency CV meter at $100\text{ kHz} - 1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Interconnect Routing Pitch (BL & WL)** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Inline CD-SEM / In-die AFM metrology |
| **Cell Transistor Geometry ($L \times W$)** | $L = 180, \; W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Inline CD-SEM inspection after poly gate etch |
| **Data Retention Window** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Validated retention time at $85^\circ\text{C}$ operating temperature |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Context Alignment

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Confirms unit cell channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Establishes storage capacitor target range ($25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell), data retention requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate oxide thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, and bitline/wordline pitch range of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Establishes differential bitline signal development target $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ based on $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, setting the noise margin baseline for guard-ring shielding integrity.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## COB Parallel Array High-Frequency C-V Storage Capacitance Extraction

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow
This SOP defines the metrology procedure for extracting the single-cell storage capacitance ($C_s$) of 180nm Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stacked capacitor structures using parallel test arrays (e.g., $N = 10{,}000$ or $100{,}000$ cells connected in parallel) via High-Frequency Capacitance-Voltage (HF C-V) metrology.

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Parallel COB Array  │
│      Selection       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Open-Short Cable   │
│     De-embedding     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   HF C-V Profiling   │
│    100kHz to 1MHz    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Voltage Bias Sweep  │
│     across Vcell     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Pad Parasitic     │
│     Subtraction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Single-Cell      │
│    Capacitance Cs    │
│    Normalization     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Test Array & Probe Station Alignment**:
   - Load the wafer onto the shielded, dark probe station chuck thermally stabilized at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (ambient screening) or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ (temperature-dependent validation).
   - Align low-leakage Kelvin probes onto the dedicated COB parallel macro array pad set (connected to the common top plate node and parallel bottom storage nodes via tied wordline access/tungsten plug test structures) and adjacent open/dummy reference pads.

2. **Instrumentation Calibration & Fixture De-embedding**:
   - Initialize an LCR meter / precision impedance analyzer in $C_p - G_p$ (parallel capacitance and conductance) mode.
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit calibration at the probe tip tips to de-embed coaxial cable parasitic capacitance ($C_{\text{cable}}$) and series lead resistance ($R_s$).
   - Measure the adjacent unpopulated dummy open-pad structure across the frequency spectrum to establish the baseline fixture stray capacitance $C_{\text{pad}}$.

3. **High-Frequency C-V Profiling & DC Bias Sweep**:
   - Set AC oscillation excitation amplitude to $30\,\text{mV}_\text{RMS}$ at measurement frequencies of $100\,\text{kHz}$ and $1\,\text{MHz}$ to prevent series resistance dispersion and carrier generation roll-off.
   - Apply a DC bias voltage sweep from $-1.5\,\text{V}$ to $+1.5\,\text{V}$ (centered around operating cell levels, spanning $0\,\text{V}$ to $V_{DD}$ with step size $\le 25\,\text{mV}$).
   - Record total parallel capacitance $C_{\text{total}}(V)$ and parallel conductance $G_p(V)$. Ensure dissipation factor $D = G_p / (\omega C_p) < 0.05$ to guarantee low dielectric loss.

4. **Parasitic Subtraction & Single-Cell Normalization**:
   - Subtract the measured open dummy fixture capacitance:
     $$C_{\text{array}}(V) = C_{\text{total}}(V) - C_{\text{pad}}(V)$$
   - Calculate extracted single-cell storage capacitance $C_s$:
     $$C_s = \frac{C_{\text{array}}(V_{\text{operating}})}{N}$$
     *(where $N$ is the total number of parallel cells in the test macro array)*.
   - Extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) based on physical crown/cylinder surface area and effective dielectric stack constant ($\kappa$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Single-Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (minimum $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | At operating bias ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$), $1\,\text{MHz}$ test frequency |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from accumulation capacitance across dielectric stack |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15.0$ | Dimensionless | $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$ high-k stack |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Cell Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ retention test condition |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Validates minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ capacitance budget for alpha-particle soft error immunity, stacked crown/MIM topology with W-plug contact, effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, and cell leakage $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - Validates the required storage capacitance target range of $25\text{ to }30\,\text{fF/cell}$ for $>64\,\text{ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$, and high-k dielectric stack Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) specification of $3\text{ to }4\,\text{nm}$.
- **Source 3**: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
  - Validates nominal cell capacitance value $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$ yielding $100\text{ to }150\,\text{mV}$ differential signal $\Delta V$ over bitline loading $C_{BL} = 250\,\text{fF}$.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Thermal Chuck Triaxial Probing for Sub-fA 1T1C Node Leakage at 85°C

**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture & Integration

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Chuck Pre-Heat to    │
│          85°C          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Triaxial Guarded Pin  │
│        Landing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Electrometer      │
│    Settling & Noise    │
│        Zeroing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   1T1C Node Leakage    │
│        Sampling        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│    Validation <1 fA    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Thermal Stabilization & Vacuum Chuck Setpoint:**
   - Secure the 180nm silicon wafer/die onto the gold-plated thermal chuck via vacuum hold-down.
   - Ramp the thermal chuck controller to **85.0°C** and allow a 15-minute thermal equilibrium soak time to eliminate mechanical drift and wafer bow expansion.

2. **Triaxial Guarding & Environmental Isolation:**
   - Close the dark Faraday shielding enclosure over the probe station to block ambient light-induced photocurrents and electromagnetic interference (EMI).
   - Ensure driven guard shields on triaxial lines are active (V_guard = V_force) to nullify parasitic cable and fixture leakage down to the sub-femtoampere equipment noise floor (< 0.1 fA).

3. **Guarded Micro-Probe Landing:**
   - Using precision micromanipulators with tungsten probe needles (tip radius ≤ 0.5 µm), align to the dedicated 1T1C cell test pad array (W-plug storage node / bitline contact nodes).
   - Touch down with controlled Z-axis overdrive (3 µm to 5 µm) to achieve low contact resistance without puncturing the tungsten plug or capacitor top electrode.

4. **Bias Configuration & Settling:**
   - Ground the substrate/well and access transistor gate (Wordline = 0 V to maintain cut-off; $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Apply cell high-voltage bias $V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$ (or precharge midpoint offset) across the stacked capacitor node.
   - Wait 5 seconds settling time for dielectric polarization relaxation (Ta₂O₅ / Al₂O₃ / ONO dielectric stack) and cable dielectric absorption currents to decay.

5. **Sub-fA Current Integration & Sampling:**
   - Configure the parametric analyzer / electrometer in high-resolution, long-integration mode (NPLC ≥ 10, averaging over 50 samples).
   - Measure steady-state leakage current $I_{\text{leak}}$ originating from access transistor sub-threshold leakage and junction leakage at the storage node.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature** | `85.0` | `±0.5` | `°C` |
| **Storage Node Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | `< 1.0` | `0.0 to 1.0` | `fA/cell` |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Target** | `28.0` | `25.0 to 30.0` | `fF/cell` |
| **Retention Window Minimum** | `> 64` | `≥ 64` | `ms` |

#### Leakage Benchmark Profile at 85°C:
```text
                1T1C Node Leakage Benchmark at 85C (fA) 
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░                                   │
    Equip Floor┤░░░░                                   │
Measured at 85C┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
   Target Bound┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
              0.00      0.25     0.50      0.75    1.00 
```

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Context Traceability

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Access Transistor Geometry:* $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$ with tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
  - *Dielectric Stack:* ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - *Capacitance Budget & Leakage Floor:* Minimum **$28\text{ fF/cell}$**; sub-threshold and junction leakage target **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C**.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Retention Specification:* Storage capacitance of **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell** guarantees retention time **$> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C**.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - *Charge Dynamics & Sensing Thresholds:* Validates signal margin $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ based on baseline $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction for Bitline/Wordline Matrix

- **Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)
- **Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction
- **Topology**: Folded Bitline ($8F^2$ footprint: $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Layout GDS/OAS Stream-In (BL/WL Matrix)"] --> B["Design Rule Check (DRC) Clean Run"]
    B --> C["Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction"]
    C --> D["Parasitic Extraction (PEX: R + C Network)"]
    D --> E["Capacitance Ratio & Read Margin Check (Cb/Cs <= 9:1, Delta V >= 100 mV)"]
    E --> F{"Acceptance Criteria Met?"}
    F -- "Yes" --> G["Sign-off & Matrix Netlist Release"]
    F -- "No" --> H["Layout Optimization: Metal Pitch / Dielectric Tuning"]
    H --> B
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Design Rule Verification (DRC Clean Sign-off)**
   - Run full-chip/matrix DRC decks on the $8F^2$ folded bitline cell array ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell, $F = 180\ \text{nm}$).
   - Validate high-voltage spacing and enclosure rules for Wordline pass gates rated for $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}\text{--}2.8\ \text{V}$ overdrive (preventing dielectric breakdown on access NMOS gate oxide).
   - Ensure zero design rule violations across active diffusion, poly wordlines, metal contacts, and bitline metal tracks.

2. **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Verification**
   - Extract device connectivity across all 1T1C cells (256 or 512 cells per bitline column).
   - Verify topological mapping of complementary bitline pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$) against schematic netlists.
   - Confirm pin consistency, storage capacitor terminals ($C_s$), access NMOS source/drain terminals, and equalization networks with zero shorts, opens, or property mismatch errors.

3. **Parasitic Resistance & Capacitance Extraction (PEX)**
   - Perform full field solver parasitic extraction (coupled $RC$ mode) on wordlines and folded bitlines.
   - Extract storage node capacitance $C_s$ per cell (target: nominal $28\ \text{fF}$, bound: $\ge 25\ \text{fF}\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$).
   - Extract total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ (including line-to-line coupling, junction capacitance of access transistors, and crossing capacitance over orthogonal wordlines for 256/512 cells).

4. **Capacitance Ratio and Read Margin Validation**
   - Calculate capacitance ratio:
     $$\text{Ratio} = \frac{C_b}{C_s}$$
     Ensure ratio is strictly within $5:1$ to $9:1$ (must not exceed $10:1$).
   - Compute nominal differential read sense margin $\Delta V$:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     Verify that $\Delta V \ge 100\ \text{mV}\text{--}150\ \text{mV}$ before approving matrix sign-off.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                       ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                       │░                            │
      V_PP WL Overdrive┤░                            │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒          │
    Delta V Read Margin┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒          │
C_b (Bitline Parasitic)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     C_s (Storage Node)┤█████                        │
                       │█████                        │
                       └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0     50     100    150   200 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Min / Max Bound | Units | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | PEX / 3D Field Solver Extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $200.0$ | $150.0 \le C_b \le 250.0$ (for 256–512 cells) | $\text{fF}$ | PEX Coupled $RC$ Matrix Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $7.1 : 1$ | $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$ ($< 10:1$ strictly) | Ratio | Post-PEX Automated Calculation |
| **Read Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $125.0$ | $100.0 \le \Delta V \le 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Extracted Static/Transient Calculation |
| **Wordline Driver Supply ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.65$ | $2.5 \le V_{PP} \le 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | DRC/LVS Overvoltage Rule & Transient Sim |

---

### Sources & Local Context Citations
1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: 
   - $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area: $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$.
   - $C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$ per cell (nominal $28\ \text{fF}$).
   - $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$ for array blocks of 256 or 512 cells.
   - $C_b / C_s$ constrained to $5:1\text{--}9:1$ (degradation threshold $> 10:1$).
2. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Differential read voltage signal $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\ \text{mV}\text{--}150\ \text{mV}$ for $C_s = 25\ \text{fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\ \text{fF}$.
3. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
   - Wordline boosted overdrive requirement: $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}\text{--}2.8\ \text{V}$ to prevent access NMOS $V_{th}$ charge loss ($1.8\ \text{V} - 0.6\ \text{V} = 1.2\ \text{V}$).
