# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## DRC Deck Customization & Geometric Design Rule Clean-up (180nm 1T1C DRAM Matrix)

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Custom DRC Rule Deck  │
│      Formulation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Array Density &     │
│     Dummy Geometry     │
│       Insertion        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Geometric Clean-up:   │
│    BL/WL Spacing &     │
│   Contact Enclosure    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Multi-corner      │
│     Verification &     │
│        Sign-off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the custom design rule check (DRC) deck configuration, optical proximity correction (OPC) boundary setup, and geometric clean-up procedures for the **180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip** ($8F^2$ Folded Bitline matrix layout). It governs the layout verification of the access transistor, bitline (BL) contacts, tungsten plugs (W-plugs), and capacitor-over-bitline (COB) stacked storage node modules.

---

### 2. Physical Layout Parameters & Design Constraints
All geometric parameters adhere strictly to the verified literature specifications:
* **Feature Size ($F$):** $180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).
* **Cell Layout Footprint:** $8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\ \mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ (Folded bitline architecture).
* **Access Transistor Dimensions:** Gate Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Active Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
* **Shared Contact Geometry:** Tungsten plug (W-plug) contact shared symmetrically between two adjacent 1T1C cells along the bitline.
* **Storage Node Module:** Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via drain W-plug.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Rule Deck Customization for Dense Memory Array
1. In the DRC rule deck (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Calibre syntax), split standard logic design rules into separate **Array Core** and **Periphery** rule groups using layer derivation and boundary markers (`ARRAY_BOX`).
2. Implement custom geometric rules for:
   * **Active Area (OD):** Minimum width = $220\text{ nm}$, length pitch matching $8F^2$ cell pitch.
   * **Poly Gate / Wordline (PO/WL):** Critical dimension (CD) gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   * **Bitline Contact (CT/W-Plug):** Shared contact enclosure rules (minimum OD extension past contact edge $\ge 45\text{ nm}$).
   * **Capacitor Storage Node Contact (SNC):** Crown bottom-electrode landing pad enclosure on drain plug $\ge 30\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 2: Dense Array Dummy Border & Pattern Density Balancing
1. Apply dummy wordlines and dummy bitline cells around the memory array edge (minimum 2 dummy rings) to mitigate lithography corner rounding and nested-to-isolated line bias.
2. Verify active diffusion and metal pattern density rules across a moving window ($20\ \mu\text{m} \times 20\ \mu\text{m}$):
   * Active OD density: $35\% \le \text{Density}_{\text{OD}} \le 55\%$.
   * Poly/Wordline density: $30\% \le \text{Density}_{\text{PO}} \le 50\%$.

#### Step 3: Geometric Violation Clean-up & Snapping
1. Execute initial DRC run over the full $256 \times 512$ or sub-block matrix.
2. Resolve bitline-to-wordline corner-to-corner spacing violations ($S_{\text{min}} \ge 180\text{ nm}$).
3. Eliminate grid-snapping off-grid vertices by snapping all layout vertices to the primary manufacturing grid ($1\text{ nm}$ or $5\text{ nm}$).
4. Fix acute angle geometries ($< 90^\circ$) and non-manhattan notched polygons at W-plug landing pads.

#### Step 4: Final Sign-off DRC Execution
1. Run hierarchical DRC check on the top-level cell hierarchy.
2. Confirm zero DRC violations across all array core, dummy ring, and periphery-interface layers.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Verification Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Access Transistor Gate Length ($L_{\text{gate}}$) | **$180$** (Tolerance: $\pm 0$) | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Rule Check (`WIDTH PO == 0.180um`) |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Active Width ($W_{\text{active}}$) | **$220$** (Tolerance: $\pm 0$) | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Rule Check (`WIDTH OD == 0.220um`) |
| **AC-03** | 1T1C Unit Cell Layout Area ($A_{\text{cell}}$) | **$\le 0.259$** ($8F^2$) | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Area Calculation over repeating unit cell |
| **AC-04** | Total Clean-up DRC Violations | **$0$** | Count (Errors) | Full-chip Automated Hierarchical DRC Run |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Literature References
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  * Unit cell geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * Shared bitline contact topology via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  * Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown-shaped polysilicon/MIM structure.
* **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
  * Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint with unit cell area of $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
  * Noise rejection and bitline matrix integration parameters.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## DRC Rule Deck Extension for Stacked Capacitor (COB) & Dense Contact Geometries

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-DRC-COB-001`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Process Category:** Metrology & Physical Verification (DRC / Deck Customization)  
**Target Topology:** Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) 1T1C Folded Bitline DRAM Matrix Layout

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Layer Definition & Boolean Setup: SN, PLUG, BL, WL, CB │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Dense Pitch & Width Checks (WL/BL 360-400 nm Pitch)   │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ COB Storage Node & Tungsten Contact Plug Enclosure     │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Area / Aspect Ratio Extraction (Min 25-28 fF Budget)   │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │ Golden GDS-II Regression & Metrology Violation Sign-off│
       └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Definition of Derived Mask Layers and Booleans
1. Open the base 180nm DRC runset (KLayout `drc` or Mentor Calibre `svrf`).
2. Define base topological layers for the Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stack:
   - Wordline / Access Gate Poly: `POLY` (GDS layer 10)
   - Active Diffusion: `DIFF` (GDS layer 1)
   - Shared Bitline Contact Plug: `CB_BL` (GDS layer 15)
   - Embedded Bitline: `BITLINE` (GDS layer 20)
   - Cell Storage Node Contact (Tungsten Plug / W-plug): `SN_PLUG` (GDS layer 25)
   - Crown/MIM Capacitor Storage Node Bottom Plate: `CAP_SN` (GDS layer 30)
   - Capacitor Top Plate / Cell Plate: `CAP_PLATE` (GDS layer 35)
3. Derive the access transistor channel active region:
   ```text
   GATE_AREA = POLY AND DIFF
   STORAGE_DRAIN = DIFF NOT POLY (Storage contact diffusion side)
   ```

#### Step 2: Implementation of Wordline & Bitline Pitch/Width Rule Checks
1. Implement minimum gate length and active width design rules for the access transistor:
   - Minimum gate length: `L = 180 nm` (`L_min = 0.18 um`).
   - Minimum transistor active width: `W = 220 nm` (`W_min = 0.22 um`).
2. Enforce dense memory array wordline and bitline periodic pitch checks:
   - Rule `WL_PITCH`: `POLY` spacing + width must verify pitch between `360 nm` and `400 nm`.
   - Rule `BL_PITCH`: `BITLINE` spacing + width must verify pitch between `360 nm` and `400 nm`.
3. Check bitline contact sharing geometry across two adjacent memory cells.

#### Step 3: Enclosure & Clearance Rules for Dense Contacts & Tungsten Plugs (W-Plug)
1. Add geometric clearance rule `CB_to_WL`: Minimum spacing between shared bitline contact plug (`CB_BL`) and adjacent wordline gate edge.
2. Formulate tungsten contact plug (`SN_PLUG`) to storage drain node enclosure:
   - Enforce exact symmetric enclosure of `SN_PLUG` by `STORAGE_DRAIN` to suppress junction leakage below target limit.
3. Formulate capacitor bottom electrode (`CAP_SN`) landing and enclosure rules over `SN_PLUG`:
   - Minimum overlap/enclosure of `SN_PLUG` by `CAP_SN` crown pedestal.
   - Minimum clearance between adjacent crown nodes `CAP_SN` across diagonal cell pairs.

#### Step 4: Storage Capacitor Geometry & Physical Area DRC Constraints
1. Create area and perimeter extraction checks on `CAP_SN`:
   - Compute physical 3D effective electrode area considering crown/cylinder sidewall height.
   - Enforce minimum effective area matching the cell dielectric configuration (EOT = 3 to 4 nm with $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO stack with $\kappa > 15$) to prevent design-phase layout instantiation yielding $< 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$.
2. Enforce top-plate (`CAP_PLATE`) enclosure boundary over active array perimeter.

#### Step 5: Test Execution, Regression Run, and DRC Clean-up
1. Execute custom rule deck against the 180nm $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ 1T1C matrix test benchmark:
   ```powershell
   klayout -b -r drc_cob_180nm.lydrc -rd input=matrix_180nm_test.gds -rd report=drc_cob_report.lyrdb
   ```
2. Verify zero false violations along array boundaries and wordline/bitline strap cells.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | Exact DRC Nominal Constraint | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | Exact DRC Nominal Constraint | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Bitline & Wordline Grid Pitch** | `360 to 400` | $[360,\, 400]$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Minimum Storage Capacitance Metric ($C_s$)** | `25 to 28` | $\ge 25$ (Design rule limit) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Context References & Sourcing
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms tungsten plug (W-plug) stacked capacitor topology over drain contact with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Sets minimum target capacitance budget at $28\text{ fF/cell}$ and junction/sub-threshold leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Confirms $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ 1T1C architecture, bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
  - Specifies storage capacitor retention requirement of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) and equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Grounds differential sensing margins ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$) based on $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ against bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

   - Stream in the finalized 180 nm 1T1C cell array layout GDSII/OASIS file containing the folded bitline structure ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$).
   - Load the customized 180 nm DRAM technology DRC rule deck tailored for capacitor-over-bitline (COB) and shared bitline contacts.
2. **Batch Automated Execution**:
   - Launch batch-mode DRC across the active matrix, perimeter sense amplifier boundary, and wordline stitch regions.
   - Generate rule error summary reports (`.rdb` / `.summary`) flagging geometric design rule violations.
3. **Matrix Spacing Violation Isolation & Correction**:
   - Parse wordline (polysilicon gate) and bitline metallization line-to-line spacing errors.
   - Enforce the required wordline and bitline routing pitch within the physical grid limit of **360 nm to 400 nm**.
   - Validate access transistor dimensions to maintain gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
4. **Contact & Plug Enclosure Debugging**:
   - Filter enclosure errors at the shared bitline contact pad and capacitor tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pads.
   - Adjust the active diffusion and metal overlap margins over the tungsten contacts to guarantee full landing under lithographic overlay shifts.
5. **Regressive Re-Run & Stream-Out**:
   - Re-run hierarchical DRC checks incrementally over modified coordinate bounding boxes.
   - Confirm zero matrix violations, lock coordinate geometries, and stream out the verified GDSII layout.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-LITHO-001`  
**Title:** Final Geometric Clean-up Sign-off & Lithography Compatibility Metrology  
**Node / Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm Node) — DRAM Foundation VN  
**Discipline:** Metrology & Sign-off Verification / Physical Design Sign-off  
**Procurement / Action Type:** Buy (External Foundry Tape-out & Lithography Clean-up Verification)

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the procedural flow for final full-chip geometric clean-up, Design Rule Checking (DRC) sign-off, and lithography rule/process window qualification on 180 nm 1T1C stacked capacitor DRAM bitline/wordline matrix arrays prior to tape-out mask preparation.

---

### 2. Standard Operating Procedure Flow

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Full-Chip GDSII/OASIS Merge & Top-Level Hierarchy Flattening Verification  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Final DRC Sign-off Run (Wordline, Bitline, and Contact Array Checks)      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Lithography Process Window & Critical Dimension (CD) Metrology Simulation |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Sign-off Signatures & Buy-off Tape-out Package Freeze                     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Full-Chip GDSII/OASIS Ingestion & Boundary Verification
1. Merge the final 180 nm 1T1C DRAM core cell matrix with periphery sense amplifiers, decoders, and seal rings into a unified top-level layout file (`final_tapeout.gds`).
2. Verify coordinate snapping to the physical design grid (5 nm standard manufacturing grid) to prevent off-grid vertex errors.
3. Validate that cell boundary abutments for 8F² / 6F² arrays exhibit zero overlapping polygons or illegal layout boundaries.

#### Step 2: Full-Chip Design Rule Checking (DRC) Execution
1. Load the certified foundry 180 nm DRC sign-off rule deck.
2. Execute automated DRC across all critical layers:
   - **Access Transistor Active / Poly Gate:** Verify channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - **Array Wiring Pitch:** Check that Wordline (Poly/Polycide) pitch and Bitline (M1) pitch fall strictly within the allowed $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ envelope.
   - **Via/Contact Geometry:** Validate nested tungsten plug (W-plug) encasements and minimum spacing to active diffusion boundaries for shared bitline contacts.
3. Review DRC error markers; apply automated pattern fixes or re-route touch-ups for any non-conforming geometries.

#### Step 3: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) & Lithography Process Margin Metrology
1. Run lithography simulation across a nominal process window ($\pm 10\%$ exposure dose, $\pm 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ depth-of-focus) on critical dense array layers (Poly Wordline, M1 Bitline).
2. Inspect for critical necking/pinching (bridging or open circuits) along dense array wordlines and bitlines across the simulated focus-exposure matrix (FEM).
3. Validate that post-OPC aerial images maintain critical dimension (CD) variations within allowable foundry process limits.

#### Step 4: Quality Review & Sign-off Archival
1. Generate the Final DRC & Lithography Compliance Certificate report confirming zero fatal DRC violations (`Violations == 0`).
2. Freeze the layout checksum (`SHA-256`) and compile the sign-off package for external foundry mask data prep (MDP).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Sign-off Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180 \pm 0$ (Nominal drawn) | $\text{nm}$ | Calibre/IC Validator Automated DRC |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220 \pm 0$ (Nominal drawn) | $\text{nm}$ | Calibre/IC Validator Automated DRC |
| **Bitline & Wordline Dense Array Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Pitch Metrology Deck |
| **DRC Critical Sign-off Violations** | $0$ (Clean Sign-off) | Count | Foundry DRC Rule Deck Run Log |

---

### 4. Context References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry criteria ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, shared bitline contact, and tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Pitch specification constraints for wordline and bitline arrays ($360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$ pitch), 8F²/6F² cell footprint topologies.

```text
             │
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────────╮Mismatch
         Pass│                                  │
             ▼                                  ▼
┌────────────────────────┐         ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │         │                        │
│  LVS Clean: 0 Errors   │         │    Pin/Net/Property    │
│                        │         │       Error Log        │
│                        │         │                        │
└────────────────────────┘         └────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Scope & Physical Context

This SOP defines the netlist-versus-schematic (LVS) comparison, device extraction, and node connectivity verification for a 180nm open-source 1T1C DRAM bitline/wordline matrix layout block.

### Key Layout & Physical Parameters
- **Feature Size ($F$):** $180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\,\mu\text{m}$)
- **Cell Footprint:** $8F^2$ folded bitline topology ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell area)
- **Access NMOS Dimensions:** Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$
- **Cell Architecture:** Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via tungsten plug (W-plug) to the transistor storage drain node; bitline contact shared between adjacent cells
- **Dielectric Stack:** High-$\kappa$ ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ ($\kappa > 15$)

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Netlist Pre-Processing & Layout Preparation
1. Export layout stream (`gds2` / `oasis`) from the bitline/wordline array macro. Ensure all layer mapping tables preserve:
   - Poly wordlines (`WL`)
   - Active diffusion (`DIFF`/`OD`)
   - Tungsten storage plug contacts (`W-plug`)
   - Bitline contacts (`BLC`) and metal bitlines (`BL`, `/BL`)
   - Cell plate (`V_PLATE` / $V_{DD}/2$) common top electrode
2. Generate golden hierarchical SPICE/CDL netlist from the schematic database. Confirm subcircuits define:
   - Access NMOS: $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$
   - Storage capacitor ($C_s$): Nominal target $28\text{ fF}$ (allowed operational range $\ge 25\text{ fF}\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) connected between the internal storage node `SN` and `V_PLATE`.

### Step 2: Layer Derivation & Device Extraction
1. Execute the LVS rule deck (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Netgen / Calibre).
2. Verify pin and text label connectivity:
   - Extract primary array ports: `BL<0:N>`, `BL_B<0:N>`, `WL<0:M>`, and `V_PLATE`.
   - Confirm common node recognition for shared bitline contacts between adjacent 1T1C cells.
3. Extract recognized 2-terminal capacitor devices at the stacked capacitor level and 3/4-terminal NMOS devices along the active wordline gates.

### Step 3: Topological Netlist Comparison & Error Resolution
1. Run LVS comparison engine with device property tolerance checking:
   - Access transistor: $W/L$ tolerance within $\pm 1\%$.
   - Storage capacitance $C_s$: Nominal parameter validation.
2. In case of discrepancies, inspect the discrepancy report:
   - **Unconnected Nets / Opens:** Verify tungsten plug vias between access drain and bottom crown plate.
   - **Short Circuits:** Check bitline contact clearance and adjacent cell storage node clearances.
   - **Pin Swaps:** Ensure complementary bitline pairs `BL` and `/BL` are routed to differential sense amplifier cross-coupled pairs according to folded-bitline connectivity.

### Step 4: Storage Node & Bitline Connectivity Matrix Sign-off
1. Trace connectivity of storage node `SN`:
   - Verify complete isolation of `SN` when `WL` is unasserted (low).
   - Ensure `SN` connects exclusively to access transistor drain terminal and storage capacitor bottom plate.
2. Verify bitline array matrix configuration (blocks of 256 or 512 cells per bitline).
3. Generate signed LVS report and archive LVS extraction netlist for parasitic extraction (PEX).

---

## 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Evaluation Mechanism | Target Value / Specification | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **LVS Discrepancy Count** | Topology Comparison Log | `0` (Zero nets, pins, and instances mismatched) | count |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | Extracted Layout Property Check | $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0\text{ nm}$), $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0\text{ nm}$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Unit Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Device Extractor Property Check | Nominally $28\text{ fF}$ (Minimum $\ge 25\text{ fF}$) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Unit Cell Footprint Area** | Bounding Box Calculation | $0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ ($8F^2$ Folded Bitline Topology) | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |

---

## 5. Literature Context References

1. **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
   - *Cited Details:* $8F^2$ folded bitline topology with cell area $= 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$; Storage node capacitance target $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$); Array block sizing of 256 or 512 cells per bitline; Bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF}\text{ to }250\text{ fF}$ with target ratio $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$.
2. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - *Cited Details:* Access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; Shared bitline contact between adjacent memory cells; Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) erected via tungsten plug (W-plug); Dielectric stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$; Target storage capacitance of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
3. **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
   - *Cited Details:* Differential complementary bitline pairing `BL` and `/BL` connected to CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch; Equalization and precharge topology to $V_{DD}/2$.

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Layer Map Configuration & Conductive Trace Declaration**:
   - Ingest physical design masks: `ACTIVE`, `POLY_WL`, `NPLUS_IMPLANT`, `PPLUS_IMPLANT`, `CONT_W`, `METAL1_BL`, `CAP_BOTTOM_NODE`, `CAP_TOP_PLATE`, `SUBSTRATE`.
   - Declare vertical inter-layer electrical connectivity:
     - `CONNECT ACTIVE NPLUS_IMPLANT BY DIFF_CONT`
     - `CONNECT NPLUS_IMPLANT METAL1_BL BY CONT_W`
     - `CONNECT NPLUS_IMPLANT CAP_BOTTOM_NODE BY CONT_W`
2. **1T Access Transistor Primitive Derivation**:
   - Derive channel region using Boolean intersection:
     $$\text{DRAM\_CHANNEL} = (\text{ACTIVE} \cap \text{POLY\_WL}) \cap \text{NPLUS\_IMPLANT}$$
   - Derive source/drain diffusions:
     $$\text{DRAM\_SD} = (\text{ACTIVE} \cap \text{NPLUS\_IMPLANT}) \setminus \text{POLY\_WL}$$
   - Establish 1T NMOS primitive extraction with terminal mappings: Gate (`POLY_WL`), Source (`DRAM_SD` connected to shared bitline contact), Drain (`DRAM_SD` connected to storage node plug), Bulk (`P_SUBSTRATE`), extracting nominal dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
3. **1C Stacked Storage Capacitor Primitive Recognition**:
   - Derive the capacitor effective dielectric overlap:
     $$\text{DRAM\_CAP\_AREA} = \text{CAP\_BOTTOM_NODE} \cap \text{CAP\_TOP\_PLATE}$$
   - Map physical terminals: Storage Node (`SN`) via tungsten plug (`W-plug`) to access transistor drain; Cell Plate (`CP`) to common array plate biased at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Bind to device extraction model `CAP_1T1C` with EOT of $3\text{ nm to }4\text{ nm}$.
4. **Folded Bitline Pairing and Contact Sharing Audit**:
   - Route and associate complementary bitline pairs (`BL` and `/BL`) on `METAL1_BL`.
   - Run layout topology soft-check rule to confirm the bitline contact is strictly shared between two adjacent 1T1C memory cells.
5. **LVS Comparison & Discrepancy Verification**:
   - Extract layout SPICE netlist and compare against reference schematic CDL.
   - Verify zero layout discrepancies: ensure no opens, shorts, pin mismatches, or dimension mismatches exceeding tolerance.

### 4. Context Literature Citations

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contact topology between two adjacent memory cells.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title
**Hierarchical Netlist Extraction and Layout-Versus-Schematic (LVS) Equivalence Run for 180nm 1T1C DRAM Matrix**

---

### 1. Document Metadata & Process Context
- **Scope & Hierarchy:** DRAM Foundation VN > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction for Bitline/Wordline Matrix > LVS Netlist Comparison & 1T1C Node Connectivity Validation > Hierarchical Netlist Extraction and Layout-Versus-Schematic Equivalence Run
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)
- **Action Type:** Make / Verification Execution
- **Target Cell Architecture:** 1T1C folded bitline, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) configuration ($8F^2$ or $6F^2$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           LVS EXECUTION FLOW PIPELINE                             |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  [Step 1: Setup]        Input SPICE schematic & GDSII/OASIS matrix layout
         |
         v
  [Step 2: Rule Prep]    Bind 180nm LVS deck; set L=180nm, W=220nm, C_s extraction
         |
         v
  [Step 3: Extract]      Hierarchical device & connectivity netlist extraction (GDSII -> EXT)
         |
         v
  [Step 4: Comparison]   Topological match, pin permutation, cross-coupled latch trace
         |
         v
  [Step 5: Analysis]     Validate zero discrepancy, report extraction deltas & sign-off
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Input Netlist and GDSII Pre-Verification Setup
1. Export the reference transistor-level schematic netlist (`matrix_1t1c_reference.spice`) encompassing the unit 1T1C cells, bitline/wordline interconnect matrices, precharge equalizers, and cross-coupled sense amplifier latch circuits.
2. Load the physical layout file (`dram_matrix_180nm.gds`) into the physical verification engine (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Netgen / Calibre-compatible flow).
3. Validate layer map alignment for critical masks: Active (OD), Poly Gate/Wordline (PO), Shared Bitline Contact (CONT/W-plug), Metal 1 Bitline (M1), Capacitor Contact/Node (SN_CONT), and Crown/Stacked MIM/Cylinder Capacitor top/bottom electrodes (CAP_BOT, CAP_TOP).

#### Step 2: Layer Derivation & Device Recognition Deck Initialization
1. Configure extraction rules to recognize the access transistor geometry with target nominal gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ µm}$) and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\text{ µm}$).
2. Formulate device recognition models for the stacked storage capacitor:
   - Identify plate node connected to common cell plate ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{DD}/2$).
   - Identify storage node connected to the drain diffusion through the tungsten plug (W-plug).
3. Set parasitic/lumped model extraction for folded bitline complementary pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$) and sense amplifier NMOS/PMOS pull-down/pull-up cross-coupled pairs.

#### Step 3: Hierarchical Device and Interconnect Extraction
1. Execute hierarchical connectivity extraction (`ext2spice` or hierarchical extraction run).
2. Trace shared contact geometries between adjacent cells along the bitline axis to verify node sharing without short-circuiting adjacent storage nodes.
3. Extract layout netlist (`matrix_1t1c_extracted.spice`) preserving hierarchy for the $8F^2 / 6F^2$ unit array blocks, sub-wordline drivers, and sense amp segments.

#### Step 4: Topological Comparison & Equivalence Engine Run
1. Run LVS comparison engine between `matrix_1t1c_reference.spice` and `matrix_1t1c_extracted.spice`.
2. Enable symmetry recognition and terminal swapping for symmetric differential bitline pairs ($BL$, $/BL$) and sense amplifier cross-coupled inverter gates.
3. Check 1T1C storage node isolation: ensure that no storage node is floating, shorted to bulk/substrate, or bridging across wordlines.

#### Step 5: Discrepancy Reporting & Sign-Off Documentation
1. Review discrepancy matrix: inspect discrepancies in device counts (MOSFETs, capacitors), net counts, port mappings, and parameter tolerances.
2. Verify that extracted storage cell capacitance values fall within physical target budgets prior to parasitic extraction (PEX).
3. Generate signed LVS clean status log (`lvs_run.log`).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Engine Check |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180 \pm 9$ | nm | Extracted layout gate parameter tolerance ($\le \pm 5\%$ of nominal $180\text{ nm}$) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220 \pm 11$ | nm | Extracted layout active width tolerance ($\le \pm 5\%$ of nominal $220\text{ nm}$) |
| **Unit Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ (min. threshold: $\ge 25$) | fF | Hierarchical capacitor device parameter extraction |
| **Netlist Comparison Topology Delta** | $0$ (Unmatched Nets = $0$, Unmatched Devices = $0$) | Count | Automated LVS comparator equivalence log |

---

### 4. Context References & Traceability
- **Transistor Dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), Stacked Capacitor (Crown/MIM via W-plug), and Cell Layout ($8F^2, 6F^2$, Shared Contact):**
  *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
- **Capacitance Value Range ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell):**
  *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* and *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
- **Folded Bitline Topology & Cross-Coupled Inverter Sensing Architecture:**
  *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
citations: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 1T1C Storage Node Floating Check & Plate Voltage Bias Connectivity Verification

**Module**: Architecture & Integration / Metrology  
**Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Target Structure**: 1T1C Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) Cell Matrix (8F² / 6F²)  
**Action Type**: Make / Verification  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Verification Lifecycle

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  GDSII Matrix Layout & Layer Boolean Derivation        │
│  - Active/Diffusion (W = 220 nm, L = 180 nm)           │
│  - Poly Gate (Wordline), Bitline W-Plug Contact        │
│  - Storage Node Via (SN Contact) & Crown/MIM Top Plate │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  1T1C Node Connectivity Extraction & Floating Checks   │
│  - Check SN terminal continuity to access drain        │
│  - Flag open-circuited / isolated storage nodes        │
│  - Verify no parasitic shorts to adjacent wordlines    │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Common Plate Bias (V_PL) Global Net Verification     │
│  - Verify continuous meshed top-plate plane            │
│  - Ensure top-plate tied to V_DD / 2 precharge bias    │
│  - Detect pin disconnection or excessive resistance    │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Parasitic Extraction & LVS Final Sign-off             │
│  - Validate cell capacitance C_s (25 fF to 30 fF)      │
│  - Bitline coupling verification (C_BL ~ 250 fF)       │
│  - Zero electrical discrepancy sign-off                │
│                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Rule Deck Layer Derivation & Device Recognition**:
   - Compile DRC/LVS rule decks targeting 180nm COB architecture.
   - Define boolean layer operations: identify access transistor drain/source diffusion (`W = 220 nm`, `L = 180 nm`), wordline poly gate (`pitch = 360 nm to 400 nm`), tungsten plug (`W-plug`), and crown/cylinder capacitor dielectric stack (ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$).
   - Formulate recognition pins for the storage node (`SN`) and the global cell plate (`V_PL` / Cell Plate).

2. **Storage Node (`SN`) Floating & Continuity Check**:
   - Execute topological connectivity extraction from access transistor drain diffusion through the tungsten plug to the crown/MIM capacitor bottom plate.
   - Run antenna and electrical floating net checks to verify that every bottom plate terminal connects to **exactly one** access transistor drain node.
   - Flag any floating storage bottom electrodes (unconnected via/W-plug opens) or multi-driven storage nodes (bridging shorts across adjacent cell nodes).

3. **Common Cell Plate (`V_PL`) Continuity and Bias Verification**:
   - Trace the continuous common plate metal/polysilicon plane covering the memory array matrix.
   - Verify low-resistance continuity from the top plate array across pick-up rings to the internal reference generator providing cell plate voltage bias ($V_{\text{PL}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$).
   - Run soft-connect / floating gate checks to ensure no sub-array top plate tile is left electrically isolated or floating.

4. **Parasitic Extraction & Differential Sensing Margin Audit**:
   - Extract 3D field solver parasitic capacitance for storage nodes ($C_s$) and bitline lines ($C_{\text{BL}}$).
   - Ensure the cell storage capacitance satisfies noise immunity criteria and soft-error immunity.
   - Cross-check that the differential voltage development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$ matches the target operating window for the cross-coupled sense amplifier.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                 Capacitance & Signal Margins (fF & mV) 
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │███████████████████████              │
   Delta V Signal┤███████████████████████              │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     C_BL Typical┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
C_s Budget Target┤▒▒▒▒▒                                │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒                                │
   C_s Min Target┤░░░░░                                │
                 │░░░░░                                │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0     62.5     125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Specification Window | Exact Unit | Inspection Tool / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28.0` | `25.0` to `30.0` | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Extraction rule deck / Metrology LVS Netlist |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | `250.0` | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Field solver parasitic net extraction (PEX) |
| **Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | `125.0` | `100.0` to `150.0` | $\text{mV}$ | Post-layout SPICE sense amplifier simulation |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | Max $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Electrical test (E-test) / TCAD junction verification |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | Critical Dimension (CD) $\pm 5\%$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical DRC / Optical CD SEM Metrology |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM capacitor over tungsten plug (W-plug); capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - 1T1C architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ layout; minimum capacitance target of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$ guaranteeing retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch folded-bitline readout; precharge equalization to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; cell charge dumping $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$; differential sensing signal development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## PEX Extraction & Wordline/Bitline Parasitic RC Modeling (180nm 1T1C DRAM Matrix)

```
Hierarchy: DRAM Foundation VN > Architecture & Integration > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > Metrology > PEX Extraction & Wordline/Bitline Parasitic RC Modeling
Generation: Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)
Action Type: Make
Document ID: SOP-DRAM180-PEX-001
```

---

### 1. Architectural Workflow & Extraction Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["GDSII / OASIS Clean 180nm Layout (8F² Folded BL)"] --> B["Rule Deck Setup & Layer Mapping (Calibre xRC / StarRC)"]
    B --> C["Full-Chip / Matrix PEX (Distributed RC Network Extraction)"]
    C --> D["Storage Node Capacitance (C_s) Net Extraction"]
    C --> E["Bitline Parasitic Capacitance (C_b) & Coupling Extraction"]
    C --> F["Wordline Distributed RC & High-Voltage Gate Extraction"]
    D --> G["Capacitance Ratio Validation (C_b / C_s <= 9 : 1)"]
    E --> G
    F --> H["V_PP Wordline Transient Delay & Voltage Loss Check"]
    G --> I{"Acceptance Criteria Satisfied?"}
    H --> I
    I -- Yes --> J["Sign-off Extracted SPICE DSPF Netlist"]
    I -- No --> K["Iterate Metal Pitch, Contact Stitching or Shielding"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Extraction Deck & Layer Calibration Setup**:
   - Load the certified 180nm design kit rule decks (targeting unit cell $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $8F^2$ footprint area of $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
   - Configure parasitic extraction (PEX) for distributed $RC$ reduction with high-frequency corner cutoffs.
   - Define dielectric constants for stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$ for ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).

2. **Bitline Matrix Distributed Parasitic Extraction**:
   - Extract total Bitline wire capacitance ($C_b$) and resistance ($R_{bl}$) across array sub-blocks populated with 256 to 512 cells per bitline.
   - Include adjacent bitline-to-bitline ($BL$ to $\overline{BL}$) coupling capacitance, drain diffusion junction capacitance, and tungsten plug ($W$-plug) contact parasitics.

3. **Storage Node Extraction ($C_s$) & Pass Gate Coupling**:
   - Isolate the storage node capacitor node from the cell access pass transistor NMOS source/drain.
   - Extract intrinsic stacked crown/MIM capacitance and verify that $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ nominal per cell, accounting for soft-error immunity.

4. **Wordline Parasitic RC & Overdrive Stress Modeling**:
   - Extract polysilicon/strapped metal wordline gate interconnect resistance and capacitance across matrix rows.
   - Set operating conditions for wordline charge-pump driver models with boosted voltage $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$ to account for access NMOS threshold voltage ($V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$) and prevent stored charge loss.

5. **DSPF / SPEF Netlist Reduction & Back-Annotation**:
   - Synthesize extracted parasitic DSPF netlists.
   - Run multi-corner transient simulations to verify signal development margin and sensing delay.

---

### 3. Key Physical Targets & Parameters

```text
                  DRAM 180nm Key PEX RC Modeling Limits 
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░                                 │
     V_PP Min (V)┤░░░░                                 │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
     C_s Min (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
C_b/C_s Ratio Typ┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
C_b/C_s Ratio Max┤█████████████                        │
                 │█████████████                        │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0        7       14       21       28 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Nominal / Allowed Limit | Unit | Verification Method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **AC-PEX-01** | Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Extracted net capacitance on storage node |
| **AC-PEX-02** | Total Bitline Parasitics ($C_b$, 256–512 cells) | $150.0 - 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Lumped bitline extracted parasitic capacitance |
| **AC-PEX-03** | Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1 - 9.0 : 1$ (Reject $> 10.0 : 1$) | Ratio | Calculated from extracted $C_b$ and $C_s$ |
| **AC-PEX-04** | Wordline High-Voltage Gate Overdrive ($V_{PP}$) | $2.5 - 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Transient simulation with Dickson pump driver |

---

### 5. Verified Source Citations

- **[1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**: Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$); Bitline parasitic capacitance budget ($C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ for 256–512 cells/bitline); Maximum allowed ratio before severe read margin degradation ($C_b / C_s = 5 : 1 - 9 : 1$, threshold limit $< 10 : 1$).
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Access NMOS channel geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); Folded bitline $8F^2$ cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$); COB tungsten plug ($W$-plug) contacts; High-$\kappa$ dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$).
- **[High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture]**: Access NMOS $V_{th} = 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$; Target boosted wordline drive level ($V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$) to overcome threshold voltage loss ($V_{DD} - V_{th} = 1.2\text{ V}$ at nominal $1.8\text{ V}$ $V_{DD}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Identification
- **Title**: GDSII Layer Mapping & 180nm PEX Technology Rule Deck Configuration
- **SOP ID**: `SOP-180NM-PEX-GDS-001`
- **Scope**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction for Bitline/Wordline Matrix > PEX Extraction & Wordline/Bitline Parasitic RC Modeling
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 1: GDSII Layer   │
│    Stream Ingestion    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Step 2: Layer      │
│   Derivation and Pin   │
│      Connectivity      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Step 3: PEX       │
│  Dielectric Stack and  │
│       Parasitics       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 4: PEX Netlist   │
│   Extraction and QA    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Ingest Layout Stream & Define GDSII Layer Map Table
1. Import the taped-out/routed GDSII stream file of the 180nm 1T1C folded bitline DRAM matrix into the parasitic extraction (PEX) engine.
2. Bind stream layer and datatype identifiers to logical mask layers in the PEX layer map file (`gds_map.rules`):
   - **Diffusion / Active Area (DIFF/OD)**: Layer `1`, Datatype `0` (Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - **Polysilicon / Wordline (POLY/WL)**: Layer `2`, Datatype `0` (Pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - **Contact to Active/Poly (CONT/W-plug)**: Layer `3`, Datatype `0` (Tungsten plugs).
   - **Metal 1 / Bitline (M1/BL)**: Layer `4`, Datatype `0` (Pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - **Capacitor Bottom Electrode / Node (SN_CONT)**: Layer `5`, Datatype `0`.
   - **Capacitor Top Plate / Cell Plate (PLATE)**: Layer `6`, Datatype `0` (Crown/cylinder stacked structure).

### Step 2: Establish Layer Derivations & Geometric Connectivity Operations
1. Form primary electrical nodes using standard Boolean layout derivations:
   - Identify DRAM access transistor gates via intersection: `GATE = POLY AND DIFF`.
   - Identify source/drain diffusion regions: `SD = DIFF NOT POLY`.
   - Derive the storage node node pin: `SN_NODE = SN_CONT INTERSECT SD`.
   - Derive the bitline contact pin: `BL_CONTACT = CONT INTERSECT SD` (shared between two adjacent memory cells in 8F² / 6F² folded bitline topologies).
2. Configure vertical multi-level connectivity chains:
   - Connect `M1` to `SD` through `CONT` (W-plug).
   - Connect `SN_NODE` to stacked capacitor bottom electrode via storage node `W-plug`.

### Step 3: Configure 180nm PEX Dielectric Stack & RC Extraction Parameters
1. Declare vertical cross-section profiles and dielectric constants in the PEX technology deck (`tech.pex`):
   - **Gate Dielectric**: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation, with physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - **Capacitor Dielectric**: High-k stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO triple dielectric) calibrated to effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, with an Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
   - **Interlayer Dielectric (ILD)**: Set relative permittivity of pre-metal and inter-metal dielectrics isolating Bitline (M1) and Wordline (Poly).
2. Set 2.5D/3D field solver boundary extraction rules for parasitic coupling:
   - Wordline-to-wordline coupling ($C_{\text{WL-WL}}$) at $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$ pitch.
   - Bitline-to-bitline coupling ($C_{\text{BL-BL}}$) at $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$ pitch.
   - Bitline-to-substrate and Bitline-to-Wordline cross-capacitance.

### Step 4: Execute RC Extraction & Validate Extracted Netlist
1. Run distributed RC extraction on the cell matrix array:
   ```bash
   pex_engine --deck tech.pex --layout dram_matrix_180nm.gds --layer-map gds_map.rules --mode RC --out extracted_dram_matrix.spf
   ```
2. Verify that extracted parasitics match electrical constraints for differential signal development:
   - Calculate signal margin $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \times \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.
   - Inspect parasitic report for sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold integrity at elevated operational temperatures ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Exact Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Minimum $\ge 28.0$ for noise immunity) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field-Solver / PEX Netlist LVS Extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | $250.0$ (Nominal reference array column) | $\text{fF}$ | PEX Distributed RC Netlist Matrix Summary |
| **Bitline & Wordline Matrix Pitch** | $360.0 \text{ to } 400.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC/PEX Pitch Rule Check |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | $3.5$ (Thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{nm}$ | PEX Technology Profile / In-line Metrology Verification |
| **Capacitor Dielectric EOT & Permittivity** | $\text{EOT}: 3.0 \text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$; $\kappa > 15.0$ | $\text{nm}$ / Dimensionless | Ellipsometry / PEX Dielectric Material Definition Deck |
| **Cell Leakage Current at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Post-layout SPICE Leakage Simulation ($\text{Retention} > 64\text{ ms}$) |

---

## 3. Literature Context Citations
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Transistor gate dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown-shaped polysilicon/MIM structure with W-plugs.
  - Capacitor dielectric ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ and leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - 1T1C architecture with $8\text{F}^2 / 6\text{F}^2$ cell layouts requiring $C_s$ of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ to ensure data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ using $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
  - Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - Folded bitline topology with cross-coupled sense amplifier latch precharged to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
  - Nominal array parameters: cell storage capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, generating differential voltage $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Distributed 3D Field Solver RC Extraction for Folded Bitline and Poly/Silicide Wordline Array

- **Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-042`
- **Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)
- **Module:** Architecture & Integration > Metrology / Circuit Design
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Extraction Workflow & Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  GDSII / OASIS Array  │
│        Layout         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘

            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │

            │
            │

┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Boundary Element /   │

│        Solver         │

            │

│                       │

            │

│                       │
│  Multi-Port Coupled   │

│        Matrix         │
│                       │

```

```text
                                                        
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░                         │
Oxide Temp (degC/10)┤░░░░░░░░░                         │
                    │▒▒▒                               │
 Cell Cs Target (fF)┤▒▒▒                               │
  BL Cap Target (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓           │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓           │
    WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████│
                    │██████████████████████████████████│
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0      95       190     285    380 
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Geometry Ingestion & Periodic Boundary Instantiation**:
   - Stream the validated hierarchical GDSII/OASIS layout containing the folded bitline ($BL$/$\overline{BL}$) and poly/silicide wordline matrix.
   - Configure a representative unit tile consisting of an $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ array segment with access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and pitch spanning $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Apply periodic Dirichlet/Neumann boundary conditions across array boundaries to emulate an infinite embedded core without edge fringing artifacts.

2. **Dielectric Stack & Material Assignment**:
   - Assign gate dielectric properties: physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation.
   - Assign stacked capacitor geometry above bitline (COB) contacted via tungsten plugs (W-plug) with high-$\kappa$ triple dielectric ($\text{ONO}$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, effective $\kappa > 15$, Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$).
   - Set poly/silicide sheet resistance and inter-metal dielectric (IMD) permittivities surrounding tungsten bitlines and bitline contacts.

3. **Domain Decomposition & Cluster Job Dispatch**:
   - Partition the dense 3D conductor array into overlapping bounding boxes using distributed domain decomposition.
   - Dispatch distributed Boundary Element Method (BEM) and Floating Random Walk (FRW) 3D field solver instances across compute nodes.
   - Resolve electric field distributions to accurately compute lateral coupling capacitances ($C_{\text{BL-BL}}$, $C_{\text{WL-BL}}$, $C_{\text{WL-WL}}$) and cross-layer fringe fields.

4. **Multi-Port Coupled RC Netlist Reduction & Verification**:
   - Extract multi-port parasitic capacitance and distributed resistance matrices for all complementary $BL$/$\overline{BL}$ pairs and poly/silicide wordlines.
   - Perform model-order reduction (TICER/Arnoldi) to export a distributed SPEF/DSPF netlist preserving coupling capacitance to cell nodes.
   - Validate that differential signal development $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$ yields between $100\text{ mV}$ and $150\text{ mV}$ under nominal precharge conditions ($V_{DD}/2$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | `250` | $\pm 10\%$ max deviation across full column span | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28` (min `25` to `30`) | Absolute lower bound $\ge 25.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | $\le 1.0$ | At $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh $> 64\text{ ms}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Bitline / Wordline Physical Pitch** | `360 to 400` | Critical dimension metrology limit | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 4. Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked COB architecture with W-plugs, $\kappa > 15$ dielectric, target capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Complementary $BL$/$\overline{BL}$ folded-bitline topology, $V_{DD}/2$ precharge equalization, nominal $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, nominal $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, and sensing $\Delta V = 100\text{ to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: $8F^2 / 6F^2$ 1T1C architecture, $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ retention budget for $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4 / \text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$), wordline/bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$, and $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: DSPF/SPEF Back-Annotation, RC Mesh Reduction & Bitline-to-Bitline Coupling Crosstalk SPICE Analysis
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Hierarchy**: [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell Bitline & Wordline Matrix Layout [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic Extraction for Bitline/Wordline Matrix [Metrology] > PEX Extraction & Wordline/Bitline Parasitic RC Modeling [Circuit Design] > DSPF/SPEF Back-Annotation, RC Mesh Reduction & Bitline-to-Bitline Coupling Crosstalk SPICE Analysis [Circuit Design]
- **Action Type**: Make

---

## 1. Overview & Workflow Architecture

This SOP specifies the back-annotation of parasitic RC network extractions (DSPF/SPEF) for the 180nm 1T1C DRAM folded-bitline matrix, executes order-reduction on distributed RC meshes, and evaluates transient bitline-to-bitline coupling crosstalk against dynamic sense-amplifier latch margins.

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  DSPF/SPEF Back-Annotation & Mesh Reduction  │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Folded BL/BLB Dynamic Crosstalk SPICE Sim   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│      Transient Differential Verification     │
│             (dV >= 100 to 150 mV)            │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Netlist Ingestion & DSPF/SPEF Back-Annotation
1. Ingest the post-layout parasitic extraction files (`.dspf` / `.spef`) extracted from the 180nm folded bitline/wordline matrix (pitch: 360 nm to 400 nm).
2. Stitch distributed parasitic RC networks onto the unit 1T1C memory array schematic comprising access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and stacked storage capacitors ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$).
3. Ensure bitline contact sharing and metal-insulator-metal (MIM) / crown capacitor connections through the tungsten plug (W-plug) are correctly mapped to corresponding circuit nodes.

### Step 2: Algorithmic RC Mesh Reduction
1. Apply Krylov subspace (TICER / PRIMA) reduction algorithms to compress dense distributed RC networks along adjacent bitlines (BL and complementary $\overline{\text{BL}}$) into equivalent $\Pi$- or T-ladder models.
2. Filter high-order parasitic poles exceeding the cutoff threshold ($f_c \gg 10\text{ GHz}$) while maintaining inter-wire coupling capacitance ($C_c$) and total bitline capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) within $\pm 1\%$ error tolerance.

### Step 3: Transient Crosstalk & Signal Development SPICE Setup
1. Back-annotate the reduced SPICE deck with precharge and sense-amplifier circuitry (CMOS cross-coupled latch).
2. Initialize precharge equalization transistors to bias $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
3. Configure worst-case aggressor-victim switching patterns:
   - **Aggressor lines**: Assert adjacent bitlines switching fully between $V_{\text{DD}}$ and $0\text{ V}$.
   - **Victim line**: Maintain target bitline sampling minute cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
4. Simulate wordline activation and access transistor turn-on across temperature corners up to $85^\circ\text{C}$.

### Step 4: Differential Sensing Margin & Soft-Error Noise Analysis
1. Measure differential voltage development $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}} / 2)$ prior to sense-amplifier latching.
2. Measure bitline-to-bitline capacitive coupling induced noise spike $\delta V_{\text{coupling}}$ on the victim bitline.
3. Verify that post-coupling residual margin allows stable latching of SAN/SAP without false flips or alpha-particle soft error vulnerability.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                       Baseline Target Parameters       
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░                                     │
Max Leakage (fA)┤░                                     │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
  Signal dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
       C_BL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     C_cell (fF)┤█████                                 │
                │█████                                 │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     62.5      125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (Minimum 25 to 30) | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE node capacitance integration |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | $\approx 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-reduction network sum analysis |
| **Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient readout evaluation at sense amp inputs |
| **Cell Leakage Current (Junction + Sub-threshold)** | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC bias leakage transient hold simulation |
| **Inter-Bitline Line & Wordline Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Layout back-annotation geometry check |

---

## 4. Context References
- *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*: Defined access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor budget ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$), soft-error noise immunity, and leakage target ($\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*: Prescribed $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ precharge, cell charge transfer $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$, bitline capacitance baseline ($C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$), and signal development ($\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$).
- *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*: Validated 1T1C stacked capacitor target range ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$), retention constraint ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), and bitline/wordline matrix pitch ($360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line

- **Document Reference**: [`docs/sop_high_k_gate_dielectric_thermal_oxidation.md`](docs/sop_high_k_gate_dielectric_thermal_oxidation.md)
- **Node & Architecture**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | Front-End Fabrication (FEOL)
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node
- **Action Type**: Make

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│    RCA Clean and    │
│   Pre-Gate HF Dip   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Dry O2 Thermal    │
│    Oxidation at     │
│      850C-900C      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  High-K Dielectric  │
│     Deposition      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Ellipsometry and   │
│ Breakdown Metrology │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Oxidation Cleaning & Native Oxide Removal**:
   - Perform Standard RCA-1 ($NH_4OH:H_2O_2:H_2O$) and RCA-2 ($HCl:H_2O_2:H_2O$) cleaning to strip organic and metallic surface contaminants from the $180\text{ nm}$ silicon substrate.
   - Dip in dilute HF ($1\% - 2\%$) for native oxide stripping to prepare a hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated interface; dry under $N_2$.
2. **Quartz Tube Furnace Idle & Ramp-Up**:
   - Idle horizontal quartz tube furnace at $650^\circ\text{C}$ under high-purity dry $N_2$ purge gas flow.
   - Load wafer boat into the central thermal flat zone; ramp furnace temperature at $\le 10^\circ\text{C/min}$ to the dry oxidation target range of **$850^\circ\text{C}$ to $900^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. **Deal-Grove Dry $O_2$ Thin Thermal Oxidation**:
   - Stabilize quartz furnace at **$850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$** ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Switch gas feed to dry $O_2$ ($\ge 99.999\%$ purity). Operate in the Deal-Grove linear reaction-rate-limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, $k_l = B/A$) to grow high-density $SiO_2$ gate oxide to a target physical thickness of **$3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$**.
   - Perform in-situ post-oxidation anneal under $N_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ for 10–15 min to passivate interface traps ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).
4. **Capacitor High-K Dielectric Integration**:
   - Transfer wafers to the thin film deposition chamber for capacitor dielectric formation.
   - Deposit $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ or ONO stack achieving effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of **$3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$**.
5. **Inline Metrology & Quality Gate**:
   - Measure gate oxide physical thickness via multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry.
   - Perform wafer-level C-V / I-V probe testing on monitor structures to evaluate dielectric breakdown field ($E_{bd}$), per-cell capacitance, and leakage.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  Dielectric Process Target Metrics     
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░░░░░                                    │
     EOT (nm)┤░░░░░                                    │
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒                                   │
Gate Tox (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                                   │
Cap/Cell (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 E_bd (MV/cm)┤███████████████                          │
             │███████████████                          │
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0         7        14        21        28 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oxidation Temperature Window** | `850 to 900` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-zone Quartz Tube Thermocouple Array ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Thermally Grown Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | `3.5 to 4.0` | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Capacitor Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `3.0 to 4.0` | $\text{nm}$ | High-Frequency C-V Parametric Probe |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | `> 10` | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Ramp-Voltage I-V Breakdown Meter |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance** | `25 to 30` (min `28`) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Parametric C-V Tester ($85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Sub-threshold / Junction Leakage Current** | `< 1` | $\text{fA/cell}$ ($85^\circ\text{C}$) | Low-Noise Picoammeter Wafer Probe |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Linear-parabolic rate kinetics ($x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$) governed by linear constant $k_l = B/A$ for thin films.
  - Dry oxidation temperature range ($900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ and $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$) in pure dry $O_2$.
  - Dielectric breakdown strength $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$, and gate dielectric thickness target $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Thermally grown $SiO_2$ gate oxide at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - Stacked capacitor dielectric ($Si_3N_4$ or $Ta_2O_5$) target EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage capacitor retention requirement: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - High-k dielectric stack ($Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ or ONO) delivering effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure: RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning

- **Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-002`
- **Revision:** 2.0
- **Process Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line [Front-End Fabrication]
- **Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     1. SC-1 Bath:      │
│  UPW-NH4OH-H2O2 5:1:1  │
│       at 70-75C        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    2. Cascade Dump     │
│  Rinse: 18.2 MOhm-cm   │
│          UPW           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    3. Native Oxide     │
│   Strip: 1:50 HF:UPW   │
│       for 15-30s       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    4. Intermediate     │
│       Rinse: UPW       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     5. SC-2 Bath:      │
│   UPW-HCl-H2O2 6:1:1   │
│       at 70-80C        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     6. Final QDR &     │
│   High-Purity N2 Dry   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Standard Clean 1 (SC-1 / RCA-1) Alkaline Organic Dissolution & Particle Removal**
   - **Bath Chemistry:** $5:\!1:\!1$ volume ratio of $\text{UPW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\,(29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\,(30\%)$ prepared in a quartz or PTFE immersion bath.
   - **Process Conditions:** Temperature controlled at $70^\circ\text{C}$ to $75^\circ\text{C}$ ($70^\circ\text{C}$–$80^\circ\text{C}$ operating range) with megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - **Immersion Time:** $10\text{ minutes}$ (up to $15\text{ minutes}$).
   - **Mechanism:** Solubilizes organic surface contamination by simultaneous oxidative dissolution and microscopic base etching of silicon ($\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$), removing sub-micron particles via zeta potential repulsion.

2. **Cascade Dump Rinse (Post-SC-1)**
   - **Rinse Chemistry:** $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW).
   - **Process Conditions:** $5\text{ cycles}$ cascade dump rinse (or dump rinse for $3\text{ minutes}$) until bath effluent resistivity exceeds $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

3. **Native Oxide Strip (Dilute HF Dip)**
   - **Bath Chemistry:** $1:50$ to $1:100\ \text{HF} : \text{UPW}$ ($0.5\%$ to $1.0\%$ hydrofluoric acid).
   - **Process Conditions:** Room temperature at $22^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **Immersion Time:** $15$ to $30\text{ seconds}$.
   - **Endpoint Transition:** Visual and in-line contact verification of hydrophobic dewetting transition (water sheets completely shed from silicon surface).

4. **Intermediate Deionized Water Rinse**
   - **Rinse Chemistry:** $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW.
   - **Process Conditions:** Dump rinse for $3\text{ minutes}$ to strip residual fluorides prior to the acidic oxidation bath.

5. **Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / RCA-2) Acidic Metallic Trace Stripping**
   - **Bath Chemistry:** $6:\!1:\!1$ volume ratio of $\text{UPW} : \text{HCl}\,(37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\,(30\%)$.
   - **Process Conditions:** Temperature controlled at $70^\circ\text{C}$ to $80^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **Immersion Time:** $10\text{ minutes}$.
   - **Mechanism:** Desorbs and solubilizes alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy trace metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) via soluble metal-chloride complexation.

6. **Final Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) and Wafer Drying**
   - **Rinse:** Final cascade QDR using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW until effluent resistivity reaches $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - **Drying:** High-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry / spin rinse dryer to ensure complete dehydration before furnace loading.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Technique |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rinse Water Effluent Resistivity** | $> 16$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line Bath Resistivity Probe |
| **Native Oxide Strip Immersion Window** | $15 \text{ to } 30$ | $\text{s}$ | Process Wet-Bench Automation Timer |
| **SC-1 Microscopic Base Etch Depth** | $\sim 0.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **SC-1 Bath Operating Temperature** | $70 \text{ to } 75$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated Quartz Bath Thermocouple |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source 1:** *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering* (Megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$, $5:\!1:\!1$ SC-1 at $70^\circ\text{C}$–$75^\circ\text{C}$, $\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$ microscopic Si etch, $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ rinse to $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, and $1:50$ to $1:100$ DHF dip for $15$–$30\text{ s}$ at $22^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source 2:** *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure* ($6:\!1:\!1$ SC-2 with $37\%\text{ HCl}$ and $30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^\circ\text{C}$–$80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$, $3\text{-minute}$ dump rinse, and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying).
- **Source 3:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Front-end context for $180\text{ nm}$ access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ gate oxidation conditioning).
