# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-RCA1-180NM`
**Title:** Chemical Bath Formulation and RCA-1 Organic/Particle Decontamination  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > RCA-1 Decontamination  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Mechanism
The RCA-1 / SC-1 (Standard Clean 1) sequence performs alkaline oxidative dissolution of organic surface contaminants and simultaneous microscopic controlled base etching of silicon (~0.5 nm). Sub-micron particles are dislodged and repelled via electrostatic zeta-potential manipulation under megasonic cavitation prior to high-temperature furnace growth.

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| RCA-1 Formulation: 5 UPW : 1 NH4OH (29%) : 1 H2O2 (30%)                           |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Heated Bath Immersion: 70°C to 75°C | 10 min | 1 MHz Megasonic Agitation          |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Quick Dump Rinse (QDR): 5 Cycles UPW (18.2 MΩ·cm) until Resistivity > 16 MΩ·cm    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Preparation**:
   - Verify wet bench exhaust velocity is nominal and secondary containment is active.
   - Don full acid/base chemical PPE (fluoropolymer apron, face shield, heavy-duty neoprene/nitrile sleeves and gloves).
   - Ensure the quartz or PTFE immersion tank and recirculating megasonic transducer (1 MHz) are clean and inspected.

2. **Chemical Bath Formulation (5:1:1 Volume Ratio)**:
   - Fill the quartz/PTFE bath with **5 parts** Ultra-Pure Water (UPW, 18.2 MΩ·cm).
   - Add **1 part** Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, 29% electronic grade).
   - Initiate bath heating to reach **70°C to 75°C** (process window: 70°C–80°C).
   - Once at temperature, add **1 part** Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30% unstabilized electronic grade) to avoid premature peroxide decomposition.
   - Allow solution to stabilize and equilibrate thermally.

3. **Wafer Immersion & Decontamination**:
   - Transfer wafer cassette into the RCA-1 tank using automated quartz/PTFE end-effector lifters.
   - Activate 1 MHz megasonic agitation.
   - Maintain wafer immersion for **10 minutes** (acceptable process window: 10 to 15 minutes) at **70°C to 75°C**.

4. **Cascade Dump Rinse (QDR)**:
   - Transfer cassette immediately to the cascade Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank to prevent chemical dry-in and salt precipitation.
   - Execute **5 dump-and-fill cycles** using UPW (18.2 MΩ·cm).
   - Continue overflow/cascade rinsing until bath effluent resistivity surpasses **16 MΩ·cm** (target 3-minute minimum rinse).
   - Advance cassette to dilute HF native oxide strip station.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Process Window | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Volumetric Bath Ratio** | 5 : 1 : 1 ($\text{UPW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Exact metered dispense | Automated wet bench dosing flowmeter |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | 72.5°C | 70°C to 75°C (Upper limit 80°C) | In-line PTFE-sheathed thermocouple / RTD |
| **Megasonic Agitation Frequency** | 1.0 MHz | ±0.05 MHz | Transducer generator output readout |
| **Process Immersion Time** | 10.0 min | 10 to 15 min | Automated recipe timer / cassette hoist |
| **Cascade Dump Rinse Resistivity** | > 16.0 MΩ·cm | Minimum threshold $\ge 16.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (supply 18.2 MΩ·cm) | In-line resistivity sensor on rinse effluent |
| **Microscopic Silicon Removal / Etch** | ~0.5 nm | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / weight-loss monitor wafer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **Source 1:** *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering*
  - Chemical ratio: 5 UPW : 1 $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ (29%) : 1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ (30%).
  - Process parameters: 70°C–75°C bath temperature, quartz/PTFE tank with 1 MHz megasonics, 10 min immersion, ~0.5 nm Si microscopic etch, 5-cycle QDR to > 16 MΩ·cm.
- **Source 2:** *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*
  - Process window: 70°C–80°C for 10–15 min; 3-minute intermediate dump rinse with 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW.

## RCA-1 Chemical Bath Metering and Reagent Preparation

**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) | Front-End Fabrication | Wet Chemistry  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Node / Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm)

---

### 1. Process Overview & Preparation Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │    │                       │
│   DI Water 5 Parts    │    │   NH4OH 29% 1 Part    │
│                       │    │                       │
└──────────┬────────────┘    └───────────┬───────────┘
           │                             │
           │ ╭───────────────────────────╯
           ▼ ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    RCA-1 Bath Tank    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Heat to 70C-80C    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Add H2O2 30% 1 Part  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Exothermic Reaction  │
│        Active         │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **PPE & Exhaust Verification**:
   - Verify wet bench laminar exhaust velocity and chemical-resistant face shield/acid aprons prior to dispensing.
2. **Deionized Water (DI H₂O) Charge**:
   - Meter and dispense **5 parts** by volume of high-purity Deionized Water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) into the PVDF/quartz RCA bath tank.
3. **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH₄OH) Metering & Addition**:
   - Meter and dispense **1 part** by volume of electronic-grade **Ammonium Hydroxide (29% $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$)** into the DI water.
   - Activate bath recirculating pump / nitrogen bubbler to ensure homogeneous mixing.
4. **Thermal Pre-Heating**:
   - Engage immersion heating elements and bring the $\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ solution to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
5. **Hydrogen Peroxide (H₂O₂) Addition**:
   - Once the target temperature range is achieved, meter and inject **1 part** by volume of **Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
   - *Note:* Do not pre-heat $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ beforehand; adding it at temperature initiates the controlled organic oxidation and light trace metal removal reaction.
6. **Submersion & Process Window**:
   - Maintain the chemical bath at **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$** throughout the **10 to 15 minute** wafer submersion sequence.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Volumetric Mixing Ratio** ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | `5 : 1 : 1` | $\pm 1\%$ by volume | In-line flow meters / calibrated dosing pumps |
| **Bath Process Temperature** | $75^\circ\text{C}$ | $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ | Fluoropolymer-jacketed RTD / thermocouple |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity cell |
| **Bath Residence / Process Time** | $12.5\text{ min}$ | $10 - 15\text{ min}$ | Wet bench automated recipe timer |

---

### 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **`Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure`**:
  - RCA-1 (SC-1) reagent ratio: 5 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide (29% $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - Thermal range: Heated to $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Processing duration: $10-15\text{ minutes}$.
  - Water quality specification: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - Contextual front-end gate dielectric pre-oxidation conditioning targeting dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ growth ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$) with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical gate oxide thickness.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-RCA1-MEGA-001`
**Title:** Megasonic-Assisted SC-1 Organic Stripping and Particle Desorption  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Megasonic-Assisted SC-1 Organic Stripping and Particle Desorption  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the operational protocol for formulating the RCA Standard Clean 1 (SC-1) bath and performing megasonic-assisted wafer cleaning to strip organic films and desorb particulate contamination from silicon wafers prior to pre-oxidation surface conditioning.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Bath Formulation & Chemical Sequencing:**
   - In a quartz or PVDF chemical wet bench bath, meter high-purity Deionized Water (DIW) with resistivity of $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - Add Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$) and Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) to achieve the volumetric ratio of:
     $$\text{DIW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 = 5 : 1 : 1$$
   - Ensure continuous recirculation and filtration.

2. **Thermal Stabilization:**
   - Engage the immersion bath inline heating system.
   - Heat the chemical mixture until the bath stabilizes within the target operating window of $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Megasonic Agitation & Wafer Immersion:**
   - Lower the wafer cassette containing silicon wafers into the heated SC-1 bath.
   - Activate the megasonic transducer array to supply acoustic cavitation/acoustic streaming for sub-micron particle desorption.
   - Process the wafers in the active SC-1 bath for $10 - 15\ \text{minutes}$.

4. **Intermediate Deionized Water (DIW) Dump Rinse:**
   - Transfer wafer cassette immediately into the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank to quench chemical action and prevent dry-out.
   - Perform dump rinse using $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water for $3\ \text{minutes}$.

5. **Transfer / Downstream Pre-conditioning:**
   - Transfer wafers to the downstream diluted HF oxide etch / RCA-2 module, or proceed to final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 Bath Volumetric Formulation Ratio** | $5 : 1 : 1\ (\text{DIW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\ [29\%] : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ [30\%])$ | Volumetric Ratio | Mass flow / volumetric dosing controller |
| **Chemical Bath Operating Temperature** | $70 - 80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Immersion thermocouple / RTD sensor |
| **SC-1 Immersion & Megasonic Exposure Time** | $10 - 15$ | $\text{minutes}$ | Automated wet bench recipe timer |
| **Intermediate Dump Rinse Duration & Water Quality** | $3$ min rinse at $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{minutes}$; $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity probe & rinse timer |

---

### 4. Context References & Source Citations
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical formulation: $5\ \text{parts}\ \text{DIW} : 1\ \text{part}\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\ (29\%) : 1\ \text{part}\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$.
  - Process temperature window: $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Process duration: $10 - 15\ \text{minutes}$.
  - Intermediate rinse parameters: $3\ \text{minutes}$ with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
citations: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Pre-Oxidation Particle Defect Density and Surface Roughness Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB180-WET-MET-004`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM, 1T1C COB Cell)  
**Process Stage:** RCA-1 Wet Clean / Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning $\rightarrow$ Gate Thermal Oxidation  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tool Operation & Metrology Quality Gate  

---

#### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-RCA1 Wafer     │
│         Infeed         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Automated Laser     │
│   Surface Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     AFM Topography     │
│       Profiling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Particle & Roughness  │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gate Oxidation Tube   │
│        Release         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Lot Infeed & FOUP Robotic Transfer**:
   - Transfer wafer cassettes directly from the RCA-1 dump-rinse/marangoni dry station into the metrology load-port under an ISO Class 1 mini-environment.
   - Start the maximum queue-time counter: wafers must enter the dry oxidation quartz tube furnace within $\le 120\text{ min}$ to avoid airborne organic recontamination or uncontrolled native oxide growth.

2. **Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanning**:
   - Load wafer onto the laser particle scanner chuck (e.g., Surfscan/KLA dark-field optical scatterometer).
   - Configure optical calibration recipes for bare/hydrogen-terminated single-crystal Si with an edge exclusion of $3.0\text{ mm}$.
   - Execute full-surface spiral scan detecting localized light scattering (LLS) down to the critical defect threshold corresponding to the access transistor gate length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Generate defect density maps and record defect coordinates binned at particle size $\ge 180\text{ nm}$.

3. **Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) Surface Roughness Profiling**:
   - Route sample monitor wafers automatically to the in-line AFM station.
   - Deploy non-contact/tapping mode tips to scan a $1.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 1.0\,\mu\text{m}$ area across 5 designated test sites (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Extract the root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$) and mean roughness ($R_a$) to ensure pristine pre-oxidation interface kinetics.

4. **Disposition & Furnace Gate Clearance**:
   - Cross-check measured particle counts and $R_q$ values against statistical process control (SPC) acceptance limits.
   - If acceptance criteria pass, clear the lot tag to proceed immediately into the dry oxidation quartz tube furnace at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to grow the physical $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate $\text{SiO}_2$.
   - If particle count or roughness violates control limits, flag the lot for rework through megasonic RCA cleaning.

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Queue Time to Furnace┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
     AFM Roughness Rq┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
 Defect Bin (≥180 nm)┤████                             │
                     │████                             │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      30      60      90     120 
```

| Metrology Parameter | Target Specification Limit | Tool / Detection Method | Unit | Rationale / Failure Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Defect Particle Density** | $\le 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ (Particle diameter $d \ge 180\text{ nm}$) | Dark-field Laser Surface Scanner | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Particles $> L$ ($180\text{ nm}$) bridge access transistor gates or disrupt 3.5 nm oxide continuity. |
| **Root-Mean-Square Surface Roughness ($R_q$)** | $\le 0.18\text{ nm}$ ($1\,\mu\text{m} \times 1\,\mu\text{m}$ field) | Tapping Mode In-Line AFM | $\text{nm}$ | Prevents localized high electric fields and degradation of gate oxide breakdown ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$). |
| **Queue-Time to Furnace Load** | $\le 120\text{ minutes}$ | Automated MES Timestamp Tracking | $\text{minutes}$ | Prevents uncontrolled interface trap density increase ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$). |
| **Gate Oxide Baseline Physical Thickness** *(Post-Ox Test)* | $3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ | In-Line Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | $\text{nm}$ | Complies with the 180 nm node 1T1C gate dielectric budget. |

---

#### 4. Context References & Verifications

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; particle detection bin calibrated to the minimum gate length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) to protect channel integrity and sub-threshold leakage requirements ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Governs the gate dielectric physical target of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation for the 1T1C 8F$^2$/6F$^2$ access transistor.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Directs interface preparation ensuring the linear-reaction regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) achieves breakdown fields $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ with pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-WET-180-002`
**Title:** Dilute HF Oxide Strip and RCA-2 Metallic Ionic Cleansing  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This procedure executes chemical oxide stripping via dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF) followed by Standard Clean 2 (RCA-2 / SC-2) acid-peroxide treatment. The objective is to remove chemical/native oxide films created during SC-1, strip trapped contaminant layers, and solubilize trace alkali metals ($Na^+$, $K^+$) and heavy transition metal ions ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$) prior to gate dielectric and thin-film thermal oxidation.

---

### 2. Required Chemistries & Equipment

- **DHF Strip Bath:** 1:50 or 1:100 Hydrofluoric Acid ($49\%\ \text{HF}$) : Ultra-Pure Water ($\text{UPW}$) (Concentration: $0.5\%\text{--}1.0\%\ \text{HF}$ by volume). Bath vessel: PVDF / PTFE.
- **RCA-2 (SC-2) Bath:** $6:1:1$ volume ratio of $\text{UPW} : 37\%\ \text{HCl} : 30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$. Bath vessel: Quartz or PTFE with recirculating chemical heater.
- **Rinse Infrastructure:** Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) and Cascade Overflow Rinse tanks supplied with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water / UPW.
- **Drying System:** Surface-tension gradient dryer (Marangoni) or filtered high-purity dry $N_2$ blow-dryer / spin-rinse dryer.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
[Post-SC-1 Hydrophilic Wafer]
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 1: Dilute HF (DHF) Oxide Strip          │
│ • Chemistry: 1:50 to 1:100 HF:UPW (0.5%–1.0%)│
│ • Temperature: 22°C                          │
│ • Duration: 15–30 seconds                    │
│ • Endpoint: Hydrophobic dewetting transition │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 2: Intermediate DI Water Dump Rinse     │
│ • DI Water Resistivity: 18.2 MΩ·cm           │
│ • Cycles: 5 dump cycles / 3 minutes          │
│ • Target: Complete acid clearance            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 3: RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Cleansing      │
│ • Chemistry: 6 UPW : 1 HCl (37%) : 1 H2O2 (30%)│
│ • Temperature: 70°C–80°C                     │
│ • Immersion Time: 10 minutes                 │
│ • Target: Alkali (Na+, K+) & heavy metal strip│
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 4: Final Cascade Rinse & Resistivity Cut│
│ • DI Water: 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW                   │
│ • Resistivity Endpoint: > 16 MΩ·cm           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 5: High-Purity N2 Blow-Dry              │
│ • Medium: High-purity filtered N2 gas        │
│ • Target: Zero residual water spotting       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

#### Step 1: Dilute Hydrofluoric (DHF) Native Oxide Strip
1. Transfer wafer cassettes directly from the post-SC-1 intermediate rinse tank into the ambient DHF immersion bath.
2. Maintain bath chemistry at **1:50 to 1:100 $\text{HF}:\text{UPW}$** ($0.5\%\text{--}1.0\%\ \text{HF}$) at an operating temperature of **$22^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. Immerse wafers for **$15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$**.
4. Monitor endpoint via surface transition: the wafer surface changes from hydrophilic to completely hydrophobic (liquid sheets off cleanly with zero wetting).

#### Step 2: Intermediate Deionized Water Dump Rinse
1. Immediately transfer cassette from DHF bath to Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) within $< 5\text{ seconds}$ to prevent air exposure staining.
2. Execute dump rinse using **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** deionized water for **$3\text{ minutes}$** (or $5$ dump cycles) to quench fluoride residue.

#### Step 3: RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Ionic Cleansing
1. Submerge cassette into the heated RCA-2 chemical bath containing **$6\text{ parts UPW} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\ \text{HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$**.
2. Maintain bath temperature steadily at **$70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }80^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. Process wafers for an immersion period of **$10\text{ minutes}$** to complex and dissolve alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).

#### Step 4: Final Cascade Overflow Rinse
1. Transfer cassette to final cascade overflow rinse tank supplied with continuous $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW.
2. Continue flushing until the downstream bath effluent reaches an electrical resistivity of **$> 16\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.

#### Step 5: Wafer Drying
1. Transfer wafers immediately to the drying module.
2. Perform spin-rinse drying or blow-drying utilizing high-purity filtered **$\text{N}_2$ gas** until wafer surfaces are completely dry and free of water spots.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Inspection Method | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DHF Strip Endpoint Wettability** | Optical Contact Angle / In-line Vision | Surface hydrophobic transition (dewetting) | Non-wetting ($\theta > 70^\circ$) |
| **RCA-2 Bath Process Temperature** | In-situ RTD / Thermocouple probe | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **RCA-2 Immersion Duration** | Automated Wet Bench Robot Timer | $10.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{minutes}$ |
| **Final Rinse Effluent Resistivity** | In-line Resistivity Sensor | $> 16.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

### 5. Literature References
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - HF dip ratio (1:50 HF:$\text{H}_2\text{O}$), exposure window ($15\text{--}30\text{ s}$), and hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic surface transition.
  - RCA-2 composition ($6\ \text{UPW} : 1\ \text{HCl}\ (37\%) : 1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$), process temperature ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$), immersion duration ($10\text{ minutes}$), and $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**
  - DHF concentration parameters ($1:50\text{ to }1:100\ \text{HF}:\text{UPW}$ / $0.5\%\text{--}1.0\%$), temperature ($22^\circ\text{C}$), and dewetting endpoint verification.
  - Cascade rinse specification with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW and effluent cut-off threshold ($> 16\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Contextual gate and pre-dielectric purity constraint for 180nm access transistors ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Preparation and Formulation of 50:1 DHF and SC-2 Chemical Baths

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-RCA-002`  
**Process Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line (180nm Open-Source DRAM)  
**Classification:** Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   1. Dispense 18.2   │
│   MOhm-cm DI Water   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  2. Formulate 50:1   │
│       DHF Bath       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  3. Formulate SC-2   │
│  6:1:1 DIW:HCl:H2O2  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   4. Heat SC-2 to    │
│       70C-80C        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    5. QA Check &     │
│  Acceptance Signoff  │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Pre-Check**
   - Verify acid wet bench exhaust velocity and secondary containment status. Ensure PVDF/PTFE tanks are clean and free of particulate residue.
   - Verify supply of electronic-grade reagents: 18.2 MΩ·cm Deionized Water (DIW), 49% Hydrofluoric Acid ($\text{HF}$), 37% Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$), and 30% Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).

2. **50:1 Dilute Hydrofluoric Acid (DHF) Bath Formulation**
   - In a PVDF/PTFE tank, dispense **50 parts** deionized water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Meter and blend **1 part** Hydrofluoric Acid ($\text{HF}$, 49% electronic grade) into the DIW. *Always add acid to water.*
   - Maintain ambient chemical bath temperature ($20^\circ\text{C} - 25^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Ensure the bath is primed for stripping native oxide (15–30 seconds immersion) until surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.

3. **SC-2 (RCA-2) Chemical Bath Formulation**
   - In a quartz immersion tank equipped with an inline fluoropolymer circulation heater, dispense **6 parts** deionized water (18.2 MΩ·cm).
   - Carefully introduce **1 part** Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$, 37% electronic grade) into the DI water while recirculating.
   - Introduce **1 part** Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30% semiconductor grade) to establish the volumetric ratio of **$6:1:1$ ($\text{DIW} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.

4. **SC-2 Bath Heating & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Energize the immersion tank heater with continuous recirculation.
   - Ramp and stabilize bath operating temperature within the range of **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Maintain temperature stability for metallic ionic desorption ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+, \text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) across a 10-minute cycle target.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\ge 18.2$ | Inline resistivity sensor at supply manifold | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **DHF Volumetric Mixing Ratio** | `50:1` | $50:1 \pm 0.5$ ($\text{DIW}:\text{HF}$) | Automated wet bench liquid mass/volumetric dosing flowmeters | Volume Ratio (parts) |
| **SC-2 Volumetric Mixing Ratio** | `6:1:1` | $6:1:1 \pm 0.1$ ($\text{DIW}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Automated wet bench chemical delivery metering pumps | Volume Ratio (parts) |
| **SC-2 Bath Operating Temperature** | `75.0` | $70.0 - 80.0$ | Dual-sheathed PFA thermocouple immersed in bath | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Verified Context Literature Citations

- **`Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure`**:
  - *DHF Formulation & Native Oxide Strip*: 1:50 HF:H2O dip for 15–30 seconds; transitions silicon surface from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
  - *RCA-2 (SC-2) Formulation*: 6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - *SC-2 Bath Thermal Envelope*: Temperature heated to $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes to eliminate alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
  - *Rinse Specification*: Dump rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes before nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Sequential Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch and SC-2 Metallic Decontamination

**Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line [Front-End Fabrication]  
**Sub-Process:** RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Classification:** Gen 2 (µm) / Action Type: Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Dilute HF Dip 1:50   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dump Rinse 18.2     │
│        MOhm-cm         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   SC-2 Clean 70-80C    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Final Rinse & N2 Dry  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Readiness:**
   - Verify active bench exhaust and ensure calcium gluconate gel is stocked and immediately accessible at the wet station.
2. **Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip:**
   - Prepare a **1:50 HF:H₂O** dilute bath.
   - Immerse wafer lot for **15 to 30 seconds** at ambient temperature to strip native oxide until the silicon surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic (complete de-wetting / water beading).
3. **Intermediate Deionized Water Rinse:**
   - Transfer wafers immediately into an automated dump rinser.
   - Rinse with high-purity **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized water for **3 minutes** to halt chemical action and purge trace fluoride.
4. **SC-2 (RCA-2) Metallic Ionic Cleansing:**
   - Prepare the SC-2 bath with volumetric ratio **6 parts DI H₂O : 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H₂O₂**.
   - Heat and stabilize the bath at **70°C – 80°C**.
   - Submerge wafer cassette for **10 minutes** to eliminate alkali contaminants ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and dissolve heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).
5. **Final Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) & Drying:**
   - Cascade rinse in **18.2 MΩ·cm** DI water until overflow resistivity recovers.
   - Perform spin-rinse dry / dry wafer surfaces completely using high-purity filtered **Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry**.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dilute HF Bath Concentration** | `1:50` ($\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) | Volumetric ratio | Refractometer / Automated Chemical Dosing Controller |
| **HF Strip Immersion Duration** | `15 – 30` | Seconds ($\text{s}$) | Wet Bench Recipe Timer Controller |
| **Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line Resistivity Sensor |
| **SC-2 Bath Temperature** | `70 – 80` | Degrees Celsius ($^\circ\text{C}$) | Calibrated Immersion Thermocouple / PID Controller |
| **SC-2 Process Duration** | `10` | Minutes ($\text{min}$) | Automated Station Recipe Timer |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:** Chemical ratios (1:50 HF:H₂O dip; 6:1:1 DI H₂O:37% HCl:30% H₂O₂ SC-2), step durations (15–30 s HF dip, 3 min dump rinse, 10 min SC-2), temperature target (70°C–80°C for SC-2), resistivity specification (18.2 MΩ·cm), target contaminants (alkali ions $\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$, and heavy metals $\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$), and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying.
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):** Safety protocol requiring calcium gluconate gel presence at the wet station due to HF calcium-binding hazard.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Post-Clean Hydrophobicity Contact Angle and TXRF Metallic Residue Metrology  
**Module:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line | Metrology  
**Node / Technology:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Inline Automated Inspection System)

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the metrology verification protocol following Dilute HF oxide strip and RCA-2 metallic cleansing. It qualifies the bare silicon substrate prior to 850°C–1000°C gate oxidation (3.5–4.0 nm physical thickness target) by quantifying surface hydrogen termination (hydrophobicity via deionized water contact angle goniometry) and residual transition metal ionic contamination (via Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence, TXRF).

---

### 2. Metrology Workflow & Execution Steps

```text
+-----------------------+     +--------------------------+     +------------------------+
| Wafer Transfer & Load | --> | Sessile Drop Contact     | --> | Glancing-Angle TXRF    |
| (FOUP -> Metrology)   |     | Angle Goniometry (DI H2O)|     | Trace Metallic Scan    |
+-----------------------+     +--------------------------+     +------------------------+
                                                                            |
                                                                            v
                                                               +------------------------+
                                                               | Inline Disposition     |
                                                               | (Pass -> Gate Furnace) |
                                                               +------------------------+
```

1. **Automated Wafer Handling & Alignment:**
   - Transfer wafer from pre-clean wet bench cassette/FOUP into class-1 mini-environment metrology station under clean dry air (CDA) or $\text{N}_2$ purge.
   - Perform optical notch alignment.

2. **Automated Sessile Drop Contact Angle Goniometry:**
   - Dispense an ultra-pure deionized (DI) water micro-droplet ($1.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$, resistivity $> 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) onto the wafer surface at 5 standard radial test sites (Center, North, South, East, West at 5 mm edge exclusion).
   - Capture droplet profile within 5 seconds using automated high-resolution CCD goniometer camera to prevent ambient evaporation or surface re-oxidation.
   - Fit tangent angle across three-phase boundary to calculate static contact angle $\theta_c$. Hydrophobic H-terminated bare Si confirms successful complete oxide strip without native oxide repassivation.

3. **TXRF Metallic Residue Spectroscopy:**
   - Load wafer onto TXRF high-precision goniometer stage under high vacuum ($< 10^{-4}\ \text{Pa}$).
   - Direct incident monochromatic Mo-$K_\alpha$ or W-$L_\beta$ X-ray beam at grazing incidence angle below the critical angle of total external reflection ($\phi_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.18^\circ$ for Si).
   - Acquire energy-dispersive X-ray spectra across 3 to 9 site map points covering active channel array areas ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ layout footprint regions).
   - Integrate characteristic fluorescent peaks for iron ($\text{Fe}$), copper ($\text{Cu}$), and nickel ($\text{Ni}$).

4. **Surface Stability & Queue-Time Disposition:**
   - Validate post-clean surface queue time ($Q\text{-time} < 2\ \text{hours}$) to prevent native oxide regrowth before loading into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation quartz tube furnace.
   - Record metrology telemetry into factory MES; generate lot pass/fail flag.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Tool / Technique | Target Spec / Threshold | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** | Automated Optical Goniometer | $> 70^\circ$ (Hydrophobic H-terminated surface) | Degrees ($^\circ$) |
| **Surface Metallic Residues ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni}$)** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) | $< 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ |
| **Sub-surface Residual Native Oxide** | Multi-wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | $< 0.2$ (pre-thermal gate oxide growth) | nm |
| **Max Pre-Furnace Queue Time** | Automated Factory MES Timer | $\le 120$ | Minutes |

*Subsequent process target correlation: Prepares channel for gate oxide target of 3.5 to 4.0 nm with $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$ and $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$.*

---

### 4. Literature References & Citations

- **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace]:**
  - Confirms gate dielectric physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\ \text{nm}$ grown in dry $\text{O}_2$ at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ to achieve breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$ (which requires strict metallic-free and oxide-free initial interfaces).
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**
  - Defines the access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), emphasizing leakage current constraints ($< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at 85°C) sensitive to transition-metal precipitates and gate interface states.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**
  - Specifies thermal gate oxide processing conditions ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation, $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness) and overall 1T1C retention time limits ($> 64\ \text{ms}$ at 85°C).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document:** [docs/sop_surface_hydrophobicity_particle_metrology.md](docs/sop_surface_hydrophobicity_particle_metrology.md)  
**Task Title:** Surface Hydrophobicity and Post-Clean Particle Defect Metrology  
**Module:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line / RCA Wet Clean Surface Conditioning  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Pre-Clean HF Dip /   │
│   SC-1 / SC-2 Rinse    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│    Angle Goniometry    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     Hydrophobicity     │
│   Check: θ > 75 deg    │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮ [Fail: Residual Oxide / Low θ]
        Pass │                              ▼
             │                 ┌────────────────────────┐
             │                 │  Rework: Native Oxide  │
             │                 │   Re-etch / Surface    │
             │                 │         Strip          │
             ▼                 └────────────────────────┘
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Laser Surface      │
│  Particle Scanning /   │
│     DLS Metrology      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│   LPD Particle Count   │
│    <= 10 at 0.18 um    │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮ [Fail: Particle Contamination]
        Pass │                              ▼
             │                 ┌────────────────────────┐
             │                 │  Megasonic DIW Rinse   │
             │                 │       & Re-scan        │
             ▼                 └────────────────────────┘
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Release to 850-900°C  │
│   Dry Gate Oxidation   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Environmental & Transfer Controls**:
   - Unload 200 mm production wafers from final RCA clean drying module (spin-rinse dry / Marangoni) in Class 1 cleanroom environment.
   - Enforce maximum queue time limit of $\le 4\text{ hours}$ between final dilute HF etch rinse and furnace load to eliminate native oxide regrowth prior to thermal oxidation.
2. **Sessile Drop Contact Angle Goniometry**:
   - Position wafer on an automated optical contact angle goniometer.
   - Dispense a calibrated $1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ droplet of ultra-pure deionized water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) at 5 standard radial sites (Center, North, South, East, West with $5\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
   - Compute Young-Laplace contact angle ($\theta$). Pass condition is $\theta \ge 75^\circ$ confirming uniform hydrogen termination (Si-H) and removal of hydrophilic native oxides.
3. **Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanning**:
   - Load wafer into the automated laser surface scanning inspection system (calibrated with NIST-traceable polystyrene latex spheres).
   - Execute full-surface defect map capturing Light Point Defects (LPD) at the critical 180nm channel pitch threshold ($\ge 180\text{ nm} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Verify defect density and check for localized particulate micro-clusters.
4. **Cleanliness Verification & Furnace Loading**:
   - Verify all acceptance metrics below. Upon passing, load wafers into $\text{N}_2$-purged pods for dry gate oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to grow target $3.5\text{ nm}-4.0\text{ nm}$ gate dielectric.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
Acceptance Criteria Target Thresholds
                          ┌────────────────────────────┐
                          │░░░░░                       │
Defect Density (cts/wafer)┤░░░░░                       │
                          │▒▒▒▒▒                       │
   Breakdown Field (MV/cm)┤▒▒▒▒▒                       │
        Ox Target EOT (nm)┤▓▓                          │
                          │▓▓                          │
       Contact Angle (deg)┤████████████████████████████│
                          │████████████████████████████│
                          └┬──────┬──────┬─────┬──────┬┘
                          0.0   18.8   37.5  56.2  75.0 
```

1. **Water Contact Angle ($\theta$)**: $\ge 75.0^\circ$ (via sessile drop goniometry, ensuring complete Si-H passivation).
2. **Critical Particle Count ($d \ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$)**: $\le 10\text{ counts/wafer}$ on 200 mm substrates (matching transistor feature size $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
3. **Residual Native Oxide Thickness**: $< 0.3\text{ nm}$ equivalent thickness prior to loading into dry oxidation furnace.
4. **Dielectric Breakdown Voltage Target**: $E_{\text{bd}} > 10.0\text{ MV/cm}$ (reflecting minimal interface trap density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ after $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry gate oxidation).

---

### Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Defines access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and sub-threshold leakage limit $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Dictates gate dielectric thermally grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Establishes high-breakdown dry oxidation standards yielding $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, interface trap density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$, and target gate dielectric thickness range of $3.5\text{ nm}-4.0\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Goniometer Water Droplet Contact Angle Hydrophobicity Verification

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-042`  
**Level:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Process Area:** [Front-End Fabrication] > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Surface Hydrophobicity and Post-Clean Particle Defect Metrology  
**Metrology Equipment:** Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer / Tensiometer  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Placement on   │
│    Goniometer Stage    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Automated Sessile DI  │
│   Water Dispense 2-3   │
│           uL           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Optical Baseline    │
│      Detection &       │
│     Young-Laplace      │
│        Fitting         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Multi-Point Radial   │
│  Mapping & Pass/Fail   │
│       Evaluation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Initialization & Baseline Calibration**:
   - Verify instrument optics, clean backlight illumination, and automated microliter syringe integrity.
   - Purge syringe dispensing lines with cleanroom ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Calibrate optical magnification scale using a certified calibration ball standard prior to wafer loading.

2. **Substrate Handling & Stage Vacuum Clamping**:
   - Transfer incoming pre-oxidation or primed silicon wafer (100 mm format) onto the motorized goniometer vacuum chuck using automated edge-grip end-effectors.
   - Activate stage vacuum holding pressure to ensure zero substrate vibration or tilt.

3. **Micro-Droplet Dispensing (Sessile Drop Method)**:
   - Position the micro-syringe tip 1.0 mm directly above the inspection coordinates (radial 5-point map: Center, North, South, East, West with edge exclusion $\ge 5\text{ mm}$).
   - Automatically dispense a precise sessile droplet volume of **2 to 3 µL** (following standard dynamic dispense micro-volumes) onto the wafer surface.
   - Retract syringe needle immediately to avoid meniscus distortion.

4. **Image Acquisition & Drop Profile Fitting**:
   - Capture high-resolution drop shadowgraph images within 2 to 5 seconds of droplet placement to prevent evaporation artifacts.
   - Apply automated edge-detection algorithms to define the liquid-solid baseline and extract droplet profile.
   - Calculate static contact angle ($\theta$) via Young-Laplace or circle/tangent fitting on both left and right flanks; log the average angle.

5. **Post-Measurement Purge**:
   - Aspirate or nitrogen-blow droplets with filtered clean dry air (CDA) or transfer wafer to subsequent dry station/strip line.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Criteria | Verification Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dispensed Droplet Volume** | $2.5\text{ \mu L}$ | $2\text{ \mu L}$ to $3\text{ \mu L}$ | Calibrated Automated Syringe Dispenser |
| **Wafer Dimension / Substrate Format** | $100\text{ mm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ mm}$ (Standard SEMI Spec) | Optical Stage Micrometer / End-Effector |
| **Film Uniformity Target (Verification Anchor)** | $1.30\text{ \mu m}$ | $\pm 15\text{ nm}$ ($1285\text{ nm} - 1315\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Reflectometer / Ellipsometer |
| **Hydrophobic Pass Surface State** | Silanized Surface ($-\text{Si-O-Si(CH}_3)_3$) | $\ge 70^\circ$ (Hydrophobic / Silylated condition) | Young-Laplace Optical Goniometer |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Droplet Dispense Volume & Substrate Geometry**:
  > *"Spin Recipe: Dispense 2-3 mL Shipley 1813... Film Uniformity: Produces 1.30 um ± 15 nm film across 100mm wafers."*  
  *(Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming)*
- **Surface Silylation & Hydrophobicity Mechanism**:
  > *"Wafer Dehydration: Silicon wafers must be baked at 150°C-200°C for 30 minutes to desorb physisorbed water molecules. HMDS Priming: Hexamethyldisilazane vapor reactively silylates hydrophilic silanol (-Si-OH) groups into hydrophobic methyl-siloxane (-Si-O-Si(CH3)3) bonds, increasing resist adhesion and preventing peel-off during acid wet etching."*  
  *(Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming)*
- **Device & Integration Compatibility**:
  > *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm... Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*  
  *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology & Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture)*

```text
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│  Verification & Clean  │
│        Release         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Initialization & Optics Self-Check:**
   - Verify solid-state scanning laser beam alignment, photomultiplier tube (PMT) / collector optics sensitivity, and background noise level in Class 1 cleanroom environment.
2. **Scanner Size & Sensitivity Calibration:**
   - Load a certified calibration standard wafer deposited with monodisperse Polystyrene Latex (PSL) reference spheres calibrated to the critical feature dimensions of the 180nm generation.
   - Run baseline calibration scan to adjust dark-field scatter collection gain, ensuring size binning accuracy down to sub-180nm defect detection thresholds.
3. **Wafer Loading & Automated Pre-Alignment:**
   - Transfer RCA-cleaned and dried wafer onto the vacuum chuck via robotic end-effector.
   - Perform optical notch/flat recognition to establish $(r, \theta)$ polar origin aligned to the crystallographic axis prior to rotation.
4. **Spiral Laser Surface Scanning:**
   - Spin chuck at calibrated angular velocity while translating laser beam radially from wafer center to edge exclusion boundary (3 mm from edge).
   - Collect scattered light signal; convert scatter intensity into equivalent Latex Sphere Equivalent (LSE) diameter.
5. **Defect Co-ordinate Mapping & Wafer Map Generation:**
   - Record spatial coordinates $(x, y)$ of all particle events into standard Klarf/defect map file format.
   - Superimpose 9-point or 49-point grid overlay to correlate radial particle distribution with thermal oxidation tube zones.
6. **Pass/Fail Disposition & Cassette Unload:**
   - Evaluate defect counts and killer defect clustering against pre-oxidation limits; release compliant lots directly to the dry oxidation furnace line.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Defect Detection Sensitivity** | $\le 0.18$ ($\le 180$) | $\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{nm}$) | Certified PSL sphere scatter calibration (scaled to $L = 180\text{ nm}$ gate length) |
| **Pre-Oxidation Particle Density Threshold** | $< 0.05$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Full wafer dark-field laser surface scan |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Mapping Grid** | $9\text{-point}$ or $49\text{-point}$ | $\text{points/wafer}$ | Automated radial sampling pattern |
| **Critical Gate Dielectric Defect Tolerance** | $0$ killer defects ($> 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$) within transistor active area ($L=180\text{ nm}, W=220\text{ nm}$) | $\text{count}$ | Spatial defect map overlay on active transistor array |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
   - *Wafer Mapping Protocol:* Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film and surface non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
   - *Target Thickness Protection:* Applied directly before growing dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) to protect sub-Angstrom gate integrity.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - *Unit Cell Geometry Constraints:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; scanner particle bins are calibrated to prevent fatal gate shorts and bridging across shared bitline contacts.
3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - *Pre-Oxidation Cleanliness Requirement:* Cleanliness baseline ensures high-k and thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectrics withstand target dielectric specifications ($3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$) without junction leakage degrading cell retention ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document Code:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-MET-007`  
**Title:** Post-RCA Surface Defect Density and Passivation Review Protocol  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line [Front-End Fabrication] > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning [Wet Chemistry] > Surface Hydrophobicity and Post-Clean Particle Defect Metrology [Metrology] > Post-RCA Surface Defect Density and Passivation Review Protocol [Metrology]  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Turnkey / Commercial In-line Metrology Protocol)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Cassette Transfer to  │
│     Review Station     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘

│     Laser Particle     │
│       Inspection       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Passivation and     │
│    Oxide Assessment    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Contact Angle      │
│  Hydrophobicity Test   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sign-Off to Thermal   │
│    Oxidation Queue     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Transfer & Environmental Verification:**
   - Unload the dry wafer lot from the RCA clean/spin-rinse-dry (SRD) module under ISO Class 1 mini-environment cleanroom hoods.
   - Stage wafers on automated robotic handling chucks within the automated laser surface inspection system (LSIS) within $\le 15\text{ min}$ of post-clean drying to minimize airborne organic recontamination.

2. **Unpatterned Surface Particle Scanning:**
   - Initialize unpatterned wafer surface defect scan with dark-field laser scattering across active device areas (calibrated for channel geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Log particle counts, coordinates, and spatial density across the wafer surface. If killer defect density exceeds threshold, hold the lot for re-clean before pre-oxidation queuing.

3. **Chemical Passivation & Native Oxide Thickness Metrology:**
   - Transfer wafer to multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE).
   - Measure chemical oxide / native passivation thickness at 9 representative radial points. The pre-oxidation conditioning layer must not exceed residual bounds that would disrupt the 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm thermal gate oxidation growth target ($x_0^2 + A \cdot x_0 = B(t + \tau)$).

4. **Surface Hydrophobicity / Passivation State Verification:**
   - Perform automated sessile drop contact angle metrology using high-purity deionized water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) on monitor wafers:
     - For **HF-last / H-passivated surfaces**: Contact angle must verify complete dewetting/hydrophobicity.
     - For **Standard RCA SC2 chemical oxide termination**: Contact angle must verify uniform hydrophilic wetting across all 9 review points.

5. **Lot Disposition & Queue Sign-Off:**
   - Record metrology telemetry into the MES system.
   - Gate oxide pre-clean clearance is approved for transfer into the high-temperature quartz tube furnace operating at 850°C–900°C / 900°C–1000°C dry $\text{O}_2$.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pre-Clean Particle Defect Gate** | $\le 0.05$ defects/cm$^2$ ($\ge 180\text{ nm}$ bin size) | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Automated Dark-Field Laser Surface Inspection System |
| **Residual Passivation / Chemical Oxide Thickness** | $\le 0.8\text{ nm}$ (Pre-gate budget for $3.5\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ target) | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-Wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Substrate Surface Interface State Budget Readiness** | Target $D_{it} < 10^{10}$ post-oxidation interface compatibility | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | In-line C-V / Surface Charge Profiling Monitor |
| **Thermal Pre-Oxidation Furnace Queue Expiry Window** | $\le 120$ | $\text{minutes}$ | MES Automated Lot-Tracking Timestamp Log |

---

### 3. Context Literature Citations

- **`Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace`**:
  - Validates pre-oxidation clean criticality where dry oxidation at $900^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$ produces dense gate dielectric with breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ for the $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ gate oxide target ($x_0^2 + A \cdot x_0 = B(t + \tau)$).
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - Governs gate dielectric target thickness of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, and cell pitch requirements ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - Dictates active transistor inspection geometry with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, requiring minimal contamination to preserve junction and sub-threshold leakage below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** SOP-FEOL-180NM-THOX-ALD-001  
**Title:** Dry Thermal Oxidation & High-K ALD Deposition Recipe Execution  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 / DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Station:** Front-End Thermal Quartz Furnace & Thin Film ALD Cluster  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Native Oxide Strip**
   - Perform standard clean (RCA SC-1 / SC-2) on incoming 180nm silicon wafers followed by a dilute HF dip (0.5% DHF for 60 s) to eliminate native oxide and chemical contaminants. Rinse with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water until resistivity $> 18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ and spin-rinse dry under ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$.
   - Transfer wafers to the furnace load station within 15 minutes of HF dip to prevent native oxide regrowth ($x_0 < 1\text{ nm}$).

2. **Furnace Loading & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Push wafer quartz boat into horizontal/vertical quartz tube furnace under a protective inert $\text{N}_2$ purge ($> 99.9999\%$ purity) at idle push temperature of $600^\circ\text{C}$ to avoid thermal shock.
   - Ramp furnace temperature up to the oxidation setpoint: **$850^\circ\text{C}$ to $900^\circ\text{C}$** at a controlled ramp rate of $5^\circ\text{C/min}$. Allow 10 minutes for chamber thermal stabilization.

3. **Dry Thermal Gate Oxidation Execution**
   - Switch furnace ambient gas from inert $\text{N}_2$ to **pure dry $\text{O}_2$** at atmospheric pressure.
   - Maintain dry oxidation at **$850^\circ\text{C}$ – $900^\circ\text{C}$** in the linear-parabolic reaction-limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, $k_l = B/A$) until the target physical $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness of **$3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$** is reached.
   - Upon completion, immediately switch process gas back to dry $\text{N}_2$ for a 15-minute post-oxidation anneal (POA) at temperature to eliminate dangling bonds and minimize interface traps.
   - Ramp down furnace temperature to $600^\circ\text{C}$ at $-3^\circ\text{C/min}$ and pull the quartz boat.

4. **High-K Dielectric ALD Deposition (Capacitor Dielectric Stack)**
   - Transfer wafers under dry $\text{N}_2$ atmosphere into the High-K Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) chamber.
   - Execute alternating precursor pulse/purge cycles to deposit the **$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$** high-k dielectric stack (or ONO triple dielectric) directly onto the crown/cylinder storage capacitor nodes.
   - Regulate recipe cycles to achieve an Equivalent Oxide Thickness (**EOT**) of **$3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$** and an effective dielectric constant **$\kappa > 15$**.

5. **In-Line Metrology & Process Disposition**
   - Transfer wafers to metrology cluster for spectroscopic ellipsometry (thickness/uniformity) and mercury-probe / test-pad C-V & I-V characterization.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Inspection Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | **3.5 to 4.0** | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | **3.0 to 4.0** | $\le 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) Metrology |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | **$> 15$** | Min. $15.0$ | dimensionless | Extraction from $C$-$V$ Accumulation |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | **$> 10$** | Min. $10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Ramp Voltage Stress ($I$-$V$ Breakdown) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | **$< 1 \times 10^{10}$** | Max. $1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Frequency Conductance Method |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - *Dry Oxidation Parameters & Performance*: 900°C–1000°C in pure dry $\text{O}_2$, interface reaction-rate limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, $k_l = B/A$).
  - *Gate Oxide Metrics*: Breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$, physical gate dielectric thickness target $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Thermal Oxidation Recipe Setpoint*: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation targeting $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *Capacitor High-K Stack*: Stacked capacitors utilizing $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ high-k dielectrics with Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *High-K Dielectric Material & Constant*: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack or ONO triple dielectric providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Passivation

**Module:** Front-End Fabrication / Wet Chemistry & Surface Preparation  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Access Transistor Channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)  
**Subsequent Operation:** Dry Thermal Oxidation ($3.5\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ gate $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$)

---

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Piranha SPM Clean  │
│  (Organic Stripping)│
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Standard Clean 1   │
│  (SC-1 / APM Bath)  │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Intermediate DHF   │
│  (Oxide Deglaze)    │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Standard Clean 2   │
│  (SC-2 / HPM Bath)  │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Final DHF Dip &   │
│  Si-H Passivation   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Marangoni / IPA   │
│      Vapor Dry      │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Clean Bulk Organic Strip (SPM / Piranha Clean):**
   - Immerse wafers in $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ ($4:1$ volume ratio) at $110^\circ\text{C} - 120^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$.
   - Overflow Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) with ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) for $5\text{ min}$.

2. **Standard Clean 1 (SC-1 / APM - Particle & Organic Removal):**
   - Process wafers in $\text{NH}_4\text{OH} (29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 (30\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($1:1:5$ by volume) at $70^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$ with megasonic agitation ($1.0\text{ MHz}$).
   - Cascade dump rinse with ultra-pure DIW until effluent resistivity exceeds $18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

3. **Intermediate Native Oxide Strip (DHF Deglaze):**
   - Dip wafers in dilute hydrofluoric acid $\text{HF} : \text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($1:50$ or $1:100$, $\sim 0.5\% - 1.0\%\text{ HF}$) at $22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ for $60 - 90\text{ s}$ to strip chemical oxide and trapped contaminants.
   - Quick dump rinse (QDR) in deoxygenated DIW for $3\text{ min}$.

4. **Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / HPM - Metallic Contamination Extraction):**
   - Immerse wafers in $\text{HCl} (37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 (30\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($1:1:6$ by volume) at $75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$ to desorb and complex alkali ions and heavy metal impurities ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
   - Cascade overflow rinse with ultra-pure DIW until bath resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

5. **Final Surface Hydrogen-Passivation Dip:**
   - Submerge wafers in ultra-pure dilute $\text{HF}$ ($1:100\text{ HF} : \text{H}_2\text{O}$) at $21^\circ\text{C} - 23^\circ\text{C}$ for $45\text{ s}$ to produce a hydrophobic, dangling-bond-free silicon surface with terminated $\text{Si-H}$ bonds.
   - Rinse in cold deoxygenated DI water ($< 10\text{ ppb dissolved } \text{O}_2$) for $60\text{ s}$.

6. **Surface Drying & Queue Limit Execution:**
   - Execute surface drying using an IPA (isopropanol) vapor / Marangoni surface tension gradient dryer to prevent water marks.
   - Transfer wafers into nitrogen purged pod ($\text{N}_2$ purge, $\text{RH} < 10\%$) with a pre-oxidation queue limit of $< 2\text{ hours}$ prior to quartz tube dry thermal oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Capacitance Budget┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
      D_it (log10)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
   Oxide Thickness┤▓▓▓▓▓                               │
                  │▓▓▓▓▓                               │
       E_bd Target┤██████████████                      │
                  │██████████████                      │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

| # | Inspection Parameter | Acceptance Target Metric | Measurement Tool / Metrology Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $\mathbf{< 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}}$ | High-frequency / Quasistatic Capacitance-Voltage ($C-V$) Profiling |
| **2** | **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $\mathbf{> 10\text{ MV/cm}}$ | Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB) / Ramp Voltage Breakdown ($I-V$) |
| **3** | **Pre-Oxidation Clean Cleanliness / Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | Physical thickness target $\mathbf{3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}}$ (post-oxidation) with zero surface watermark defects ($\ge 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ particle count $< 10\text{ per wafer}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) / Laser Surface Particle Scanner |
| **4** | **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $\mathbf{< 1\text{ fA/cell}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring cell capacitance budget retention $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer ($I_{off} - V_g$ at elevated chuck temp) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Governs dry thermal oxidation regime where thin oxide ($3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$) interface reaction-rate kinetics require clean, trap-free pre-oxidation surfaces yielding $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ and dense breakdown strength $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Establishes the dry thermal oxidation baseline at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ for $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical gate $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness and target capacitance budgeting of $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Dictates access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage current cutoff $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

```text
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   RCA-2 / SC-2 Bath    │
│      Prep: 6:1:1       │
│     DI:HCl:H2O2 at     │
│         70-80C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Final DI Water Rinse  │
│    and N2 Spin-Dry     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Reagent Receipt & Assay Verification**:
   - Inspect electronic-grade chemical lots for specification compliance:
     - Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$): $29\%$ assay.
     - Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$): $30\%$ assay.
     - Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$): $37\%$ assay.
     - Deionized (DI) Water: verify in-line resistivity is $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

2. **RCA-1 (Standard Clean 1 / SC-1) Bath Preparation**:
   - In a clean fluoropolymer/quartz tank, charge volumetric ratio:
     $$\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH } (29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%) = 5 : 1 : 1$$
   - Enable bath immersion heater and stabilize temperature to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafers for **$10 - 15\text{ minutes}$** to oxidize and solubilize organic films and particle contamination.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**:
   - Transfer wafer carrier to the QDR tank.
   - Cycle rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water for **$3\text{ minutes}$**.

4. **Dilute Hydrofluoric (DHF) Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Charge dilute HF bath with volumetric ratio:
     $$\text{HF} : \text{DI H}_2\text{O} = 1 : 50$$
   - Submerge wafers for **$15 - 30\text{ seconds}$** until the silicon surface transitions completely from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
   - Perform an immediate intermediate dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water.

5. **RCA-2 (Standard Clean 2 / SC-2) Bath Preparation**:
   - In a secondary clean quartz bath, mix volumetric ratio:
     $$\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl } (37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%) = 6 : 1 : 1$$
   - Heat and maintain solution temperature at **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafers for **$10\text{ minutes}$** to desorb alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and precipitate/dissolve metallic contaminants ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).

6. **Final Rinse and Dry**:
   - Transfer to cascade dump rinser with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water.
   - Perform final surface drying using high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry / spin-rinse-dryer.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Specification | Tolerance & Units | Monitoring Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RCA-1 Bath Temperature** | $70 - 80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-tank PFA-sheathed RTD / Thermocouple |
| **RCA-2 Bath Temperature** | $70 - 80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-tank PFA-sheathed RTD / Thermocouple |
| **DHF Strip Immersion Time** | $15 - 30$ | $\text{seconds}$ | Wet bench robotic recipe timer |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | $18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity sensor |

---

### 4. Context References Citing
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - Reagent concentration benchmarks: $29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH}$, $30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$, $37\%\text{ HCl}$.
  - Volumetric ratios: RCA-1 ($5:1:1$), RCA-2 ($6:1:1$), and DHF ($1:50$).
  - Temperature setpoints: $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ for RCA-1 and RCA-2.
  - Duration windows: RCA-1 ($10 - 15\text{ min}$), RCA-2 ($10\text{ min}$), DHF dip ($15 - 30\text{ s}$), and Dump Rinse ($3\text{ min}$).
  - Water quality and drying: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ dry.
