# Standard Operating Procedure: Sequential SC-1 Organic Clean, DHF Native Oxide Strip, and SC-2 Metal Desorption Recipe Execution

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-RCA01`  
**Classification:** Front-End Fabrication / Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation Passivation  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Line:** Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: SC-1 Organic Clean (70°C - 80°C)   │
│  Solubilize organics & oxidize light traces  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Intermediate DI Water Dump Rinse   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm DI water cascade dump (3 min)    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Dilute HF (DHF 1:50) Native Strip  │
│  Native oxide removal (15 s - 30 s)          │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 4: Intermediate DI Water Dump Rinse   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm DI water cascade dump (3 min)    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 5: SC-2 Metal Desorption (70°C - 80°C)│
│  Desorb alkali (Na+, K+) & heavy ions        │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 6: Final Dump Rinse & N2 Blow-Dry     │
│  High-purity filtered N2 surface dry         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Stage 1: Standard Clean 1 (SC-1 / RCA-1) Bath Preparation & Immersion**
   - Formulate chemical bath using a volumetric ratio of `5 : 1 : 1`:
     - 5 parts Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$)
     - 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$)
     - 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)
   - Heat the quartz bath to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafer cassette and process for **10 to 15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface residues and oxidize trace light metals.

2. **Stage 2: Intermediate Dump Rinse**
   - Transfer wafer cassette immediately into a quick-dump rinse (QDR) tank.
   - Rinse continuously with ultra-pure deionized water with a resistivity of **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** for **3 minutes**.

3. **Stage 3: Dilute Hydrofluoric Acid (DHF) Native Oxide Strip**
   - Prepare a **$1:50\ \text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$** volumetric bath at ambient cleanroom temperature.
   - Dip wafer cassette for **15 to 30 seconds** to strip the native silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) layer.
   - Observe wafer surface transition from hydrophilic (sheet wetting) to hydrophobic (beading dewetting).

4. **Stage 4: Post-DHF Cascade DI Rinse**
   - Transfer immediately to the QDR tank.
   - Flush with **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** DI water for **3 minutes** to eliminate all residual fluoride ions.

5. **Stage 5: Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / RCA-2) Heavy Metal Desorption**
   - Formulate chemical bath using a volumetric ratio of `6 : 1 : 1`:
     - 6 parts Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$)
     - 1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\%\ \text{HCl}$)
     - 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)
   - Heat bath to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Submerge wafers for **10 minutes** to strip alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy transition metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).

6. **Stage 6: Final Dump Rinse & Nitrogen Blow-Dry**
   - Perform final multi-cycle dump rinse with **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** DI water.
   - Transfer to spin-rinse dryer (SRD) or N2 dry station; execute surface dry utilizing **high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ gas**.
   - Immediately queue wafers for dry thermal oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$, $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}\ \text{SiO}_2$ target) to prevent uncontrolled ambient re-oxidation.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Bath Temperature** | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-spec within $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ calibrated bath RTD/thermocouple |
| **DI Water Rinse Resistivity** | $18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Online inline resistivity sensor |
| **DHF Dip Exposure Duration** | $15.0 - 30.0$ | $\text{s}$ | In-spec within $15 - 30\ \text{s}$ | Automated wet bench recipe timer |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Immersion Time** | SC-1: $10 - 15$ / SC-2: $10$ | $\min$ | Exact cycle duration | Automated robotic hoist timer |

---

### 3. Context Citations & Literature Traceability

- **Bath Chemistries, Dilutions & Durations:**
  - *Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*
    - SC-1 recipe: $5:1:1\ \text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\ (29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$ at $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10-15\ \min$.
    - Rinse specification: Dump rinse with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\ \min$.
    - DHF native oxide strip: $1:50\ \text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ for $15-30\ \text{s}$ (hydrophilic to hydrophobic shift).
    - SC-2 recipe: $6:1:1\ \text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl}\ (37\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ (30\%)$ at $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\ \min$.
    - Drying: High-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Downstream Thermal Oxidation & Gate Stack Integration:**
  - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
    - Gate oxide integration: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Transistor Dimensioning:**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
    - Transistor gate footprint channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Post-RCA Passivation Surface Metrology, Contact Angle, and Particle Defect Inspection
- **Project Tracking ID:** `SOP-FAB-FEOL-180NM-MET-004`
- **Node & Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)
- **Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > Dry Thermal Oxidation & High-K ALD Deposition Recipe Execution > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Passivation > Metrology
- **Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Inspection & Metrology Toolset: Automated Goniometer, Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, Unpatterned Darkfield Defect Inspection System)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Post-RCA Clean Lot   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│         Angle          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│  Ellipsometry Native   │
│         Oxide          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Darkfield Laser     │
│    Particle Defect     │
│       Inspection       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gate Oxidation Tube   │
│        Release         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Inspection Stage Environmental & Carrier Load Check**
   - Transfer the post-RCA cleaned and passivated wafer cassette directly from the wet bench spin-rinse dryer (SRD) output buffer to the Class 1 mini-environment FOUP/SMIF interface under continuous clean dry N₂ purge.
   - Verify inspection tool environment: Cleanroom ambient temperature $21 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity $40 \pm 3\%$, Class 1 filter canopy active.
   - Enforce maximum queue time limit: The entire metrology loop must complete within **$< 30\text{ minutes}$** post-rinse/dry to prevent uncontrolled native oxide growth prior to furnace loading.

2. **Hydrophobic / Hydrophilic Surface Passivation (Contact Angle Goniometry)**
   - Load the designated monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck.
   - Dispense an ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) droplet ($1.0 \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$) using an automated piezo-driven micro-syringe at 5 distinct site locations (Center, North, South, East, West at $R = 70\text{ mm}$).
   - Perform automated sessile drop optical edge detection within $2\text{ seconds}$ of droplet contact to evaluate termination quality:
     - For DHF-last H-terminated hydrophobic surface: record water contact angle $\theta_c$.
     - For SC-1/chemical oxide hydrophilic surface: record water contact angle $\theta_c$.
   - Automated nitrogen blow-off and wipe-free droplet suction to prevent drying stains.

3. **Sub-Nanometer Native Oxide Film Metrology (Spectroscopic Ellipsometry)**
   - Transfer the monitor wafer to the high-resolution multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometer stage.
   - Execute a 9-point polar map scan across the wafer active surface using calibrated wavelengths ($\lambda = 190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) at an incidence angle of $70^\circ$.
   - Fit the measured $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra using a standard $Si / SiO_2$ Cauchy optical dispersion model to quantify the residual chemical/native oxide thickness ($t_{ox,0}$) ensuring substrate baseline readiness for the target physical gate dielectric thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$).

4. **Surface Particle Defect & Micro-Contamination Inspection (Darkfield Laser Scattering)**
   - Transfer product and monitor wafers to the darkfield unpatterned surface inspection tool.
   - Scan wafer surface using an oblique/normal incidence UV/DUV laser ($355\text{ nm}$ or $266\text{ nm}$) with darkfield high-angle photomultiplier tube (PMT) detectors.
   - Quantify total particle adder count and particle size distribution binning down to the critical defect threshold ($> 90\text{ nm}$, equal to half the $180\text{ nm}$ access transistor channel length $L$).
   - Flag and map any local clusters, streak defects, or haze excursions; automatically hold the lot if defect count exceeds out-of-control limits (OOC).

5. **Lot Disposition & Quartz Furnace Gate Release**
   - Automatically compile metrology data into the fab MES/SPC database.
   - If contact angle, native oxide thickness, and defect metrics satisfy all acceptance thresholds, mark the lot as **PASS** and route directly to the dry thermal oxidation quartz tube furnace (recipe at $850^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Control Limit / Tolerance | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **H-Passivated Surface Contact Angle** ($\theta_c$, DHF-last) | $> 75^\circ$ | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ (Uniformity $\pm 3.0^\circ$ across 5 points) | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI Water Droplet) |
| **Residual Native / Chemical Oxide Thickness** ($t_{ox,0}$) | $< 0.8\text{ nm}$ | $\le 1.0\text{ nm}$ (Within baseline for $3.5\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$ gate oxide target) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (9-point map, $\lambda = 190-800\text{ nm}$) |
| **Critical Defect / Particle Adder Density** ($d_{part}$) | $< 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ ($> 90\text{ nm}$ size) | $\le 15\text{ defects/wafer}$ for $200\text{ mm}$ wafer | Darkfield DUV/UV Laser Surface Particle Scanner |
| **Surface Micro-Roughness** ($R_q$ / RMS) | $< 0.15\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.20\text{ nm}$ | In-line Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM, $2\ \mu\text{m} \times 2\ \mu\text{m}$ scan) |

---

### 3. Context Literature Citations

- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Cited for gate dielectric baseline growth conditions: Dry oxidation performed at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ targeting physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ (requiring pre-oxidation residual oxide metrology control $\le 1.0\text{ nm}$ and minimal initial surface trap contamination to guarantee $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Cited for thermal gate oxide specification: $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, setting strict tolerances for incoming wafer surface cleanliness and pre-oxidation chemical oxide thickness.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Cited for access transistor channel geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, defining the critical particle inspection limit ($> L/2 = 90\text{ nm}$) to avoid gate bridging, pinholes, and excessive junction leakage ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Dry Thermal Oxidation and High-k ALD Stack Deposition Recipe Execution
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make | **Classification:** Front-End Fabrication / Thermal Oxidation & Dielectric Deposition

---

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Pre-Clean: RCA-1, RCA-2 & Dilute HF (Native Oxide Strip)│
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Dry Thermal Oxidation (850°C - 900°C, Pure Dry O2)     │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ In-Situ Post-Oxidation Anneal (POA in N2 Ambient)      │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ High-k ALD Deposition (Al2O3 / Ta2O5 Stack)            │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Post-Deposition Anneal (PDA) & Inline Metrology        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Furnace Surface Preparation (RCA Clean & HF Dip)**
   - Subject single-crystal Si (100) wafers to standard RCA clean (SC-1: $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2/\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at 70°C; SC-2: $\text{HCl}/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2/\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at 70°C).
   - Perform a final 50:1 DHF dip for 30 s to strip native oxide, followed by quick-dump rinse (QDR) with ultra-pure deionized water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and spin-rinse dry under clean $\text{N}_2$ to achieve a hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated interface.

2. **Furnace Loading and Ramp-Up**
   - Transfer wafers into the quartz tube oxidation furnace at an idling temperature of 600°C under continuous ultra-high purity (UHP) $\text{N}_2$ carrier flow (5–10 slm) to prevent uncontrolled native oxide regrowth.
   - Ramp furnace temperature up to **850°C – 900°C** at a linear ramp rate of 5°C/min in dry $\text{N}_2$.

3. **Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution**
   - Switch gas flow from $\text{N}_2$ to **100% pure dry $\text{O}_2$** (filtered, dew point $< -100^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Execute oxidation in the linear Deal-Grove regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, interface reaction-rate limited with linear rate constant $k_l = B/A$) at **850°C – 900°C** until achieving the target physical interface oxide thickness of **3.5 nm to 4.0 nm**.

4. **In-Situ Post-Oxidation Anneal (POA)**
   - Flush process tube with UHP $\text{N}_2$ and hold at 900°C for 15 minutes to passivate dangling silicon bonds, relieve film stress, and reduce interface trap density.
   - Ramp down furnace temperature to 600°C under $\text{N}_2$ and unclamp wafers into nitrogen purge transfer pods (FOUPs).

5. **High-k ALD Stack Deposition ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$)**
   - Transfer wafers immediately into the cross-flow Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) chamber (wafer transfer queue delay $< 60$ minutes).
   - Stabilize substrate stage temperature between 250°C – 300°C at base pressure $\sim 10^{-2}\text{ Torr}$.
   - Execute cyclical pulsed ALD recipe:
     - **$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ alternating cycles** using precursor exposure, $\text{N}_2$ purge, oxidant exposure ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$ or $\text{O}_3$), and $\text{N}_2$ purge to build the high-k stack with target effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of **3.0 to 4.0 nm**.

6. **Post-Deposition Anneal (PDA)**
   - Subject the stacked film to a mild thermal anneal at 400°C – 450°C in an $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ (forming gas) ambient for 20 minutes to densify the high-k dielectric and minimize border traps.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Physical Thickness** | **3.5 nm – 4.0 nm** | $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ ($1\sigma < 1.5\%$) | Multi-angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | **$> 10\text{ MV/cm}$** | Lower limit: $10.0\text{ MV/cm}$ | Mercury Probe / CV Prober (Quasi-static I-V) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | **$< 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$** | Upper limit: $1.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Frequency / Low-Frequency C-V Profiling |
| **High-k Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$) & Total EOT** | **$\kappa > 15$**; **$\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$** | Min $\kappa = 15.0$; $\text{EOT} \le 4.0\text{ nm}$ | Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) Metrology at 100 kHz |
| **Per-Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** | Target range: **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$** | Inline Array Parametric Testing (PCM) |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** (at 85°C) | Upper limit: $1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Prober Parametric Station |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Oxidation kinetics: Linear-parabolic model $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$ with thin regime linear limit $x_0 \ll A/2$.
  - Dry oxidation temperature: $850^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - Dielectric breakdown field: $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
  - Interface trap density: $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.
  - Target physical thickness: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell dimensions: Transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Dielectric materials: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\ /\ \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack providing effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Cell capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Leakage requirement: Sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor target capacitance: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - High-k Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation conditions: $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ yielding $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-FEOL-THOX-001`
**Title:** RCA-Cleaned Wafer Surface Preparation and Ultra-Thin Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$)  
**Architecture & Level:** 180 nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) | Access Transistor Gate Dielectric ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  RCA Clean & HF Dip   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Load Boat in N2    │
│     Purge at 600C     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Ramp to 850C-900C   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Pure Dry O2      │
│   Oxidation: 3.5nm    │
│        target         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Post-Oxidation     │
│     Anneal N2/Ar      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Ellipsometry &     │
│  Breakdown Metrology  │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Surface Preparation & Native Oxide Stripping (Pre-Gate RCA Clean)**:
   - Perform Standard Clean 1 (SC-1: $\text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 : \text{H}_2\text{O} = 1:1:5$) at $75^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes to strip particles and organic residues.
   - Perform dilute $\text{HF}$ dip ($0.5\%\text{ HF}$ in $\text{DI}$ water) for 30–60 seconds to strip native oxide down to a bare, hydrogen-terminated silicon surface.
   - Perform Standard Clean 2 (SC-2: $\text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2 : \text{H}_2\text{O} = 1:1:6$) at $75^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes to strip metallic contaminants, followed by a final quick dilute $\text{HF}$ touch and ultra-pure $\text{DI}$ water rinse ($>18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) until resistivity stabilizes. Spin-rinse dry in ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$.
   - Transfer wafers to the furnace load port within a strict queue time limit ($\le 60\text{ min}$) to prevent uncontrolled native oxide regrowth.

2. **Furnace Idling & Boat Loading**:
   - Verify quartz tube furnace idling at standby temperature: $600^\circ\text{C}$ under high-purity dry $\text{N}_2$ purge ($>99.9999\%$).
   - Load quartz boat carrying p-type Si (100) product wafers and monitor wafers into the furnace tube at a controlled insertion rate of $100\text{ mm/min}$ under continuous $\text{N}_2$ purge to avoid air backstreaming.

3. **Temperature Ramp & Stabilization**:
   - Ramp tube furnace temperature from $600^\circ\text{C}$ to recipe setpoint of $850^\circ\text{C}$–$900^\circ\text{C}$ at a ramp rate of $10^\circ\text{C/min}$ in inert $\text{N}_2$ ambient.
   - Allow temperature to stabilize across all three thermal zones (load, center, source) within $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes.

4. **Ultra-Thin Dry Thermal Oxidation Execution**:
   - Switch ambient gas from $\text{N}_2$ to pure dry $\text{O}_2$ ($900^\circ\text{C}$ setpoint; operating in the Deal-Grove linear oxidation regime $x_0 \ll A/2$, dominated by interface reaction rate constant $k_l = B/A$).
   - Execute dry oxidation timer calibrated for physical target thickness: $3.5\text{ nm}$ (acceptable range: $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$).

5. **Post-Oxidation Anneal (POA) & Cooldown**:
   - Immediately switch gas manifold back to dry $\text{N}_2$ or ultra-pure $\text{Ar}$ at $850^\circ\text{C}$–$900^\circ\text{C}$ for 15 minutes to minimize interface trap states ($D_{it}$).
   - Ramp furnace down to $600^\circ\text{C}$ at a controlled rate of $-5^\circ\text{C/min}$ under continuous inert purge.
   - Unload quartz boat at $100\text{ mm/min}$ into the cleanroom Class 1 mini-environment.

6. **Post-Process Inline Metrology**:
   - Measure 49-point wafer mapping on spectroscopic ellipsometer to verify film thickness and refractive index.
   - Perform non-contact corona-Kelvin or CV/IV probe on test monitor wafers to assess interface trap density and dielectric breakdown field.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | `3.5 to 4.0` | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Oxidation Temperature Window** | `900` | `850 to 900` (up to `1000`) | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | `> 10.0` | Min `10.0` | $\text{MV/cm}$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | `< 1.0E+10` | Max `1.0E+10` | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ |

---

### 3. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
   - *Oxidation Regime & Chemistry*: Pure dry $\text{O}_2$ oxidation at $900^\circ\text{C}$–$1000^\circ\text{C}$; governed by linear-parabolic model $x_0^2 + A\cdot x_0 = B(t + \tau)$ with linear rate constant $k_l = B/A$ in the thin regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$).
   - *Electrical & Physical Targets*: Yields dense $\text{SiO}_2$ with dielectric breakdown $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$, and target thickness of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - *Access Transistor Gate Oxide Specification*: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}$–$900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - *Device Integration Context*: 180 nm access transistor dimensioning ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor integration with sub-threshold/junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: High-k $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3 / \text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ Dielectric Stack Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) Recipe Execution
- **Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > Dry Thermal Oxidation & High-K ALD Deposition Recipe Execution > Dry Thermal Oxidation and High-k ALD Stack Deposition Recipe Execution > High-k $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3 / \text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ Dielectric Stack ALD Recipe Execution
- **Technology Node:** 180nm (Gen 2 µm)
- **Cell Architecture:** 1T1C Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB / Crown / Cylinder)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Load Substrate &   │
│         Pump         │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Al2O3 Interfacial   │
│         ALD          │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Ta2O5 Bulk High-k   │
│         ALD          │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Post-Deposition    │
│  Anneal & Metrology  │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Vacuum Pump-Down**:
   - Transfer pre-cleaned 180nm DRAM wafers (patterned crown/cylinder capacitor nodes over W-plug contacts) through the vacuum loadlock into the ALD reaction chamber.
   - Evacuate reaction chamber to base pressure ($< 1 \times 10^{-5}\text{ Torr}$) and establish high-purity carrier gas flow ($\text{N}_2$ or $\text{Ar}$) at stabilized reactor pressure (100–300 mTorr).
   - Equilibrate wafer chuck temperature to the standard ALD thermal window ($250^\circ\text{C} - 300^\circ\text{C}$).

2. **Interfacial $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ Seed/Barrier Layer Deposition**:
   - Execute self-limiting cycle for interfacial $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$:
     - **Precursor Pulse:** Trimethylaluminum ($\text{TMA}$, $\text{Al(CH}_3)_3$) vapor injection for self-saturating surface adsorption.
     - **Chamber Purge:** High-purity $\text{N}_2$ purge to remove unreacted TMA and methane byproducts.
     - **Oxidant Pulse:** Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ vapor or $\text{O}_3$ pulse to complete surface ligand exchange.
     - **Post-Oxidant Purge:** $\text{N}_2$ purge to evacuate reaction byproducts.
   - Cycle until achieving the required ultra-thin barrier layer thickness prior to bulk high-k transition.

3. **Bulk High-k $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ Dielectric Layer Deposition**:
   - Switch precursor manifold to tantalum source (e.g., Tantalum ethoxide $\text{Ta(OC}_2\text{H}_5)_5$ [$\text{PET}$]):
     - **Precursor Pulse:** Sublimated/vaporized tantalum precursor dose to saturate 3D crown surface topology conformally.
     - **Purge:** $\text{N}_2$ purge sweep of dead volume and physisorbed residues.
     - **Oxidant Pulse:** $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ or $\text{O}_3$ injection to form stoichiometric amorphous $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$.
     - **Purge:** Exhaust purge sequence.
   - Repeat sequential ALD cycles to target equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window.

4. **In-Situ Purge, Unload & Post-Deposition Thermal Anneal (PDA)**:
   - Perform inert $\text{N}_2$ gas pump-purge evacuation (minimum 5 cycles) before loadlock transfer.
   - Subject deposited stack to post-deposition thermal treatment to densify the film, passivate oxygen vacancies, and lower interface trap density without exceeding thermal budgets.

5. **In-Line Ellipsometry & C-V Test Pad Verification**:
   - Measure physical thickness and optical refractive index via spectroscopic ellipsometry across multi-point wafer sites.
   - Measure test capacitor macro capacitance and current-voltage ($I\text{-}V$) leakage at 85°C.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-frequency C-V extraction on test pads |
| **Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15$ | dimensionless | Extracted from high-k stack physical vs electrical thickness |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance** | $25\text{ to }30$ (min. target: $28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Direct probe C-V metrology on 180nm 1T1C array macro |
| **Leakage Current Density (@ 85°C)** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated parametric tester (pA/fA meter) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 3. Citations & Context Alignment

- **Cell Capacitance & Leakage Limits**: Verified against *"180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench"* — requires a minimum storage capacitance budget of **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** (retention spec: **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$**) and sub-threshold/junction leakage **$< 1\text{ fA/cell at }85^\circ\text{C}$**.
- **Dielectric Stack & Permittivity**: Verified against *"180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench"* — specifies the $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stack achieving an effective dielectric constant **$\kappa > 15$**.
- **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)**: Verified against *"Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering"* — dictates an EOT target of **$3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$** for 180nm stacked crown/cylinder cell capacitors.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-SE-CVIV-001`
**Title:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V / I-V Dielectric Stack Leakage Characterization Metrology  
**Project:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Front-End Fabrication / Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│     Pre-Alignment      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│      Ellipsometry      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Mercury Probe / Dot   │
│  C-V Characterization  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Quasi-Static &     │
│   High-Frequency C-V   │
│         Sweep          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  I-V Leakage Current   │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Acceptance /   │
│       Rejection        │
│      Disposition       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Metrology Preparation & Wafer Pre-Alignment:**
   - Mount the test/pilot wafer containing the thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric or the $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{ONO}$ capacitor dielectric stack onto the robotic wafer chuck.
   - Run optical notch/flat alignment to establish standard coordinate axes for multi-point cartography.

2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) Film Thickness & Optical Modeling:**
   - Position the optical head at incident angle $\Phi = 70^\circ$ (spectral range: $190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$).
   - Measure polarimetric angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ governed by the fundamental Fresnel relation:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   - Fit experimental data using a Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion model to parameterize refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
   - Execute an automated **49-point** (or **9-point**) radial wafer mapping routine across the diameter to monitor radial film non-uniformity.

3. **Mercury Probe / Metal Dot Contact Setup for Electrical Metrology:**
   - Transfer wafer to the C-V / I-V characterization station (using top-gate test pads or automated non-destructive capillary mercury probe contacts of known contact area $A$).
   - Verify backside ohmic grounding and set chuck temperature control to $85^\circ\text{C}$ for hot dielectric qualification.

4. **High-Frequency & Quasi-Static C-V Electrical Characterization:**
   - Sweep bias voltage $V_g$ from accumulation through depletion into strong inversion at high frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static rates.
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance $C_{acc}$ and calculate the Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):
     $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{acc}}$$
   - Verify that effective dielectric permittivity satisfies $\kappa > 15$ for advanced $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ capacitor stacks.

5. **I-V Dielectric Leakage & Breakdown Testing:**
   - Apply a stepped DC voltage ramp across the dielectric stack under inversion and accumulation bias conditions.
   - Measure gate/dielectric leakage current density $J_g$ and evaluate sub-threshold/junction leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Ensure the cell storage capacitance target of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ (within the $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ budget) is backed by negligible leakage.

6. **Data Logging and Lot Disposition:**
   - Record fitted physical thickness, EOT, dielectric constant $\kappa$, and leakage current at $85^\circ\text{C}$ in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
   - Trigger SPC alarms if 49-point radial non-uniformity or leakage exceeds acceptance thresholds.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance / Bounds | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermally Grown Gate $\text{SiO}_2$ Physical Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.05$ (Sub-Angstrom precision) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Capacitor Dielectric Stack Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **High-$\kappa$ Stack Effective Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15$ | $\ge 15.0$ | Dimensionless |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance Floor Budget** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |

---

### Verified Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - Fresnel reflection relation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$.
  - Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion parameterization for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Dry gate oxide physical thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$) with $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ precision.
  - Automated 9-point or 49-point radial mapping for tracking film non-uniformity across furnace and deposition runs.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - $\text{ONO}$ triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack requiring $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity.
  - Leakage current target: sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh performance.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Cell storage capacitance range of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window: $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Dielectric Metrology Inspection

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180-004`  
**Process Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line  
**Module:** Metrology & In-Line Process Control  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM Node, Architecture & Integration)  
**Action Type:** Make / In-Line Metrology Inspection  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Load Wafer and Align  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Ellipsometry      │
│      49-Point Map      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dispersion Model    │
│          Fit:          │
│    Cauchy/Sellmeier    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   C-V Dot Profiling:   │
│      EOT and Cox       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SPC Disposition and   │
│        Release         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Measurement System Calibration & Optical Initialization
1. Verify spectroscopic ellipsometer source lamp intensity (Xe/quartz-tungsten halogen source) across the target optical spectral band ($190\text{ nm} - 830\text{ nm}$).
2. Perform reference autocalibration on a certified clean bare silicon / $100\text{ nm}$ thermal oxide wafer standard. Ensure root mean square error (RMSE) $< 1.0$.
3. Load the 180nm production/monitor wafer onto the automated vacuum chuck and execute notch/flat robotic optical pattern alignment.

#### Step 2: Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Inspection
1. Select the multi-point wafer mapping recipe: **49-point polar map** with a $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion zone to measure across radial zones.
2. Set the optical angle of incidence ($\theta$) to $70.0^\circ$ (Brewster angle neighborhood for the $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ and high-$\kappa$ interface).
3. Acquire polarization state angles $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ according to the fundamental ellipsometric ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
4. Apply the optical dispersion model:
   - For thermal gate dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$): fit using the parameterized **Cauchy model** ($n(\lambda) = A + B/\lambda^2$).
   - For high-$\kappa$ capacitor dielectrics ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or $\text{ONO}$): fit using the **Sellmeier dispersion model** to extract physical thickness $t_{phys}$, refractive index $n$, and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
5. Calculate wafer mean thickness, standard deviation ($1\sigma$), and radial non-uniformity percentage:
   $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{t_{max} - t_{min}}{2 \cdot t_{mean}} \times 100\%$$

#### Step 3: High-Frequency Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) Metrology
1. Transfer wafer/monitor test vehicle to the automated mercury-probe (Hg-probe) or patterned gate test pad array.
2. Initialize high-frequency C-V sweep generator:
   - AC small-signal oscillation: $f = 100\text{ kHz} - 1.0\text{ MHz}$, $v_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}_{rms}$.
   - DC bias voltage ramp: sweep from accumulation ($-2.5\text{ V}$) through depletion to deep inversion ($+2.5\text{ V}$).
3. Extract maximum accumulation capacitance density ($C_{ox}$) to evaluate the Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):
   $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}}{C_{ox}}$$
4. Verify dielectric constant ($\kappa_{eff}$) from the physical film thickness $t_{phys}$ and measured accumulation capacitance.

#### Step 4: SPC Data Disposition
1. Log extracted metrics ($t_{phys}$, EOT, $\kappa$, wafer non-uniformity) into the manufacturing execution system (MES).
2. Apply automated out-of-spec (OOS) hold if metrics violate the baseline threshold tolerances.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Wavelength Dispersion Modeling and Tool Baseline Calibration

**Module / Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > Front-End Fabrication > Thermal Oxidation > Metrology  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Calibration & Metrology  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Standard Calibration  │
│       Wafer Load       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Auto-Alignment &    │
│  Baseline Calibration  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Multi-Wavelength    │
│   Data Acquisition:    │
│      Psi & Delta       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Cauchy / Sellmeier   │
│    Dispersion Model    │
│        Fitting         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Radial Wafer      │
│    Mapping: 9-Pt /     │
│   49-Pt Verification   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Calibration & Standard Wafer Loading:**
   - Verify tool environmental enclosures and optical source stability.
   - Load certified calibration standard wafers (e.g., bare silicon reference and thermal oxide control wafer) onto the vacuum chuck.

2. **Optical Alignment & Tool Baseline Calibration:**
   - Execute auto-collimation and Z-height auto-focus to ensure beam alignment normal to the optical axis.
   - Perform baseline polarimeter and compensator calibrations at standard angles of incidence to zero tool-induced phase and amplitude offsets.

3. **Multi-Wavelength Data Acquisition ($\Psi$, $\Delta$):**
   - Acquire polarized reflectance spectra over the spectroscopic wavelength range ($\lambda$).
   - Measure the amplitude ratio angle ($\Psi$) and phase difference angle ($\Delta$) governed by the fundamental ellipsometric equation:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients for p-polarized and s-polarized light.

4. **Optical Dispersion Modeling & Layer Fitting:**
   - Select and configure the appropriate optical dispersion model:
     - Apply **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion formulations to parameterize refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ across the dielectric and transparent film layers.
   - Execute regression fitting against acquired $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra to extract film thickness and refractive index profiles.

5. **Automated Wafer Mapping & Run Qualification:**
   - Execute automated **9-point** or **49-point** wafer mapping programs to capture across-wafer thickness profiles and evaluate radial non-uniformity across furnace thermal oxidation and coating runs.
   - Record baseline calibration parameters into the metrology SPC run log before releasing the tool to production lots.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Criteria | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal thickness | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Ångström precision) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Dispersion fit |
| **Thick Film / Photoresist Measurement Precision** | $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ nominal thickness | $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Dispersion fit |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Inspection Scheme** | 9-point or 49-point pattern | $100\%$ sites resolved, radial map validated | Automated Multi-Point Wafer Chuck Mapping |

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Context

- **Source: *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology***
  - Physical principle: Polarization change quantified by amplitude ratio angle $\Psi$ and phase difference angle $\Delta$ via $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical modeling: Cauchy and Sellmeier dispersion models for parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Precision targets: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) precision within $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$; thick film/photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) precision within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - Spatial metrology: Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping for radial non-uniformity tracking.
- **Source: *Ellipsometry Basics***
  - Baseline definition: Phase change ($\Delta$) and amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) measurements.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated 49-Point Wafer Thickness and Refractive Index Radial Uniformity Mapping

- **Module**: Metrology / Thin Film Dielectric Metrology Line
- **Process Step**: Automated 49-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Inspection
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (1T1C Stacked Capacitor Architecture)
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Target Films**: Thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ (~3.5 nm), High-$\kappa$ capacitor dielectrics ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$/$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ EOT 3 to 4 nm), and Photolithography Resist (1.3 µm)

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Stage Loading & Vacuum Chucking"] --> B["System Optical Calibration (Si/SiO2 Reference)"]
    B --> C["Recipe Configuration (49-Point Radial Polar Grid)"]
    C --> D["Automated Polarimetric Acquisition (Psi & Delta)"]
    D --> E["Dispersion Model Fitting (Cauchy / Sellmeier)"]
    E --> F["Wafer Uniformity Map & Acceptance Screening"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**:
   - Transfer the 180nm process wafer (following 850°C–900°C dry thermal oxidation or high-$\kappa$ dielectric deposition) via cleanroom end-effector to the spectroscopic ellipsometer stage.
   - Engage vacuum chucking and run automated laser auto-collimation/tilt leveling to align stage reflection normal to the detector.
2. **System Baseline & Calibration**:
   - Verify spectrometer wavelength calibration across the UV-visible-NIR spectrum against the certified baseline reference standard.
   - Confirm detector dark-current baseline and signal-to-noise ratio prior to map sequence initiation.
3. **49-Point Radial Grid Recipe Setup**:
   - Load the automated **49-point wafer mapping recipe**, setting up a concentric radial polar layout ($r, \theta$) spanning edge-exclusion zones down to 3 mm from the bevel.
   - Configure optical model selection: select **Cauchy dispersion model** for transparent dielectrics ($n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}$, $k \approx 0$) or **Sellmeier model** for high-$\kappa$ dielectrics ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$).
4. **Data Acquisition ($\Psi$ & $\Delta$)**:
   - Execute the 49-point measurement sweep. For each coordinate, record polarization parameters according to the fundamental ellipsometric equation:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) e^{i\Delta}$$
   - Extract raw Fresnel reflection coefficient ratios across the full spectral band.
5. **Model Regression & Extraction**:
   - Run Levenberg-Marquardt regression minimizing Mean Squared Error (MSE) between experimental and modeled $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$.
   - Extract point-by-point physical thickness ($t$) and refractive index ($n$).
6. **Radial Uniformity Computation & Disposition**:
   - Generate radial contour maps and compute percent non-uniformity ($\%NU$):
     $$\%NU = \frac{t_{\max} - t_{\min}}{2 \cdot t_{\text{avg}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Flag out-of-spec wafers exceeding thickness deviation or radial gradient limits.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               Metrology Precision Limits (+/- nm)              
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Photoresist (1.3um)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                      │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Target Cap EOT (3-4nm)┤▒▒▒                             │
                      │▒▒▒                             │
    Gate Oxide (3.5nm)┤██                              │
                      │██                              │
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                     0.00    0.50    1.00   1.50   2.00 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value / Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Thickness & Precision** | $3.5 \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry fit |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) Range** | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / C-V metrology |
| **Photoresist Layer Thickness Precision** | $1.3 \ \mu\text{m} \pm 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | 49-point optical reflectometry / ellipsometry |
| **Radial Mapping Point Count** | Exactly $49$ | $\text{points/wafer}$ | Polar stage coordinate execution log |
| **High-$\kappa$ Dielectric Constant ($\kappa$)** | $> 15$ | dimensionless | C-V dielectric extraction / Sellmeier fit |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Principles of $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) e^{i\Delta}$, Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models, 49-point wafer mapping, 3.5 nm dry gate oxide precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$), and photoresist 1.3 µm precision ($\pm 2\text{ nm}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Dry thermal oxidation gate dielectric physical thickness of ~3.5 nm grown at 850°C–900°C; equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) target of 3 to 4 nm for $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ and $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ capacitor dielectrics.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric stacks ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) providing dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ to achieve the minimum capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$).

nodes.sop_content:
```markdown
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): High-Frequency and Quasi-Static MOS C-V Profiling for EOT and Interface Trap Density Extraction

## 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the metrology workflow for executing combined High-Frequency (HF) and Quasi-Static (QS) Capacitance-Voltage ($C-V$) measurements on MOS test capacitor structures. The procedure extracts Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT), flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$), and interface trap density ($D_{it}$) for the 180nm DRAM access transistor gate dielectric and storage capacitor dielectric stacks.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Wafer Loading and Chuck Grounding
1. Mount the 180nm process monitor wafer onto the probe station gold-plated vacuum chuck.
2. Engage vacuum hold-down and verify back-contact ohmic continuity to the wafer substrate chuck ground.
3. Establish dark-box enclosure sealing and allow probe environment temperature stabilization at nominal ambient ($25.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).

### Step 2: Probe Contact and Instrument Setup
1. Align the micro-manipulator tungsten or beryllium-copper coaxial probe tip onto the top electrode of the MOS test pad ($W = 220\text{ nm}$ equivalent array or dedicated large-area scribe-line capacitor dot, e.g., $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$).
2. Connect the high-side terminal to an LCR impedance analyzer (for HF $C-V$) and an electrometer/SMU (for QS $C-V$) through a low-leakage matrix switch.
3. Perform open/short/load cable capacitance compensation prior to sweep execution.

### Step 3: High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweep Acquisition
1. Configure LCR meter to an AC modulation frequency of $100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$ with an AC oscillation level of $15\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$.
2. Sweep the DC bias voltage from strong accumulation to strong inversion ($-2.5\text{ V}$ to $+2.5\text{ V}$ for p-substrate / NMOS access transistor capacitor).
3. Record high-frequency accumulation capacitance ($C_\text{ox,HF}$) and calculate maximum accumulation capacitance per unit area.

### Step 4: Quasi-Static (QS) / Low-Frequency Sweep Acquisition
1. Configure the electrometer/picoammeter for ramp-rate quasi-static $C-V$ measurement:
   $$C_\text{QS} = \frac{I_\text{displacement}}{dV/dt}$$
2. Set ramp rate $dV/dt$ to $10\text{ to }50\text{ mV/s}$ across the identical DC voltage window under strict optical blackout conditions.
3. Ensure displacement currents exceed background leakage floors, verifying gate leakage is within target specification ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ sub-threshold/junction reference).

### Step 5: Data Extraction (EOT & $D_{it}$)
1. **EOT Extraction:** Extract maximum accumulation capacitance $C_\text{ox}$ (correcting for quantum confinement and series resistance):
   $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A_\text{gate}}{C_\text{ox}}$$
   Verify EOT aligns with target physical thickness ranges ($3.5\text{ nm to }4.0\text{ nm}$ for dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$; $3\text{ nm to }4\text{ nm}$ EOT for stacked capacitor high-k).
2. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction:** Compute $D_{it}$ via the High-Low Frequency (Castagné-Vapaille) method across the depletion-to-weak-inversion bandgap regime:
   $$D_{it} = \frac{C_\text{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_\text{QS}/C_\text{ox}}{1 - C_\text{QS}/C_\text{ox}} - \frac{C_\text{HF}/C_\text{ox}}{1 - C_\text{HF}/C_\text{ox}} \right)$$

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Inspection / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | **$3.5\text{ nm to }4.0\text{ nm}$** (Gate oxide) / **$3.0\text{ nm to }4.0\text{ nm}$** (Capacitor dielectric) | Extracted from accumulation $C_\text{ox}$ ($1\text{ MHz}$ HF $C-V$) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | **$< 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$** at midgap | High-Low ($C_\text{QS} - C_\text{HF}$) extraction method |
| **Oxide Breakdown Field ($E_\text{bd}$)** | **$> 10\text{ MV/cm}$** | Quasi-static voltage ramp until dielectric breakdown threshold |
| **Storage Unit Capacitance Budget** | **$\ge 25\text{ fF to }28\text{ fF}$** per cell (ensuring noise immunity) | Extracted integrated capacitance on scaled cell capacitor structures |

---

## 4. Contextual Sources & Citations
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Gate oxide dry oxidation specifications, dielectric breakdown field ($E_\text{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$), interface trap density target ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$), and physical gate dielectric thickness ($3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) target for stacked capacitors ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$), storage capacitance minimum threshold ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$), and dry oxidation physical thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), and cell leakage thresholds ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
```

# Standard Operating Procedure: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & MOS C-V Dielectric Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-004`  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm Architecture)  
**Fab Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line  
**Classification:** Front-End Metrology & In-Line Process Control  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Vacuum Load &     │
│   Auto-Align Wafer    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Spectroscopic     │
│   Ellipsometry Scan   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Cauchy-Sellmeier    │
│  Optical Regression   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Gate Oxide Physical  │
│    Thickness Check    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   MOS Dot Array C-V   │
│        Sweeps         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Extraction of EOT,   │
│       Dit & Vfb       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Lot Disposition &   │
│     Pass Criteria     │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Critical Metrology Budget Reference

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Min Cap (fF/cell)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                    │▒▒▒▒▒                             │
  Capacitor EOT (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒                             │
SE Precision (+/-nm)┤▓                                 │
                    │▓                                 │
 Gate Oxide Thk (nm)┤█████                             │
                    │█████                             │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0       7       14      21      28 
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Alignment & Optical Reference Calibration
1. Load the 180nm production wafer onto the automated vacuum chuck of the Spectroscopic Ellipsometer.
2. Initialize optical system baseline against an NIST-traceable reference standard ($100\text{ nm }\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}$).
3. Perform motorized notch alignment and optical focus at $70^\circ$ angle of incidence (AOI).

#### Step 2: In-Line Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) Acquisition
1. Set the broadband UV-Visible source spectrometer range across $\lambda = 240\text{ nm}$ to $800\text{ nm}$.
2. Measure the complex reflectance ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$ across the spectral band.
3. Execute automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
4. Fit experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra using a parameterized Cauchy dispersion model:
   $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
5. Extract physical dielectric thickness ($T_{\text{phys}}$) for thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ and stacked capacitor dielectric layers ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or $\text{ONO}$).

#### Step 3: MOS Dot Array C-V Electrical Probing
1. Transfer scribe-line monitor test structures or sacrificial monitor wafers to the prober station.
2. Ground the silicon substrate chuck and contact the top electrode dot array (W-plug / metal gate dot) using a micro-manipulated tungsten needle.
3. Apply a dual-frequency AC test signal ($100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$) superimposed on a DC gate bias sweep from accumulation ($-2.5\text{ V}$) through inversion ($+2.5\text{ V}$).
4. Record high-frequency and quasi-static C-V curves to extract accumulation capacitance ($C_{\text{ox}}$), flat-band voltage ($V_{\text{fb}}$), and interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$).
5. Calculate Equivalent Oxide Thickness:
   $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{\text{ox}}}$$

#### Step 4: Lot Disposition & Pass/Fail Recording
1. Cross-correlate optical thickness $T_{\text{phys}}$ with electrical $\text{EOT}$.
2. Verify all extracted parameters against the Acceptance Criteria. If acceptable, release lot to Wordline/Gate Poly Deposition; quarantine lot if thickness or $D_{\text{it}}$ deviates outside limits.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement Tolerance | Unit | Metrology Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermally Grown Gate $\text{SiO}_2$ Physical Thickness** | `3.50` | `±0.05` (Sub-Ångström precision) | `nm` | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Storage Capacitor Stack Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `3.0 to 4.0` | `±0.10` | `nm` | High-Frequency MOS C-V Prober |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | `≥ 28.0` (Min: 25.0 to 30.0) | `+5.0 / -0.0` | `fF/cell` | Scribe MOS Test Array / LCR Meter |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | `< 1.0` | Upper Spec Limit: `1.0` | `fA/cell` | Precision I-V Parameter Analyzer |

---

### 3. Context Citations & Traceability

1. **Gate Dielectric Thickness & Precision:**
   - *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*
   - *"Dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) measured with sub-Angstrom precision (±0.05 nm)... Wafer Mapping: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs."*
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*

2. **Capacitor Stack EOT & Dielectric Properties:**
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - *"In 180nm nodes, stacked capacitors (Crown or Cylinder type) utilize silicon nitride (Si3N4) or tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) high-k dielectrics with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around 3 to 4 nm."*

3. **Storage Capacitance Budget & Leakage Target:**
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*

   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - *"The storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF (femtofarads) per cell to ensure data retention time > 64 ms at 85°C."*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOS Test Capacitor Array Mask & Shadow Pad Deposition

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-FEOL-180-MOSCAP-001`  
**Classification:** Front-End Fabrication / Metrology Test Vehicle Preparation  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > MOS Test Capacitor Array Mask & Shadow Pad Deposition  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  P-type 100 Si Wafer   │
│  with Gate Dielectric  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Backside Ohmic     │
│    Contact Sputter     │
│       Deposition       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Precision Shadow    │
│    Mask Alignment &    │
│       Fixturing        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   PVD Sputtering of    │
│      Top Circular      │
│   Aluminum Gate Dots   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Post-Deposition     │
│   Forming Gas Anneal   │
│         (FGA)          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Automated C-V      │
│      Metrology &       │
│   Acceptance Testing   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the fabrication protocol for patterning top-gate circular aluminum electrode pads and substrate backside ohmic metallization on P-type (100) Si test wafers with thermally grown or high-$\kappa$ gate dielectric layers ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $25\text{ nm}$ physical/EOT thickness). The resulting Planar MOS Capacitor (MOSCAP) test array enables precision high-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static capacitance-voltage ($C$-$V$) profiling, interface trap density ($D_{it}$) extraction, and dielectric thickness verification.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Substrate Preparation & Backside Oxide Strip
1. Retrieve the P-type (100) Si test wafer exiting gate dielectric thermal oxidation ($t_{ox} \sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ to $25\text{ nm}$).
2. Protect the frontside gate dielectric using a protective frontside chuck or sacrificial photoresist coating.
3. Perform a localized backside dip in dilute HF ($1\%-2\%$, $30\text{ s}$) to remove stray native/thermal oxide from the wafer backside down to bare P-type silicon, followed by a deionized (DI) water cascade rinse and spin dry ($N_2$).

#### Step 2: Backside Substrate Ohmic Contact Metallization
1. Load wafer into the Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) DC magnetron sputter system.
2. Pump down process chamber to base pressure $P_{base} \le 5.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ Torr}$.
3. Sputter deposit a backside ohmic contact layer of **Gold (Au)** or **Aluminum (Al)**:
   - Target thickness: $150\text{ nm} - 200\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure uniform blanket coverage across the entire unpolished backside surface.

#### Step 3: Precision Shadow Mask Alignment & Mechanical Clamping
1. Clean the precision laser-machined or electroformed metal shadow mask with circular apertures corresponding to:
   - Dot Diameter 1: **$200\ \mu\text{m}$** ($\text{Area} = 3.14 \times 10^{-4}\text{ cm}^2$)
   - Dot Diameter 2: **$500\ \mu\text{m}$** ($\text{Area} = 1.96 \times 10^{-3}\text{ cm}^2$)
   - Dot Diameter 3: **$1000\ \mu\text{m}$** ($\text{Area} = 7.85 \times 10^{-3}\text{ cm}^2$)
2. Mount the frontside of the wafer directly facing the shadow mask.
3. Secure the perimeter mechanical fixture with uniform clamping torque to prevent gap formation and eliminate metal vapor penumbra / edge-fringing.

#### Step 4: Top-Gate Circular Aluminum Dot Deposition
1. Transfer fixtured shadow-mask/wafer assembly into the metal PVD sputter chamber.
2. Evacuate chamber to base pressure $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ Torr}$; establish Ar sputter gas flow at process pressure $3.0\text{ mTorr} - 5.0\text{ mTorr}$.
3. Sputter deposit high-purity **Aluminum (Al, $99.999\%$)**:
   - Film thickness: $200\text{ nm} - 300\text{ nm}$.
   - Substrate platen temperature: $\le 80^\circ\text{C}$ to prevent thermal dielectric pinhole degradation and stress cracking.

#### Step 5: Post-Deposition Forming Gas Anneal (FGA)
1. Unload wafer from the shadow mask fixture in a Class 10/100 laminar clean hood.
2. Transfer wafer to a horizontal quartz tube furnace for contact alloying and defect passivating:
   - Atmosphere: Forming Gas ($5\%\ \text{H}_2\ /\ 95\%\ \text{N}_2$).
   - Temperature: $400^\circ\text{C} - 425^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ minutes}$.
   - Purpose: Establish stable ohmic interfaces and minimize dangling bond interface trap states ($D_{it}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Electrode Dot Diameters** | $200 \pm 2$, $500 \pm 5$, $1000 \pm 10$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Automated Optical Metrology / CD-SEM |
| **High-Frequency Test Frequency** | $1.0 \pm 0.01$ | $\text{MHz}$ | LCR Meter / High-Frequency $C$-$V$ Analyzer |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$) Precision** | $\pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from Accumulation $C_{ox}$ ($V_G < V_{fb}$) |
| **Dielectric Physical Thickness Window** | $3.5$ to $25.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / $C$-$V$ Calibration |

---

### 4. Verified Context & Literature Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric Thickness & Baseline Oxidation Parameters:**
   - Physical oxide baseline for 180nm nodes is $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$, scaled up to $25\text{ nm}$ across diagnostic stages.
   - *Source:* `Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction`; `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`.
2. **Top-Gate & Backside Metallization Architecture:**
   - Circular aluminum gate dots deposited through shadow masks at discrete diameters of $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ on P-type (100) Si.
   - Backside substrate contact formed with Au or Al ohmic layer.
   - *Source:* `Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction`.
3. **C-V Metrology & Thickness Precision:**
   - High-frequency testing performed at $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - Maximum oxide accumulation capacitance yields physical oxide thickness $t_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox} \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / C_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.
   - *Source:* `Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction`.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

#### Process Flowchart

```text
│      Metrology &      │
│      Inspection       │
│                       │

```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **CAD/CAM Stencil Layout & Offset Generation**:
   - Layout Gen 2 circular/square pad apertures (150 $\mu\text{m}$ to 500 $\mu\text{m}$ nominal diameter) on a 1.0 mm pitch array in GDSII/DXF format.
   - Embed alignment fiducials matching the optical viewing axis of the split-field binocular microscope with dual CMOS cameras.
   - Apply beam-kerf compensation (inward vector offset of 10–15 $\mu\text{m}$) corresponding to calibrated laser cut spot dimensions.

2. **Substrate Preparation & Tension Mounting**:
   - Clean 50 $\mu\text{m}$ thick low-expansion Invar / SUS304 foil via sequential ultrasonic baths in acetone (5 min), isopropanol (5 min), and DI water rinse.
   - Mount and clamp foil onto a flat tensioning frame to secure planar flatness across the patterned array.

3. **Laser Micro-Machining & Direct Ablation**:
   - Secure the tension frame on the CNC micro-machining vacuum chuck.
   - Perform aperture profiling using a pulsed UV (355 nm) or fiber picosecond laser under coaxial $N_2$ assist gas (2.0 bar) to cut aperture walls with minimal heat-affected zones.

4. **Deburring & Ultrasonic Clean**:
   - Immerse the machined mask into a chemical deburring/micro-etch bath for 30 s to strip recast slag and micro-burrs along aperture peripheries.
   - Rinse in high-purity cascade DI water and dry under filtered $N_2$ at 110°C.

5. **Dimensional Metrology & Storage**:
   - Inspect aperture clearance, hole roundness, and perimeter burrs using the dual CMOS camera metrology station.
   - Package in an anti-static nitrogen desiccator box for evaporation/sputter deposition transfer.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aperture Diameter Tolerance** | $\pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical coordinate microscope / CMOS video gauge |
| **Aperture Edge Burr Roughness ($R_a$)** | $< 1.5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | White-light optical profilometer |
| **Foil In-Plane Planarity (Warp/Bow)** | $< 15.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Non-contact laser displacement sensor |
| **Heat-Affected Zone (HAZ)** | $< 8.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Calibrated metallurgical microscope |

---

### 3. Target Electrical & Dielectric Reference Metrics

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░                                │
       Leakage Limit┤░░                                │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Capacitance Target┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
SiO2 Gate Dielectric┤▓▓▓▓▓                             │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓                             │
       EOT Thickness┤█████                             │
                    │█████                             │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0       7       14      21      28 
```
- **Capacitance Target**: $\ge 28.0\text{ fF/cell}$ minimum budget.
- **Leakage Limit**: $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Gate Dielectric Thickness**: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$.
- **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)**: $3.0\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ stack.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric & EOT Baseline**:
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*
   - *"stacked capacitors (Crown or Cylinder type) utilize silicon nitride (Si3N4) or tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) high-k dielectrics with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around 3 to 4 nm."*
2. **Capacitance & Retention Criteria**:
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
   - *"Minimum 28 fF per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance."*
   - *"Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval"*
3. **Alignment & Inspection Optics**:
   - *Source: Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose*
