# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Shadow Mask Alignment & Thermal Evaporation of Aluminum Dot Array

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-FE-0042`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & MOS C-V Dielectric Metrology > MOS Test Capacitor Array Mask & Shadow Pad Deposition > Shadow Mask Alignment & Thermal Evaporation of Aluminum Dot Array  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Substrate & Shadow   │
│       Mask Prep       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Fixture Alignment &  │
│       Clamping        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Vacuum Pumpdown <   │
│       2e-6 Torr       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Thermal Evaporation  │
│         of Al         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Cooling & Venting   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  MOS C-V Metrology &  │
│      Acceptance       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Mask Preparation:**
   - Inspect the test wafer carrying the high-k / thermally grown thin oxide layer ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness).
   - Clean the precision laser-cut molybdenum/beryllium-copper shadow mask in anhydrous isopropyl alcohol (IPA) and dry under filtered $\text{N}_2$.
   - Load high-purity (5N / 99.999%) Aluminum evaporation pellets or wire into the tungsten boat or basket source.

2. **Shadow Mask Alignment & Mechanical Clamping:**
   - Mount the test wafer on the substrate platen in the tooling stage.
   - Align the shadow mask aperture array over designated test capacitor test areas.
   - Secure the mask flush against the dielectric surface with magnetic backing or spring-loaded mechanical clamps to minimize edge penumbra and vapor bleed.

3. **Chamber Load & High-Vacuum Pumpdown:**
   - Transfer the clamped assembly into the thermal evaporator chamber and face downward to the source.
   - Seal the chamber and initiate roughing and high-vacuum turbomolecular/cryopump cycle until chamber base pressure pumps down below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to prevent oxygen incorporation into the depositing aluminum dots.

4. **Thermal Evaporation:**
   - Pre-condition the Al charge by ramping filament current with the source shutter closed to degas volatile surface species.
   - Open the shutter and adjust source current to deposit aluminum at a calibrated deposition rate of $50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/minute}$ monitored via quartz crystal microbalance (QCM).
   - Terminate deposition once target physical thickness is achieved ($350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$).

5. **Post-Deposition Cool-Down & Vent:**
   - Turn off filament current and allow the substrate and boat to cool down under high vacuum until temperature drops below $100^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Backfill chamber with dry $\text{N}_2$ to atmospheric pressure, unclamp mask, and transfer wafer to wafer cassette for metrology.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | Calibrated Bayard-Alpert ion gauge / vacuum transducer |
| **Al Deposition Rate** | $50\text{ to }100$ | $\text{nm/min}$ | In-situ calibrated Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) |
| **Film Thickness Target** | $350 \pm 5\%$ ($332.5\text{ to }367.5$) | $\text{nm}$ | Stylus profilometry / Spectroscopic ellipsometry |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | $\Omega/\square$ | Four-point probe (following $400^\circ\text{C}$, 30 min $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ 95/5 anneal) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source:** *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*
  - Vacuum chamber base pressure requirement: $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to prevent oxygen incorporation.
  - Source purity: $99.999\%$ (5N) Aluminum.
  - Deposition rate: $50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/minute}$.
  - Target thickness: $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - Sheet resistance metric: $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\square$ after post-metal anneal ($400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ minutes}$ in forming gas $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$).
- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - MOS dielectric interface: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness for capacitance metrology benchmarking.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Capacitor Area Profilometry & Post-Deposition Forming Gas Anneal

- **Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-FE-CAP-042`
- **Revision:** 2.0 (Gen 2 µm / 180nm Baseline)
- **Hierarchy:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > MOS Test Capacitor Array Mask & Shadow Pad Deposition > Metrology & Thermal Processing
- **Owner:** DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council (Domain Expert AI)

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Clean Surface & Load  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Stylus Profilometry   │
│      Step Height       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Area & Pad Dimension  │
│      Verification      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Load into Quartz    │
│        Furnace         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Forming Gas Anneal   │
│    400°C-450°C N2/H2   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Cooldown & MOS C-V   │
│       Inspection       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Substrate Preparation & Vacuum Stage Loading
1. Verify front-side MOS test capacitor array shadow pads (deposited over $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / ONO or thin dielectric stacks) are free of organic residue and particulate contamination.
2. Transfer wafer via vacuum wand onto the automated mechanical stylus profilometer vacuum chuck.

#### Step 2: Contact Stylus Profilometry & Area Metrology
1. Align the optical crosshair to the perimeter edge of the shadow-evaporated/sputtered metal top electrode pad.
2. Program a scan length across the boundary step height:
   - **Stylus Force:** $1.0\text{ to }3.0\text{ mg}$ to avoid soft-metal gouging.
   - **Scan Speed:** $5\text{ to }10\ \mu\text{m/s}$ across the transition boundary.
3. Extract physical electrode step thickness and pad diameter/edge dimensions across 5 die sites (Center, North, South, East, West).
4. Compute effective capacitor geometric area ($A_{\text{eff}}$) for subsequent area-normalized dielectric parameterization ($\text{fF}/\mu\text{m}^2$).

#### Step 3: Atmosphere Purge & Furnace Loading
1. Transfer profilometry-verified wafers into a horizontal atmospheric quartz diffusion/anneal tube furnace.
2. Initiate high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$, $99.999\%$) pre-purge at $10\text{ to }15\text{ SLM}$ for 15 minutes to reduce ambient $\text{O}_2$ below $5\text{ ppm}$.

#### Step 4: Post-Deposition Forming Gas Anneal (FGA)
1. Switch gas flow to forming gas mixture ($90\text{–}95\%\ \text{N}_2\ /\ 5\text{–}10\%\ \text{H}_2$).
2. Ramp furnace temperature to the standard metallization contact passivation window of **$400^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }450^\circ\text{C}$** at $5^\circ\text{C/min}$.
3. Dwell at **$400^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }450^\circ\text{C}$** for **$30\text{ minutes}$** under forming gas ambient to passivate interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$) at the semiconductor/dielectric boundary and sinter contact interfaces.

#### Step 5: Post-Anneal Cooldown & Handoff to MOS C-V
1. Switch gas manifold back to pure $\text{N}_2$ flush; ramp down temperature below $150^\circ\text{C}$ prior to tube boat pull.
2. Unload wafer to dry nitrogen cooling cassette for handoff to MOS C-V and dielectric leakage metrology.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Operational Target Metric | Physical Units | Tolerance / Limits |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Profilometer Scan Repeatability** | $1\sigma \le 0.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Step height reproducibility on 5 reference points |
| **Capacitor Pad Lateral Dimension** | Per target pad mask diameter | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ across $5$-point wafer map |
| **Forming Gas Anneal Temperature** | $400\text{ to }450$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 2.0\ ^\circ\text{C}$ furnace flat-zone stability |
| **Equivalent Cell Capacitance Target** | $\ge 25\text{ to }30$ (scaled cell reference) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Minimum $28\ \text{fF/cell}$ budget for retention $> 64\ \text{ms}$ |
| **Capacitor Dielectric Leakage** | $\le 1.0$ (cell-normalized @ $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | At nominal operating voltage condition |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $\ge 28\ \text{fF/cell}$ to maintain signal margin and noise immunity against bitline coupling.
  - Leakage current target $\le 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Storage dielectric options: $\text{ONO}$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, and $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-k stacks ($\kappa > 15$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Storage capacitor retention requirement: $25\text{ to }30\ \text{fF/cell}$ for retention time $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window: $3\text{ to }4\ \text{nm}$.
- **Source: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**
  - Refractive index standard $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\ \text{nm}$ for stoichiometric dielectric $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ layers.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness Calibration

**Task Title:** Multi-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line [Front-End Fabrication] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & MOS C-V Dielectric Metrology [Metrology] > Multi-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness Calibration [Metrology]  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Role:** Domain Expert AI, DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Start: Wafer Loading  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Goniometer & Laser   │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Multi-Angle Spectral  │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Cauchy/Sellmeier    │
│     Model Fitting      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│   Validation & Wafer   │
│        Mapping         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Alignment & Stage Loading:**
   - Transfer the thermal gate oxide or capacitor dielectric wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the spectroscopic ellipsometer.
   - Engage vacuum hold and execute automatic notch/flat optical centering.

2. **Goniometer Initialization & Optical Beam Alignment:**
   - Calibrate the goniometer zero angle and reference detector alignment using the clean reference silicon substrate.
   - Configure the source beam through the polarizer-compensator optical train to verify beam intensity across the ultraviolet-visible-near infrared spectrum.

3. **Multi-Angle Spectral Acquisition ($\Psi, \Delta$):**
   - Direct the polarized beam onto the sample across designated incident angles (e.g., $65^\circ, 70^\circ, 75^\circ$ around the Brewster angle of silicon).
   - Record the polarization change angles $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ according to the fundamental ellipsometric ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ denote the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.

4. **Dispersion Modeling & Layer Inversion:**
   - Apply a validated optical dispersion model:
     - Use a **Cauchy dispersion model** or **Sellmeier dispersion model** to parameterize refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ for transparent thin dielectrics ($\text{SiO}_2$, $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$).
   - Fit layer physical thickness ($t$) and optical constants against acquired $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra via Levenberg-Marquardt regression minimization ($\text{MSE} \to \min$).

5. **Wafer Non-Uniformity Mapping:**
   - Execute an automated **9-point** or **49-point wafer map** across concentric radial coordinates to characterize radial film non-uniformity across spin coating or furnace dry oxidation runs.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Boundary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | `3.5` | `nm` | `±0.05 nm` (sub-Angstrom precision) |
| **Photoresist Layer Thickness ($t_{\text{PR}}$)** | `1.3` | `µm` | `±2 nm` |
| **Automated Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | `9` or `49` | `points/wafer` | Exact grid point match |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) for Stacked Cap Dielectric** | `3 to 4` | `nm` | Target window for 180nm cell retention |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Traceability

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
   - *Physical Principle & Equation:* $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ using Fresnel reflection coefficients.
   - *Modeling:* Cauchy and Sellmeier dispersion models for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
   - *Measurement Precision & Targets:* Dry gate oxide target of $3.5\text{ nm}$ with $\pm0.05\text{ nm}$ precision; photoresist layer at $1.3\text{ \mu m}$ with $\pm2\text{ nm}$ precision.
   - *Mapping:* Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping protocols tracking radial furnace and spin coating non-uniformity.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - *Dielectric Thickness Context:* Gate dielectric thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; stacked capacitor high-$k$ dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - *Stack Integration:* Stacked capacitor dielectric layer baseline (ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$).
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** High-Frequency Quasi-Static MOS C-V Profiling & EOT Extraction  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Front-End Metrology Line  
**Document Link:** [docs/sop_hf_qs_mos_cv_profiling_eot.md](docs/sop_hf_qs_mos_cv_profiling_eot.md)

---

#### 1. Workflow Architecture & Sequence

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Start: MOSCAP Wafer   │
│        Loading         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Backside Ohmic     │
│     Contact Check      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   HF 1 MHz C-V Sweep   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Quasi-Static C-V    │
│          Ramp          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Cox Saturation & EOT  │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Acceptance Gate     │
│        Decision        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Vehicle Mounting & Backside Ohmic Verification**:
   - Secure the P-type (100) Si test wafer onto the probe station gold-plated vacuum chuck inside a dark, shielded Faraday box.
   - Verify low-resistance substrate grounding through the backside Gold (Au) or Aluminum (Al) contact layer.
   - Position micro-probes on clean Aluminum top gate dots ($200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, or $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter) sputtered through shadow masks over the oxide layer ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $25\text{ nm}$).

2. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Profiling**:
   - Apply a small AC probing signal: $f = 1\text{ MHz}$, $v_{ac} = 20\text{ mV RMS}$.
   - Sweep DC bias from inversion ($V_G > V_T$) into accumulation ($V_G < V_{fb}$ for P-type substrate, e.g., $+2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow -2.5\text{ V}$).
   - Record capacitance saturation in strong accumulation ($C_{max} = C_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0\text{Area}}{t_{ox}}$) and verify that HF capacitance does not recover in inversion due to minority carrier generation limitations.

3. **Quasi-Static (QS) Inversion & Interface Profiling**:
   - Transition instrumentation to quasi-static electrometer mode ($dV/dt = 20\text{ mV/s}$).
   - Ramp gate voltage across the same potential span in light-tight equilibrium conditions to measure displacement current:
     $$I_{QS}(V_G) = C_{QS}(V_G) \cdot \frac{dV_G}{dt}$$
   - Verify low-frequency recovery where $C_{QS}$ returns to $C_{ox}$ in strong inversion ($V_G > V_T$).

4. **Physical Thickness & EOT Extraction**:
   - Determine $C_{ox}$ from the plateau of the HF accumulation trace at strong negative bias.
   - Extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness using:
     $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{SiO2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot \pi (d/2)^2}{C_{ox}}$$
     where $\varepsilon_{SiO2} = 3.9$, $\varepsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}$, and $d \in \{200, 500, 1000\}\ \mu\text{m}$.

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        Target Acceptance Limits        
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Min Cap (fF/cell)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
  EOT High-k (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                               │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒                               │
 EOT Gate Ox (nm)┤██████                               │
                 │██████                               │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0        7       14       21       28 
```

1. **Gate Dielectric Physical/EOT Thickness**: $\mathbf{3.5 \pm 0.1\text{ nm}}$ (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ measured via HF $1\text{ MHz}$ $C_{ox}$ saturation).
2. **High-k Stack Capacitor EOT**: $\mathbf{3.0\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}}$ ($\kappa > 15$ with $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$/ONO stacks).
3. **Storage Cell Capacitance Budget**: $\mathbf{\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}}$ (acceptable cell window $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ to preserve data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
4. **Leakage Current Ceiling**: $\mathbf{< 1\text{ fA/cell}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (sub-threshold and junction limit).

---

#### 4. Context Literature Citations
- **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Test structure geometry: circular Al gate dots ($200\ \mu\text{m}, 500\ \mu\text{m}, 1000\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter) on P-type (100) Si; Au or Al backside substrate ohmic contact; $1\text{ MHz}$ accumulation saturation $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0\text{Area})/t_{ox}$ resolving $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision; QS inversion recovery vs HF minimum.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Gate oxide dry thermal oxidation target of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$; high-k dielectric stack EOT target of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; cell storage capacitance target range of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Minimum capacitance floor of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; high-k dielectric effective constant $\kappa > 15$; sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** MOS Dot-Capacitor Test Structure Back-Contact Preparation & Probe Station Setup  
**Module:** Metrology / High-Frequency Quasi-Static MOS C-V Profiling & EOT Extraction  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & MOS C-V Dielectric Metrology > High-Frequency Quasi-Static MOS C-V Profiling & EOT Extraction > MOS Dot-Capacitor Test Structure Back-Contact Preparation & Probe Station Setup  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Backside Native     │
│     Oxide Strip 1      │
│       percent HF       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Backside Ohmic     │
│  Metallization 200nm   │
│       Al or GaIn       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Chuck Vacuum Mount &  │
│   Shielded Probe Box   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Microchamber Purge   │
│   N2 & Triaxial Dark   │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Substrate Ohmic     │
│  Grounding & Top Dot   │
│        Landing         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Backside Native Oxide Removal & De-glaze:**
   - Protect the top wafer surface containing the MOS dot capacitors (with ~3.5 nm thermally grown SiO₂ gate dielectric or 3 to 4 nm EOT high-k Ta₂O₅/Al₂O₃ / ONO dielectric dots) using a frontside spin-coat layer of protective photoresist.
   - Dip/swab the wafer backside in dilute HF (1% to 2% aqueous solution) for 30 s to strip native oxide until the silicon surface becomes completely hydrophobic.
   - DI water rinse and blow dry with ultra-pure filtered $N_2$.

2. **Back-Contact Ohmic Formation:**
   - For rapid bench metrology: Apply a uniform scratch/rub coat of high-purity Gallium-Indium (Ga-In) eutectic paste directly onto the bare Si backside to establish a degenerate, low-resistance ohmic contact.
   - For standard fabrication lots: Deposit a 200 nm Aluminum (Al) back-contact metallization layer via physical vapor deposition (PVD sputtering or thermal evaporator), followed by rapid thermal annealing (RTA) in forming gas ($N_2/H_2$) at 400°C for 5 minutes.
   - Strip frontside protective photoresist using an acetone/IPA ultrasonic bath and dry under $N_2$.

3. **Probe Station Platen & Triaxial Chuck Setup:**
   - Secure the wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck of a shielded microchamber probe station.
   - Verify continuous chuck vacuum hold ($\ge 70\text{ kPa}$ depression).
   - Ensure the probe station's dark box enclosure is sealed to completely eliminate ambient photon-assisted carrier generation during quasi-static and high-frequency C-V profiling.
   - Ground the substrate through the gold-plated chuck using guarded triaxial cabling connected to the LCR meter / SMU low terminal ($V_{low}$ / Force Low).

4. **Microchamber Nitrogen Purge & Dark Environment:**
   - Purge the dark enclosure with dry $N_2$ ($RH < 5\%$) to prevent moisture condensation and parasitic surface conduction paths during metrology sweeps.
   - Allow thermal stabilization at standard room temperature ($25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) or heated chuck stage ($85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for DRAM retention/leakage benchmark conditions).

5. **Top Dot Microchamber Probe Landing:**
   - Align tungsten or beryllium-copper microprobe tips (tip radius $\le 5\ \mu\text{m}$) over the frontside gate metal/polysilicon dot test pad under microscope optics.
   - Lower the manipulator with precise micro-stepper control until initial electrical contact is registered; apply an overdrive travel of 10 to 15 $\mu\text{m}$ to pierce surface passivating oxides without punching through thin dielectric layers (~3.5 nm physical thickness).
   - Route probe signal through a guarded triaxial probe arm to the high terminal ($V_{high}$ / Force High / Sense High).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Acceptance Threshold Limits (Upper Bound)
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░░░░░░░░░                      │
  Probe Overdrive (um)┤░░░░░░░░░░                      │
                      │▒▒                              │
 Dark Box Leakage (fA)┤▒▒                              │
    Chuck Stray C (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                      │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Back-Contact R_c (ohm)┤███████                         │
                      │███████                         │
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                      0.0    12.5    25.0   37.5   50.0 
```

1. **Back-Contact Ohmic Series Resistance ($R_{series}$ / $R_c$):**  
   - **Target Metric:** $\le 10.0\ \Omega$ (measured across wafer back-contact to chuck ground before C-V sweep).
2. **Open-Circuit Background Stray Capacitance:**  
   - **Target Metric:** $\le 50.0\text{ fF}$ (residual probe-to-chuck parasitic capacitance post-open calibration, well below cell budget $C_s = 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$).
3. **Dark Box Baseline Parasitic Leakage Current:**  
   - **Target Metric:** $\le 1.0\text{ fA}$ at $V_{bias} = 1.0\text{ V}$ and $85.0^\circ\text{C}$ enclosure temperature (matching the sub-1 fA DRAM storage retention leakage threshold).
4. **Manipulator Probe Overdrive Travel Tolerance:**  
   - **Target Metric:** $12.5 \pm 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$ (travel range 10.0 to 15.0 $\mu\text{m}$ to safeguard the ~3.5 nm thin gate dielectric from mechanical punch-through).

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**  
  - Target cell capacitance baseline of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell (data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown by dry oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$), requiring low overdrive landing.
  - High-k dielectric equivalent oxide thickness ($\text{EOT}$) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**  
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage threshold limit $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ validating triaxial guard calibration requirements.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**  
  - Baseline nominal storage cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ compared against bitline parasitics $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: High-Frequency (100kHz–1MHz) & Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition
- **Module**: Metrology / MOS C-V Dielectric Metrology & EOT Extraction
- **Process Line**: Front-End Fabrication / High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line
- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)

---

## 1. Process Workflow & Methodology

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Wafer Load &     │
│     Light-Tight      │
│      Shielding       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Probe Calibration:  │
│   Open/Short/Load    │
│      Correction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  High-Frequency C-V  │
│  Sweep: 100 kHz - 1  │
│         MHz          │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Quasi-Static C-V   │
│   Sweep: Ramp Rate   │
│        dV/dt         │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Simultaneous     │
│  Extraction: C_ox,   │
│      EOT, D_it       │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Test Structure Selection & Wafer Setup**:
   - Transfer the 180nm test wafer onto the triaxial thermal chuck inside the light-tight, electrically shielded probe station.
   - Establish substrate backside contact (ground reference) and align microprobes to the MOS capacitor test pads corresponding to access transistor dummy gates and capacitor dielectric test structures.

2. **LCR & Electrometer Calibration**:
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit compensation on the LCR meter / impedance analyzer up to the probe tip plane across the $100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$ band.
   - Verify cabling parasitic capacitance nulling and zero-offset current verification on the quasi-static electrometer.

3. **High-Frequency (HF) C-V Acquisition**:
   - Set AC oscillation voltage level to $V_{ac} = 25\text{ mV}_\text{rms}$ at frequencies of $100\text{ kHz}$ and $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - Apply a continuous DC bias sweep ranging from accumulation to deep inversion (and reverse sweep to detect hysteresis / mobile ions), ensuring that the minority carrier response is suppressed at high frequency.
   - Record accumulation capacitance ($C_{ox}$) in strong accumulation.

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Acquisition**:
   - Apply a slow linear voltage ramp ($dV/dt$) using the quasi-static electrometer or ramp-rate unit to allow thermal equilibrium of inversion layer minority carriers.
   - Measure displacement current $I_{meas}$ to calculate low-frequency capacitance:
     $$C_{QS} = \frac{I_{meas}}{dV/dt}$$
   - Validate leakage suppression to ensure gate leakage does not distort the quasi-static curve.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) & EOT Parameter Extraction**:
   - Superimpose the high-frequency ($100\text{ kHz} - 1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static ($C_{QS}$) curves.
   - Compute interface trap density ($D_{it}$) using the High-Low frequency method:
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{QS}}{C_{ox} - C_{QS}} - \frac{C_{HF}}{C_{ox} - C_{HF}} \right)$$
   - Calculate Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) from strong accumulation capacitance per unit area:
     $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_{SiO2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{ox}}$$

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                    Dielectric Thickness Bounds (nm)    
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
Physical Tox SiO2┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
   EOT High-k max┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
```

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Quantum-Corrected C-V Modeling, EOT & Interface State Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180-QCV-001`  
**Process Line:** High-K Gate Dielectric & Thin Film Thermal Oxidation Line [Front-End Fabrication]  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 µm Architecture)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   MOS Dot Structure    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │    │                        │
│   High-Frequency C-V   │    │    Quasi-Static C-V    │
│                        │    │                        │
└───────────┬────────────┘    └────────────┬───────────┘
            │                              │
            │ ╭────────────────────────────╯
            ▼ ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Quantum C-V       │
│       Correction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │    │                        │
│   EOT Extraction 3-4   │    │     Dit Extraction     │
│           nm           │    │                        │
│                        │    │                        │
└───────────┬────────────┘    └────────────┬───────────┘
            │                              │
            │ ╭────────────────────────────╯
            ▼ ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Dielectric Metrology  │
│          Pass          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Wafer Loading & Probe Setup
1. Mount the 180nm monitor wafer with designated MOS capacitor test dots and access transistor test structures ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) on a temperature-controlled chuck stabilized at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (with secondary qualification at $85.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Secure Kelvin micro-probes on the gate top contact and substrate/well back-contact inside a light-tight, electrically shielded Faraday cage to eliminate stray displacement currents.

#### Step 2: High-Frequency (HF) Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) Acquisition
1. Connect the LCR impedance analyzer in parallel-equivalent mode ($C_p - G_p$).
2. Apply a small AC oscillation signal of $15\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ at $100\text{ kHz}$ and $1.0\text{ MHz}$.
3. Sweep the DC gate bias $V_G$ from accumulation ($-2.5\text{ V}$) through depletion to strong inversion ($+2.5\text{ V}$) at a step resolution $\le 20\text{ mV}$.
4. Perform Series Resistance ($R_s$) correction on the measured raw capacitance $C_{ma}$ and conductance $G_{ma}$:
   $$C_{hf} = \frac{(G_{ma}^2 + \omega^2 C_{ma}^2) C_{ma}}{[\omega C_{ma} - (G_{ma}^2 + \omega^2 C_{ma}^2) R_s \omega]^2 + G_{ma}^2}$$

#### Step 3: Quasi-Static (QS) Low-Frequency C-V Acquisition
1. Switch to the electrometer quasi-static C-V test head.
2. Initialize zero-bias equilibrium and sweep $V_G$ from accumulation to inversion at a linear ramp rate of $0.10\text{ V/s}$ ($dV/dt$), recording displacement current $I_{qs}$:
   $$C_{qs}(V_G) = \frac{I_{qs}(V_G)}{dV/dt}$$
3. Confirm absence of transient displacement charging anomalies or leakage distortions before modeling.

#### Step 4: Quantum-Mechanical (QM) Schrodinger-Poisson Fitting & EOT Extraction
1. Import corrected HF C-V curves into the 1D self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson numerical solver.
2. Incorporate quantum carrier confinement in the silicon substrate (inversion/accumulation layer quantum capacitance offset $\Delta z \approx 0.3 - 0.5\text{ nm}$) and polysilicon gate depletion effects ($C_{\text{poly}}$).
3. Match the simulated quantum capacitance curve against measured accumulation capacitance ($C_{acc}$):
   $$\frac{1}{C_{tot}} = \frac{1}{C_{ox}} + \frac{1}{C_{qm}} + \frac{1}{C_{poly}}$$
4. Extract the physical Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT):
   $$\text{EOT} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot A_{\text{dot}}}{C_{ox}}$$
   where $\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} = 3.9$ and $A_{\text{dot}}$ is the calibrated lithographic capacitor area.

#### Step 5: High-Low Frequency Interface State Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction
1. Align the surface potential $\psi_s(V_G)$ extracted from the integration of the quasi-static curve (Berglund integral):
   $$\psi_s(V_G) = \int_{V_{FB}}^{V_G} \left(1 - \frac{C_{qs}}{C_{ox}}\right) dV$$
2. Calculate the interface trap capacitance $C_{it}(\psi_s)$ using the combined High-Low method:
   $$C_{it} = \left(\frac{1}{C_{qs}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1} - \left(\frac{1}{C_{hf}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1}$$
3. Extract interface trap density across the silicon bandgap:
   $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{it}}{q \cdot A_{\text{dot}}}$$
4. Quantify mid-gap $D_{it}$ ($E - E_v \approx 0.56\text{ eV}$) and flag any excessive border or fast interface traps.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░                               │
      Tox Physical┤░░░░░                               │
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
        C_s Budget┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     Dit (Mid-gap)┤▒▒▒▒                                │
                  │▒▒▒▒                                │
EOT (Quantum-Corr)┤█████                               │
                  │█████                               │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Range | Tolerance / Physical Limit | Measurement Unit | Inspection Tool / Verification Mechanism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capacitor Dielectric EOT** | **$3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$** | $\pm 0.15\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | 1D Schrödinger-Poisson Fit / High-Frequency MOS C-V Profiler |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | **$\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$** (Dry $\text{SiO}_2$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$) | $\pm 0.10\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Quantum C-V Accumulation Extraction |
| **Interface State Density ($D_{it}$)** | **$\le 2.0 \times 10^{10}$** at mid-gap | Upper ceiling: $5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low ($C_{qs} - C_{hf}$) Differential Metrology |
| **Cell Capacitance Yield Floor ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$** ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ nominal) | Leakage $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked Crown/Cylinder Array Metrology at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

1. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Dictates equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window: *"stacked capacitors (Crown or Cylinder type) utilize silicon nitride (Si3N4) or tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) high-k dielectrics with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around 3 to 4 nm."*
   - Defines gate dielectric baseline: *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*
   - Validates cell charge storage envelope: *"The storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF per cell to ensure data retention time > 64 ms at 85°C."*

2. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Prescribes unit geometry and capacitance targets: *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm."*
   - Sets physical soft-error noise barrier: *"Capacitance Budget: Minimum 28 fF per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance."*
   - Enforces thermal leakage bound: *"Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval."*

3. **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Verifies operational readout boundary conditions: *"Differential Voltage Delta V = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - V_DD/2). For typical cell capacitance C_s = 25 fF and bitline capacitance C_BL = 250 fF, signal delta V is approximately 100 mV to 150 mV."*

```text
│          Test          │

└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Sputter Degas & In-Situ RF Etch**:
   - Transfer wafer into the ultra-high vacuum (UHV) multi-chamber sputtering cluster tool.
   - Perform degas bake and low-power in-situ Ar+ soft sputter etch to remove native oxide on exposed contact plugs (W-plugs) without degrading dielectric interfaces.
2. **Barrier & Seed Layer Magnetron Sputtering**:
   - Sputter a conformal barrier/liner layer (Ti / TiN) followed by metallization seed to prevent electromigration and contact interdiffusion over bitline and wordline contact interfaces.
3. **Interconnect Metallization & Patterning**:
   - Deposit top-level interconnect metal (Al-Cu / Cu alloy) targeted to accommodate tight bitline/wordline line pitches.
   - Execute lithography, metal reactive ion etching (RIE), or CMP planarization followed by final passivation layer deposition (SiO2/Si3N4) and bond pad opening etch.
4. **Die Packaging Probe Station Setup & Alignment**:
   - Mount processed wafer onto the thermal vacuum chuck of the packaging probe station.
   - Set chuck temperature to **85°C** to simulate worst-case retention and leakage conditions.
   - Align multi-contact wedge probe card to peripheral I/O bond pads and test structure pads (TEG) with micro-positioning accuracy.
5. **Electrical Parametric & Yield Characterization**:
   - Apply precharge potential $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ to complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$).
   - Assert wordlines to actuate access transistors and measure differential read signal voltage ($\Delta V$).
   - Run sub-threshold/junction leakage parameter sweep on the cell array and record capacitor retention parameters.

---

| **Readout Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | Range $[100, 150]$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded-bitline Sense Amplifier probe readout |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: M1/M2 Metallization Sputtering & Ti/TiN Barrier Deposition Recipe Execution
- **Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station [Back-End Packaging] > M1/M2 Metallization Sputtering & Ti/TiN Barrier Deposition Recipe Execution [Interconnect & Thin Film Deposition]
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Process Overview & Chamber Preparation
```text
[ Load Wafer & Pump Down ] ──> [ Ar Working Gas Strike ] ──> [ DC Magnetron Sputter ] ──> [ Forming Gas Anneal ]
   Base P < 2x10^-6 Torr         Ar: 3 - 5 mTorr              Power: 1.5 - 3.0 kW          400°C, 30 min (N2/H2)
```

1. **Chamber Evacuation & Base Vacuum:**
   - Transfer wafer into the PVD load lock and pump down main vacuum chamber using turbomolecular or cryopump until base pressure reaches **$< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$** to suppress oxygen incorporation.
2. **Process Gas Introduction:**
   - Introduce ultra-high-purity Argon gas (**$\text{Ar } 99.999\%$ / 5N**) into the sputtering chamber.
   - Throttle gate valve / mass flow control to stabilize working process pressure between **$3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$**.
3. **Substrate Stage & Target Alignment:**
   - Engage substrate stage heating to promote film step coverage over high-aspect contacts (bitline and wordline straps).
   - Verify cathode target: **$99.999\%$ (5N) Aluminum target** (or Al-0.5% Cu alloy).
4. **DC Magnetron Sputtering Deposition:**
   - Ignite plasma and ramp planar DC magnetron power supply to **$1.5\text{ to } 3.0\text{ kW}$**.
   - Maintain controlled deposition rate calibrated at **$50\text{ to } 100\text{ nm/min}$**.
   - Deposition timer set to reach nominal Metal-1 (M1) physical thickness target of **$350\text{ nm}$** ($\pm 5\%$).
5. **Post-Metal Anneal (Forming Gas Treatment):**
   - Transfer metallized wafer to furnace/RTA chamber.
   - Run post-metal anneal under forming gas mixture (**$95\%\text{ N}_2 / 5\%\text{ H}_2$**) at **$400^\circ\text{C}$** for **$30\text{ minutes}$**.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Tool / Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | Max $2 \times 10^{-6}$ | High-vacuum Penning/Ion Gauge ($\text{Torr}$) |
| **Process Working Pressure** | $3 \text{ to } 5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | Capacitance Manometer ($\text{mTorr}$) |
| **M1 Film Thickness** | $350$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($332.5 - 367.5$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Profilometer ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | Upper bound $0.08$ | Four-Point Probe ($\Omega/\Box$) |

---

### 3. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source:** *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*
  - Vacuum pump-down target $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ via turbomolecular/cryopump.
  - Sputtering gas Ar $99.999\%$ at $3 - 5\text{ mTorr}$ working pressure.
  - $99.999\%$ (5N) Al target driven by planar DC magnetron at $1.5 - 3.0\text{ kW}$.
  - Deposition rate $50 - 100\text{ nm/min}$, target M1 thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - Post-metal anneal: $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$ in forming gas ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\text{ } 95/5$), achieving $R_s < 0.08\text{ }\Omega/\Box$.

```text
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    18.8    37.5    56.2   75.0 
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Chamber Evacuation & Base Vacuum Verification**:
   - Transfer wafer batch into the high-vacuum PVD load lock and shuttle to the process chamber.
   - Initiate high-vacuum pump-down using the turbomolecular/cryopump system until base pressure reaches **$< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$** to suppress residual oxygen and water vapor incorporation.
2. **Substrate Heating & Stage Stabilization**:
   - Ramp substrate stage heater to thermal stabilization temperature to ensure uniform step coverage across dense bitline/wordline contact arrays (pitch $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$).
3. **Plasma Ignition & Gas Mass Flow Control**:
   - Introduce ultra-high-purity Argon gas (**99.999% / 5N purity**) through mass flow controllers (MFC).
   - Throttle gate valve to regulate working chamber pressure within **$3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$**.
4. **DC Magnetron Sputter Deposition (Ti Adhesion Layer)**:
   - Strike DC magnetron plasma onto high-purity target using the DC magnetron power supply operating at **$1.5\text{ to }3.0\text{ kW}$**.
   - Maintain calibrated deposition rate within **$50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$** to deposit the initial conformal titanium (Ti) contact/adhesion layer directly over the drain contact and W-plug interface.
5. **Reactive Sputter Deposition (TiN Diffusion Barrier Layer)**:
   - Introduce high-purity reactive Nitrogen gas into the Ar stream while maintaining the working pressure at **$3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$** and DC magnetron power at **$1.5\text{ to }3.0\text{ kW}$**.
   - Execute reactive deposition to form the stoichiometric TiN barrier layer above the Ti underlayer to prevent contact junction spiking and migration.
6. **Post-Deposition Cool Down & Unload**:
   - Extinguish plasma, shut off process gas flow, and idle substrate under high vacuum until temperature drops below oxidation threshold.
   - Transfer wafer back to load lock and pump/purge before progressing to Al-0.5% Cu metallization deposition (target $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Inspection / Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Ion Gauge / Penning Gauge |
| **Process Working Pressure** | $3\text{ to }5$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer |
| **DC Magnetron Power** | $1.5\text{ to }3.0$ | $\text{kW}$ | Power Supply Telemetry / RF-DC Controller |
| **Deposition Rate** | $50\text{ to }100$ | $\text{nm/min}$ | Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) / Ellipsometry |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | $\Omega/\Box$ | Four-Point Probe (after $400^\circ\text{C}$, $30\text{ min}$ forming gas anneal) |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **[Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects]**: Base vacuum pump down below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ via turbomolecular/cryopump; Ar 99.999% (5N) at $3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$ working pressure; DC magnetron power at $1.5\text{ to }3.0\text{ kW}$; deposition rate at $50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$; metal-1 stack target thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$; post-metal anneal in forming gas ($95/5\ \text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$) yielding sheet resistance $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$.
- **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: 180nm technology node layout topology ($8F^2/6F^2$ folded bitline), access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact integration.
- **[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: 180nm interconnect pitches ($360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$) requiring high step coverage and stable diffusion barrier integration.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Ti/TiN Sputter Target Conditioning & Vacuum Base Pressure Qualification
**Scope / Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Interconnect & Thin Film Deposition — Gen 2 / Back-End Metallization)  
**Action Type:** Make / Equipment Qualification  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objectives
This SOP outlines the protocol for verifying ultra-high vacuum (UHV) base pressure integrity and executing pre-sputter target conditioning for Titanium (Ti) and Titanium Nitride (TiN) adhesion/diffusion barrier deposition. Pre-conditioning removes native oxides, atmospheric adsorbates, and nitrided target poisons, ensuring reproducible work function, low contact resistance, and prevention of oxygen incorporation prior to primary metallization (M1/M2).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
  [1. Cryo / Turbo High-Vacuum Pumpdown]
                   │
                   ▼
  [2. Base Vacuum Qualification & Leak-Up Rate Test]
                   │
                   ▼
  [3. High-Purity Ar Gas Flow Stabilization]
                   │
                   ▼
  [4. Shutter-Closed Target Pre-Sputter Conditioning]
                   │
                   ▼
  [5. Plasma Stability & DC Power Verification]
```

#### Step 1: Chamber Roughing & High-Vacuum Pumpdown
1. Verify chamber seals, loadlock gate valve isolation, and cryopump/turbomolecular pump operational status.
2. Initiate roughing pumpdown to crossover pressure (~50–100 mTorr), then actuate the high-vacuum gate valve to engage the turbomolecular pump or cryopump.
3. Pump down the deposition chamber continuously until the high-vacuum ionization gauge confirms the base pressure threshold.

#### Step 2: Vacuum Base Pressure Qualification & Outgassing Verification
1. Measure chamber ultimate base pressure via calibrated ionization gauge. Verify base pressure achieves `< 2.0 × 10⁻⁶ Torr`.
2. *(Optional/Recommended)* Close chamber high-vacuum isolation valve for 180 seconds to perform a rate-of-rise (leak-up) check to distinguish real atmospheric vacuum leaks from chamber wall outgassing.

#### Step 3: Process Gas Delivery & Working Pressure Stabilization
1. Introduce 99.999% (5N) high-purity Argon (Ar) process gas through the calibrated mass flow controller (MFC).
2. Throttle the downstream gate valve / APC (Automatic Pressure Controller) to establish and stabilize the sputtering working pressure between `3.0 mTorr and 5.0 mTorr`.

#### Step 4: Shutter-Closed Pre-Sputter Target Conditioning (Burn-in)
1. Ensure the substrate shield / target shutter is fully closed over the substrate stage to isolate production wafers/platens from cross-contamination.
2. Ignite the DC magnetron plasma on the target.
3. Ramp DC magnetron power supply through a stepped conditioning sequence:
   - 0.5 kW for 60 seconds (plasma strike and stabilization)
   - 1.0 kW for 60 seconds (desorption of surface moisture/adsorbates)
   - 1.5 kW to 3.0 kW for 120 seconds (complete target surface clean-up and oxide strip)

#### Step 5: DC Electrical Characteristics & Plasma Extinction
1. Verify reflected power, target cathode voltage, and current stability at setpoint power.
2. Extinguish DC plasma or transition directly into reactive gas flow ($N_2$) for TiN barrier deposition recipe execution.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | Calibrated Hot/Cold Cathode Ionization Gauge |
| **Sputter Working Gas Pressure** | $3.0 \text{ to } 5.0$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer |
| **Argon (Ar) Gas Purity** | $\ge 99.999$ (5N) | $\%$ | Certified Gas Delivery Supply / RGA |
| **Target Conditioning DC Power Range** | $1.5 \text{ to } 3.0$ | $\text{kW}$ | DC Magnetron Power Supply Controller |

---

### 4. Literature Source Citations
- **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects:**
  - *Chamber Base Pressure:* Vacuum chamber must pump down below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ using turbomolecular or cryopump to prevent oxygen incorporation.
  - *Process Gas:* Sputtering process gas is high-purity Argon (Ar 99.999%) maintained at $3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$ working pressure.
  - *Power Supply Specification:* DC magnetron power supply operating at $1.5\text{ to }3.0\text{ kW}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Ti Adhesion & Reactive TiN Diffusion Barrier Sputter Deposition Recipe Execution

**Document ID:** `SOP-PVD-180NM-TI-TIN-001`  
**Classification:** Interconnect & Thin Film Deposition  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Process Action:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This procedure details the sequential DC planar magnetron sputter deposition of a titanium (Ti) adhesion layer followed by reactive sputter deposition of a titanium nitride (TiN) diffusion barrier on contact vias and metal-1 (M1) interconnect trenches prior to Al/Al-Cu metallization. The Ti underlayer provides ohmic contact and adhesion to underlying dielectric/silicon, while stoichiometric TiN prevents aluminum spiking and interdiffusion into silicon junctions or contact plugs.

---

### 2. Equipment, Consumables & Target Specifications
- **PVD Platform:** Multi-chamber cluster tool or sequential load-lock DC magnetron sputtering system equipped with turbomolecular/cryopump vacuum units.
- **Sputter Targets:** High-purity 99.999% (5N) Titanium (Ti) target.
- **Process Gases:** 
  - Ultra-high-purity Argon ($\text{Ar}$, $99.999\%$)
  - Ultra-high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$, $99.999\%$)
- **Forming Gas (Pre/Post-metal support):** $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ (95/5)$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Deposition Chamber Pump-Down & Base Pressure Verification
1. Load 180nm patterned wafers (post-contact etch / clean) into the load-lock cassette.
2. Evacuate the main deposition chamber using the turbomolecular/cryopumping system.
3. Verify baseline chamber pressure drops below **$2 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{Torr}$** before opening process isolation gate valves to prevent oxygen and moisture incorporation.

#### Step 2: In-Situ Substrate Degas & Pre-Sputter Target Conditioning
1. Transfer wafer to the degas / substrate heating stage.
2. Ignite the Ti planar DC magnetron target behind a closed shutter with pure Argon at working pressure ($3\text{ to }5\ \text{mTorr}$) at $1.5\ \text{kW}$ for 60 seconds to strip native oxide/contaminants from the target surface.

#### Step 3: Pure Ti Adhesion Layer Sputter Deposition
1. Set chamber process gas to pure $\text{Ar}$ ($99.999\%$) and stabilize working pressure between **$3\ \text{mTorr}$ and $5\ \text{mTorr}$**.
2. Ramp DC magnetron power supply on the Ti target to **$1.5\ \text{kW}\text{ to }3.0\ \text{kW}$**.
3. Open target shutter to deposit the Ti adhesion liner onto the contact floors and sidewalls (calibrated deposition rate: $50\text{ to }100\ \text{nm/min}$).

#### Step 4: Reactive TiN Diffusion Barrier Sputter Deposition
1. Maintain DC magnetron power ($1.5\ \text{kW}\text{ to }3.0\ \text{kW}$) on the Ti target.
2. Introduce controlled reactive $\text{N}_2$ flow alongside $\text{Ar}$ carrier gas into the plasma discharge, maintaining overall sputtering working pressure at **$3\text{ to }5\ \text{mTorr}$**.
3. Deposit stoichiometric TiN barrier layer over the Ti adhesion film.
4. Extinguish DC plasma, ramp down magnetron power, and pump purge chamber with $\text{Ar}$.

#### Step 5: Post-Deposition Transfer & Metrology Cue
1. Transfer wafer to the cooling station in vacuum or proceed directly to cluster M1 metallization (Al-0.5% Cu deposition targeting $350\ \text{nm} \pm 5\%$).
2. Run post-metal anneal verification cycle using forming gas ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes) when evaluating full stack contact and sheet resistance.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Cold Cathode / Ion Gauge |
| **Sputtering Process Working Pressure** | $3 \text{ to } 5$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer |
| **DC Magnetron Power Delivery** | $1.5 \text{ to } 3.0$ | $\text{kW}$ | DC Power Supply Controller Log |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Limit** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell (at } 85^\circ\text{C)}$ | Electrical Parametric Tester / Probe Station |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **Vacuum Base Pressure ($< 2 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{Torr}$), Working Pressure ($3\text{ to }5\ \text{mTorr}$), DC Power ($1.5\text{ to }3.0\ \text{kW}$), Target Purity ($99.999\%$), Deposition Rate ($50\text{ to }100\ \text{nm/min}$), and Post-Metal Anneal ($400^\circ\text{C}$, 30 min, $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$):**  
  *Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*
- **Bitline Contact Integration, Shared Memory Cell Geometry, & Junction Leakage Threshold ($< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$):**  
  *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Ti/TiN Bilayer Thickness, Sheet Resistance & Step Coverage Metrology

**Level & Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > M1/M2 Metallization Sputtering & Ti/TiN Barrier Deposition Recipe Execution > Ti/TiN Adhesion & Diffusion Barrier Sputter Deposition > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Quality Metrology Protocol  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Inspect & Prep     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Four-Point Probe Rs  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Spectroscopic     │
│  Ellipsometry / XRF   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cross-Sectional SEM  │
│     Step Coverage     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   SPC Verification    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Alignment & Pre-Inspection**:
   - Transfer wafer from PVD barrier cluster load-lock onto the automated inspection stage under cleanroom Class 1/10 conditions.
   - Align notch/flat to 0° reference position; confirm absence of micro-blistering, delamination, or particulate contamination on wafer test coupons and active array scribe lines.

2. **Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Mapping via Four-Point Probe (FPP)**:
   - Perform a calibrated 49-point or 121-point dual-configuration four-point probe scan across the wafer surface.
   - Measure sheet resistance ($R_s$) across test areas to detect resistivity shifts and film thickness uniformity profiles across the wafer radius.

3. **Bilayer Thickness Determination (Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / XRF)**:
   - Measure unpatterned monitor dies and dedicated metrology test pads using spectroscopic ellipsometry (multi-wavelength $\lambda = 190\text{–}850\text{ nm}$) and calibrated X-ray Fluorescence (XRF) for Ti/TiN dual-layer deconvolution.
   - Quantify physical thickness of bottom Ti adhesion film and top TiN barrier layer against baseline recipe deposition rates.

4. **High-Aspect-Ratio Contact Step Coverage Inspection (FIB-SEM)**:
   - Select witness scribe-line contact test structures (bitline drain contacts / W-plug interfaces, nominal critical dimension $L = 180\text{ nm}$, contact depth aspect ratio $\ge 3:1$).
   - Perform precision cross-sectional FIB (focused ion beam) cut and in-lens SEM inspection at $30\text{k}\times\text{–}100\text{k}\times$ magnification.
   - Measure bottom-wall and side-wall film coverage relative to field nominal thickness: $\text{Step Coverage (\%)} = \frac{t_{\text{bottom}}}{t_{\text{field}}} \times 100\%$.

5. **Data Logging & Run-to-Run SPC Gating**:
   - Transmit measured thickness, $R_s$, and step coverage data into the line Statistical Process Control (SPC) database. Flag out-of-control limits before advancing lot to Al-0.5% Cu or pure Al interconnect metallization deposition.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Metrology Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Contact CD & Topology Alignment** | Access Transistor $L = 180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Target dimension matching cell layout | In-line CD-SEM |
| **Interconnect Metallization Baseline** | Post-barrier Al Metal-1 target $= 350$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($\pm 17.5\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / XRF |
| **Sheet Resistance Stability ($R_s$)** | Pre-condition boundary for downstream metallization post-anneal ($400^\circ\text{C}$, 30 min forming gas) | $\Omega/\text{sq}$ | Downstream stack $R_s < 0.08$ | Dual-config 4-Point Probe |
| **PVD Deposition Base Vacuum Integrity** | Process chamber base pump-down | $\text{Torr}$ | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | Ionization Vacuum Gauge |
| **Sputter Process Gas Pressure** | High-purity Ar ($99.999\%$) | $\text{mTorr}$ | $3\text{ to }5$ | Capacitance Manometer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
  - *Base Pressure*: $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ prior to sputter deposition.
  - *Working Gas & Pressure*: Ar $99.999\%$ at $3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$.
  - *Interconnect Metallization Target*: Metal-1 film thickness target is $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - *Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance Target*: $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\text{sq}$ after forming gas anneal ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ minutes}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Unit Cell Geometry*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared bitline contact over tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Interconnect Pitch & Integration*: Bitline and wordline pitch approximately $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$, establishing geometric constraints for contact barrier conformality.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Al-0.5% Cu DC Magnetron Sputtering & In-Situ Stage Heating

**Level / Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > M1/M2 Metallization Sputtering & Ti/TiN Barrier Deposition Recipe Execution > Al-0.5% Cu DC Magnetron Sputtering & In-Situ Stage Heating  
**Technology Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Base Vacuum Pumpdown  │
│  (< 2 x 10^-6 Torr)    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Substrate In-Situ    │
│     Stage Heating      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Ar Gas Admission     │
│    (3 to 5 mTorr)      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  DC Magnetron Plasma   │
│   (1.5 to 3.0 kW)      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Al-Cu Deposition M-1  │
│   (350 nm ± 5%)        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Post-Metal Anneal    │
│  (400°C, 30 min, F.G.) │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Loading & High-Vacuum Chamber Pumpdown**:
   - Transfer wafer (with Ti/TiN barrier layer prepared) onto the PVD chuck.
   - Engage cryopump or turbomolecular pumping system.
   - Pump down the vacuum chamber until the base pressure reaches **below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$** to suppress residual oxygen and water vapor incorporation.

2. **In-Situ Substrate Heating**:
   - Energize the substrate heater to warm the wafer stage in-situ.
   - Maintain stage heating to facilitate surface adatom mobility and step coverage over bitline and interconnect contacts prior to and during sputtering.

3. **Process Gas Stabilization**:
   - Introduce ultra-high-purity Argon (**Ar 99.999% / 5N purity**).
   - Adjust the downstream throttle valve / MFC to maintain working process pressure strictly between **3 to 5 mTorr**.

4. **Target Sputtering & Deposition Recipe Execution**:
   - Ignite DC magnetron plasma over the 5N Al-0.5% Cu target.
   - Ramp and stabilize DC power within the operating window of **1.5 to 3.0 kW**.
   - Sputter at a calibrated deposition rate of **50 to 100 nm/min**.
   - Deposit for the calculated duration to achieve the target Metal-1 nominal thickness of **350 nm**.

5. **Post-Metal Anneal (PMA)**:
   - Transfer wafer to the annealing furnace.
   - Perform forming gas anneal under **$\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ ($95\%/5\%$)** at **$400^\circ\text{C}$** for **30 minutes** to stabilize film morphology, sinter grain boundaries, and minimize contact resistance.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Bayard-Alpert ion gauge / vacuum transducer |
| **Ar Working Process Pressure** | $3\text{ to }5$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance manometer gauge |
| **Metal-1 Film Thickness** | $350 \pm 5\%$ ($332.5\text{ to }367.5$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / surface profilometry |
| **Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** *(post-PMA)* | $< 0.08$ | $\Omega/\text{sq}$ | Four-point probe (4PP) resistivity measurement |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source**: *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*
  - Vacuum pumpdown limit: $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ (turbomolecular/cryopump).
  - Process gas: High-purity Argon (99.999% Ar) at $3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$ working pressure.
  - Power & Deposition Rate: $1.5\text{ to }3.0\text{ kW}$ DC magnetron power; $50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$ deposition rate.
  - Film Thickness & Target: Metal-1 thickness target $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - Post-Metal Anneal & Sheet Resistance: Forming gas $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\text{ }95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$; $R_s < 0.08\text{ }\Omega/\text{sq}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Al-0.5% Cu Target Sputter Pre-Clean & Base Vacuum Qualification

**Module:** Thin Film Deposition / Back-End Metallization Interconnect  
**Node / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — M1/M2 Bitline & Wordline Strapping Metallization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the sequential vacuum pump-down qualification, process gas stabilization, and shutter-closed target pre-sputtering routine for the Al-0.5% Cu DC magnetron sputtering chamber prior to deposition on active product wafers (M1/M2 metallization). Pre-cleaning strips native surface oxides and contaminants from the 5N purity target, preventing oxygen incorporation into DRAM interconnect layers.

---

### 2. Equipment & Materials
* **PVD Chamber:** Planar DC Magnetron Sputtering System with automated target shutter.
* **Vacuum System:** Turbomolecular pump (TMP) or Cryopump backed by dry mechanical roughing pump.
* **Process Gas:** High-Purity Argon ($\text{Ar} \ge 99.999\%$ / 5N).
* **Target:** 99.999% (5N) Aluminum-Copper alloy ($\text{Al}-0.5\%\,\text{Cu}$) sputter target.
* **Instrumentation:** Cold cathode / Bayard-Alpert ion gauge, capacitance manometer, mass flow controller (MFC), DC power supply (1.5 to 3.0 kW).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. High-Vacuum Pump-Down & Base Pressure Verification        |
|    - Cryopump/TMP pull-down; Gauge: Cold Cathode / Ion      |
|    - Interlock: P_base < 2.0e-6 Torr                        |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Argon Gas Introduction & Working Pressure Stabilization   |
|    - Flow Ar (99.999% 5N) via calibrated MFC                |
|    - Throttle gate valve to 3.0 - 5.0 mTorr                 |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Substrate Stage Pre-Conditioning & Shutter Confirmation   |
|    - Verify physical shutter is closed over substrate stage |
|    - Isolate product/dummy wafers during burn-in            |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Plasma Ignition & Target Pre-Sputter Clean               |
|    - Ignite DC plasma; ramp DC power to 1.5 - 3.0 kW        |
|    - Sputter against closed shutter (burn-in oxide layer)   |
|    - Verify stable V-I curve; qualify target for deposition |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 3.1: Chamber Evacuation & Base Vacuum Qualification
1. Close chamber vent valve, seal load lock isolation slit valve, and initiate roughing stage.
2. Crossover to high-vacuum pumping (cryopump or turbomolecular pump).
3. Monitor ion gauge readout until chamber outgassing subsides. 
4. Verify base vacuum pressure achieves **$< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$**. If base pressure fails to reach this threshold, halt process to perform leak checking (He leak rate check) and regeneration of cryopump/TMP.

#### Step 3.2: Process Gas Introduction & Pressure Regulation
1. Open ultra-high purity Ar supply line ($\ge 99.999\%$ purity).
2. Set MFC to introduce Ar gas into the magnetron cathode dark space.
3. Regulate downstream throttle valve to maintain chamber working pressure between **$3\text{ mTorr}$ and $5\text{ mTorr}$** as read by the capacitance manometer.

#### Step 3.3: Shutter Interlock & Stage Pre-Check
1. Confirm the target/substrate shutter is in the fully **CLOSED** position between the Al-0.5% Cu cathode and the wafer stage to prevent cross-contamination onto the substrate pedestal.

#### Step 3.4: DC Magnetron Ignition & Pre-Sputter Conditioning
1. Enable the DC power supply interlocks.
2. Strike the Ar plasma and smoothly ramp the DC magnetron power to the operating window of **$1.5\text{ kW}$ to $3.0\text{ kW}$**.
3. Maintain continuous target pre-sputtering onto the closed shutter for the recipe-specified burn-in cycle (typically 3 to 5 minutes) to remove passivated native aluminum oxide ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$) and restore fresh metallic Al-Cu grain boundaries.
4. Verify plasma discharge stability (DC voltage and current within $\pm 2\%$ operating window).
5. Ramp down power or transition directly into product wafer deposition sequencing upon completion.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Acceptance Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Ionization Gauge / Cold Cathode Gauge |
| **Sputter Process Gas Purity** | $\ge 99.999$ (5N) | $\%$ | Certified Gas Purity Analysis / In-line Filter Spec |
| **Ar Sputter Working Pressure** | $3.0\text{ to }5.0$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | Capacitance Manometer |
| **DC Magnetron Pre-Clean Power** | $1.5\text{ to }3.0$ | $\text{kW}$ | DC Power Supply Output Telemetry |

---

### 5. Context Citations
* **Base Pressure ($< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$)**: *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects* ("Base pressure must pump down below 2x10^-6 Torr using turbomolecular or cryopump to prevent oxygen incorporation.").
* **Process Gas Purity ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$) & Working Pressure ($3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$)**: *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects* ("Sputtering process gas is high-purity Argon (Ar 99.999%) maintained at 3 to 5 mTorr working pressure.").
* **Target Purity ($99.999\%$ / 5N) & DC Power ($1.5\text{ to }3.0\text{ kW}$)**: *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects* ("Target: 99.999% (5N) Aluminum target driven by DC magnetron power supply at 1.5 to 3.0 kW.").
