# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## In-Situ Heated DC Magnetron Sputtering of 350nm Al-0.5% Cu (Metal-1 Metallization)

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the step-by-step operating procedure for depositing 350 nm Al-0.5% Cu metallization on 180nm open-source DRAM wafers using a DC magnetron sputtering system equipped with in-situ substrate stage heating. This layer serves as the primary bitline and interconnect metallization (M1/M2).

---

### 2. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
       +------------------------------------+
       |  Load Wafer & Pump Down Base Vac  |  (< 2 x 10^-6 Torr)
       +-----------------+------------------+
                         |
                         v
       +------------------------------------+
       |  In-Situ Substrate Stage Heating   |  (Preheat for step coverage)
       +-----------------+------------------+
                         |
                         v
       +------------------------------------+
       |  Ar Gas Flow & Pressure Regulate   |  (Ar 99.999%, 3 - 5 mTorr)
       +-----------------+------------------+
                         |
                         v
       +------------------------------------+
       |  Pre-Sputter Target Conditioning   |  (DC 1.5 - 3.0 kW, shutter closed)
       +-----------------+------------------+
                         |
                         v
       +------------------------------------+
       |  Deposit 350nm Al-0.5% Cu Layer    |  (Deposition rate: 50-100 nm/min)
       +-----------------+------------------+
                         |
                         v
       +------------------------------------+
       |  Cool Down, Vent & Post Inspection |  (FGA: 400°C, 30 min, 95/5 N2/H2)
       +------------------------------------+
```

1. **Chamber Evacuation & Base Vacuum Check**:
   - Transfer wafer onto the DC magnetron sputtering substrate chuck via vacuum load-lock.
   - Engage turbomolecular pump/cryopump. Pump down chamber until base pressure drops below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to suppress background oxygen and moisture incorporation.
2. **In-Situ Stage Heating**:
   - Activate substrate stage heater to heat the wafer in-situ, facilitating adatom surface mobility and step coverage over interconnect topographies.
3. **Process Gas Introduction**:
   - Introduce ultra-high-purity Argon gas ($\text{Ar } 99.999\% / 5\text{N}$) into the chamber.
   - Stabilize chamber working pressure between $3\text{ mTorr}$ and $5\text{ mTorr}$ using downstream throttle-valve control.
4. **Target Ignition & Pre-Sputter Cleaning**:
   - Keep substrate shutter closed.
   - Strike plasma on the high-purity (5N, $99.999\%$) Al-0.5% Cu target using the DC magnetron power supply configured between $1.5\text{ kW}$ and $3.0\text{ kW}$.
   - Pre-sputter onto the shutter for target oxide strip and stabilization.
5. **Film Deposition**:
   - Open substrate shutter. Deposit at calibrated rate of $50\text{ nm/min}$ to $100\text{ nm/min}$.
   - Maintain run timer to achieve target nominal thickness of $350\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 5\%$).
   - Close shutter and extinguish DC plasma.
6. **Cool-Down, Unload & Post-Metal Anneal (PMA)**:
   - Allow wafer to cool under inert flow before transfer to load-lock.
   - Perform post-metal anneal in forming gas ($95\%\ \text{N}_2 / 5\%\ \text{H}_2$) at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ minutes}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | Upper limit: $2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Ion Gauge / Penning Gauge |
| **Process Working Pressure** | $3.0 - 5.0$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{mTorr}$ | In-situ Capacitance Manometer |
| **DC Magnetron Power** | $1.5 - 3.0$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{kW}$ | DC Generator Controller Output |
| **Deposition Rate** | $50 - 100$ | Process calibrated | $\text{nm/min}$ | In-situ QCM / Ellipsometry |
| **Final Film Thickness** | $350$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($332.5 - 367.5$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Reflectometry / Profilometer |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | Upper limit: $0.08$ | $\Omega/\Box$ ($\text{Ohm/sq}$) | 4-Point Probe (post 400°C, 30 min FGA) |

---

### 4. Literature Source Citation
- **Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**
  - Base pressure $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$.
  - Argon purity $99.999\%$ at working pressure of $3\text{ to } 5\text{ mTorr}$.
  - 5N Aluminum target driven at $1.5\text{ to } 3.0\text{ kW}$ DC magnetron power.
  - Deposition rate calibrated at $50\text{ to } 100\text{ nm/min}$.
  - Target thickness: $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - Post-metal anneal: $95/5\ \text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ forming gas at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$ yielding $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Deposition Four-Point Probe & Step-Coverage Metrology
**Node / Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — Interconnect & Thin Film Deposition / Metrology  
**Hierarchy Context:** Architecture & Integration > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > M1/M2 Metallization Sputtering & Ti/TiN Barrier Deposition Recipe Execution > Al-0.5% Cu DC Magnetron Sputtering & In-Situ Stage Heating > Post-Deposition Four-Point Probe & Step-Coverage Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Wafer Unload &     │
│        Cooling        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     4-Point Probe     │
│        Mapping        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Film Thickness & Rs  │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cross-Section SEM /  │
│     Step-Coverage     │
│     Profilometry      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Lot Disposition &   │
│  Pass/Fail Criteria   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Unload & Pre-Measurement Stabilization:**
   - Unload the metallized 180nm DRAM wafer following Al-0.5% Cu DC magnetron sputtering from the load lock.
   - Allow wafer temperature to equilibrate to cleanroom ambient ($21.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) on a dedicated cooling station before probe contact to prevent probe punch-through or thermal resistance drift.

2. **Automated Four-Point Probe Tool Setup & Calibration:**
   - Initialize automated collinear 4-point probe (4PP) sheet resistance metrology station.
   - Run daily calibration check against certified high-purity Al/Cu reference standards.
   - Set probe tip contact force (nominal $100\text{ gf}$ with osmium/tungsten carbide tips) and test current injection ($10\text{ mA}$ to $100\text{ mA}$) to maintain ohmic, non-destructive contact on the metal film.

3. **Multi-Point Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Mapping:**
   - Execute a 49-point or 81-point concentric contour map across the wafer with a $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion.
   - Record sheet resistance $R_s$ ($\Omega/\square$) at each site; verify uniformity across center, middle, and edge radii.
   - Evaluate post-metal anneal sample lots (annealed in forming gas $95\%\ \text{N}_2 / 5\%\ \text{H}_2$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$) to ensure complete intermetallic phase stabilization and verify $R_s$ compliance.

4. **Film Thickness & Deposition Rate Confirmation:**
   - Correlate resistivity $\rho = R_s \times t$ with optical/stylus step-height profilometer measurements on co-sputtered pilot monitor steps.
   - Confirm target physical layer thickness for Metal-1 (M1) metallization against the deposition rate calibration ($50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$).

5. **Cross-Sectional Step-Coverage Metrology:**
   - Transfer monitor scribe-line coupons or test dies containing high-aspect-ratio contacts (e.g., bitline contact shared between adjacent 1T1C memory cells with bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$) to cross-sectional FIB-SEM / FE-SEM.
   - Image contact/via sidewalls and bottom step coverage. Calculate percentage step coverage:
     $$\text{Step Coverage (\%)} = \frac{t_{\text{bottom}}}{t_{\text{field}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Ensure complete, void-free continuous step coverage over tungsten plug (W-plug) interfaces and high-aspect-ratio topography.

6. **Data Logging & Lot Disposition:**
   - Export 4PP wafer map, mean sheet resistance, standard deviation ($1\sigma$ uniformity), and SEM step-coverage micrographs to the fab Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
   - Flag and quarantine wafers showing excessive non-uniformity, surface micro-voiding, or out-of-spec $R_s$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Metal-1 (M1) Film Thickness** | $350 \pm 5\%$ ($332.5\text{ nm to }367.5\text{ nm}$) | Stylus Profilometry / FIB-SEM Cross-Section | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Deposition Rate Calibration** | $50\text{ to }100$ | In-situ quartz crystal monitor / run-time calibration | $\text{nm/min}$ |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $R_s < 0.08$ (after forming gas $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$) | Automated 4-Point Probe Mapping ($V/I$ test) | $\Omega/\square$ |
| **Cell Interconnect Pitch Alignment** | $360\text{ to }400$ | CD-SEM / Inline Optical Metrology | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Film Thickness & Deposition Rate:**
  *“Target: 99.999% (5N) Aluminum target driven by DC magnetron power supply at 1.5 to 3.0 kW. Deposition Rate: Calibrated at 50 to 100 nm/minute. Film thickness target for metal-1 is 350 nm ± 5%.”*  
  — *Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*

- **Sheet Resistance Target & Post-Metal Anneal Conditions:**
  *“Measured sheet resistance target is R_s < 0.08 Ohm/sq after post-metal anneal (forming gas N2/H2 95/5 at 400°C for 30 minutes).”*  
  — *Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*

- **180nm DRAM Interconnect & Step-Coverage Topology:**
  *“Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells. Stacked Capacitor Topology: Crown-shaped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) structure erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).”*  
  — *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*

- **Cell Dimension & Interconnect Pitch:**
  *“Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately 360 nm to 400 nm. Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness.”*  
  — *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*

## Title: Post-Metal Anneal & Four-Point Probe Sheet Resistance Metrology

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

```text
│         95/5          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Cool Down under    │
│   Inert N2 Purge to   │
│       Room Temp       │
└───────────┬───────────┘

│   Four-Point Probe    │
│  Setup & Calibration  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Multi-Site Sheet    │
│      Resistance       │
│      Measurement      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────◇───────────┐
│    Pass Acceptance    │
│         Spec?         │
└───────────◇───────────┘
            │
            ├──────────────────────────────────────────╮ Rs >= 0.08 Ω/sq
            │ Rs < 0.08 Ω/sq                           │
            ▼                                          ▼
┌───────────────────────┐                  ┌───────────────────────┐
│  Accept & Advance to  │                  │  Flag Out-of-Spec /   │
│     Probe Station     │                  │    Rework Analysis    │
└───────────────────────┘                  └───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Actionable Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Furnace / Rapid Thermal Chamber Preparation
1. Ensure the quartz tube or furnace chamber is purged with ultra-high-purity $\text{N}_2$ to purge atmospheric oxygen.
2. Introduce forming gas at a volumetric ratio of **$95\% \text{ N}_2 / 5\% \text{ H}_2$**.
3. Stabilize furnace heating zone at **$400^\circ\text{C}$**.

#### Step 2: Post-Metal Annealing Execution
1. Load wafers with deposited Metal-1 (nominal thickness target: **$350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$**) into the anneal chamber.
2. Soak wafers under continuous forming gas flow ($95/5\text{ }\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$) at **$400^\circ\text{C}$** for precisely **$30\text{ minutes}$** to eliminate lattice defects, reduce film stress, and form low-resistance ohmic contacts.
3. Ramp down temperature or transfer to the cooling zone under inert $\text{N}_2$ purge until wafer surface reaches room temperature ($< 30^\circ\text{C}$) before atmospheric exposure to avoid unpassivated surface oxidation.

#### Step 3: Four-Point Probe System Calibration & Setup
1. Inspect the collinear four-point probe head (tungsten carbide or osmium tips with standardized inter-probe spacing).
2. Verify probe pin spring tension and contact integrity on a calibrated sheet resistance transfer standard.
3. Configure the source meter to supply forward/reverse DC test currents ($I$) through outer pins (1 & 4) and detect differential voltage ($\Delta V$) across inner pins (2 & 3).

#### Step 4: Sheet Resistance Metrology & Inspection
1. Position the annealed wafer on the vacuum chuck.
2. Execute multi-site contact measurements (center, mid-radius, wafer edge exclusion zone: $3\text{ mm}$).
3. Calculate sheet resistance using the standard thin-film formulation:
   $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{\Delta V}{I} \approx 4.532 \cdot \frac{\Delta V}{I}\quad [\Omega/\text{sq}]$$
4. Validate test site consistency across the wafer surface.

---

| **Anneal Process Temperature** | **$400$** | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Furnace Thermocouple Array / Pyrometer |
| **Anneal Process Duration** | **$30$** | $\text{minutes}$ | Automated Recipe Run-Time Controller |
| **Forming Gas Composition ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$)** | **$95 / 5$** | $\% \text{ vol/vol}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Forming Gas Tube Furnace Post-Metal Anneal (PMA) Recipe Execution

### 1. Process Workflow Overview
```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Pre-Anneal Chamber  │
│        Check         │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Wafer Boat Loading  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Furnace Purge &    │
│   Temperature Ramp   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Isothermal Forming  │
│       Gas Soak       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Cooling & Boat    │
│      Unloading       │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Anneal System Initialization & Purge Check**:
   - Verify the three-zone quartz tube furnace (Load, Center, Source zones) digital triple-loop PID controller and Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples are calibrated.
   - Establish base inert carrier purge using high-purity $N_2$ regulated via Mass Flow Controller (MFC) within **1 to 5 SLPM** to eliminate ambient oxygen.

2. **Wafer Boat Loading & Insertion**:
   - Load post-metallization wafers (deposited Metal-1 target thickness: **350 nm ± 5%**) into the quartz wafer boat, oriented within the central 300 mm isothermal flat zone.
   - Initiate motorized cantilever boat push into the furnace at a speed strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.

3. **Purge & Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Stabilize multi-zone heating coils to maintain the target setpoint of **400°C** across the flat zone.
   - Ensure zone-to-zone thermal decoupling maintains temperature stability within **±0.5°C**.

4. **Forming Gas Anneal (PMA Soak Execution)**:
   - Switch gas delivery from inert $N_2$ purge to forming gas composition (**$N_2 / H_2\text{ 95/5}$**) via calibrated MFCs at **1 to 5 SLPM**.
   - Execute isothermal anneal soak strictly at **400°C** for **30 minutes** to passivate dangling interface bonds and sinter the Al interconnect interfaces.

5. **Post-Anneal Purge, Cooling & Unloading**:
   - Shut off the $H_2$ line and perform a high-purity $N_2$ purge at **1 to 5 SLPM** for a minimum of 5 volume exchanges.
   - Retract the wafer boat using the automatic push/pull mechanism at a withdrawal speed **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$**.
   - Transfer wafers to the four-point probe metrology station once cooled to room temperature.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Threshold | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Anneal Temperature** | **$400$** | °C | Type R / Type S thermocouple / PID controller |
| **Soak Duration** | **$30$** | minutes | Automated furnace recipe timer |
| **Boat Travel Speed** | **$< 50$** | mm/minute | Cantilever linear encoder / drive controller |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | **$< 0.08$** | $\Omega/\text{sq}$ | Inline Four-Point Probe Metrology |
| **Gas Flow Rate** | **$1\text{ to }5$** | SLPM | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Collinear Tungsten-Carbide Four-Point Probe Head & Current Source Setup

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Probe Head      │
│      Inspection      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Mounting & Spacing  │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Current Source    │
│       Sourcing       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Voltage Sense & Rs  │
│     Calculation      │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Probe Head Inspection & Cleaning**:
   - Inspect the collinear probe assembly containing four tungsten-carbide tips under an optical inspection microscope.
   - Verify that tip radii are clean of metal build-up and conform to $50\,\mu\text{m} - 100\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Inspect inter-probe tip pitch to confirm collinearity and uniform spacing $s = 1.0\,\text{mm}$.
2. **Mechanical Mounting & Planar Alignment**:
   - Secure the tungsten-carbide probe head into the probe station z-stage arm.
   - Align the probe head plane parallel to the wafer chuck surface to ensure simultaneous 4-point mechanical touch-down.
   - For finite wafer substrates where wafer diameter $D < 40s$ ($D < 40\,\text{mm}$), apply edge proximity correction factor $F(d/s)$ tables in the metrology system software before landing.
3. **Electrical Wiring & Current Source Configuration**:
   - Connect the outer probe terminals (Probe 1 and Probe 4) to the precision DC current source output terminals ($I^+$ and $I^-$).
   - Connect the inner probe terminals (Probe 2 and Probe 3) to the high-impedance digital voltmeter sense terminals ($V^+$ and $V^-$).
   - Set the programmable DC current source to supply a constant DC current $I = 1.0\,\text{mA}$ to $10.0\,\text{mA}$.
4. **Touchdown, Sourcing & Potential Sense**:
   - Lower the probe head onto the post-metal anneal thin film (M1/M2 metallization stack) until all four tips achieve solid ohmic contact.
   - Enable DC current sourcing through outer probes 1 and 4 ($I = 1\,\text{mA} - 10\,\text{mA}$).
   - Read the resulting floating potential difference $V$ across inner probes 2 and 3.
5. **Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Derivation**:
   - Calculate sheet resistance for thin films ($t \ll s/2$) using the semi-infinite collinear relation:
     $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{V}{I} \approx 4.5324 \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right)\quad [\Omega/\square]$$
   - Apply geometric correction factor $F(d/s)$ when sampling near boundaries or on finite geometries.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Parameter | Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Tip Radius** | $50 \text{ to } 100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Metrology / Tip Inspection |
| **Inter-Probe Spacing ($s$)** | $1.0$ | $\text{mm}$ | Calibrated Optical Tooling / Vernier |
| **DC Excitation Current ($I$)** | $1 \text{ to } 10$ | $\text{mA}$ | Precision DC Current Source Reading |
| **Thin-Film Conversion Factor** | $4.5324$ ($\pi / \ln 2$) | Dimensionless constant | Automated Metrology Software Calculation |

---

### 3. Context & Source Citations
- **Source: Four Point Probe Method**
  - Use of tungsten-carbide tips for four-point sheet resistance measurements.
- **Source: Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**
  - Probe tip specifications (tungsten-carbide, radius $50 - 100\,\mu\text{m}$, spacing $s = 1.0\,\text{mm}$).
  - Outer probe current injection ($I = 1\,\text{mA} \text{ to } 10\,\text{mA}$ through outer probes 1 and 4).
  - Inner probe floating potential difference sensing ($V$ across probes 2 and 3).
  - Sheet resistance formula $R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \frac{V}{I} = 4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I}\ [\Omega/\square]$ under $t \ll s/2$.
  - Geometric correction factor $F(d/s)$ requirements when wafer diameter is $< 40s$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-M1M2-RS`
**Title:** M1/M2 Aluminum Film Sheet Resistance & Geometric Correction Factor Metrology  
**Module:** Interconnect & Thin Film Deposition / Metrology  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Four-Point Probe Station Metrology)

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the precise execution steps for measuring sheet resistance ($R_s$) and calculating geometric thickness/correction factors for M1/M2 aluminum (Al or Al-0.5% Cu) thin films deposited via DC magnetron sputtering following post-metal anneal (PMA) in the 180nm DRAM fabrication line.

---

### 2. Verified Context & Source Citations
- **Interconnect Specifications:** Planar DC magnetron sputtering, 99.999% (5N) Al target at 1.5–3.0 kW; target thickness 350 nm ± 5%; post-metal anneal in forming gas ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$) at 400°C for 30 minutes; sheet resistance specification $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$.  
  *(Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects)*
- **Cell Architecture Context:** Bitline and wordline strap routing supporting 180nm DRAM stacked capacitor cell layouts with 360–400 nm pitch.  
  *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench; Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering)*

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Pre-Inspection & Calibration                        |
| - Verify NIST-traceable standard calibration wafer          |
| - Inspect 4-point probe tips for tip radius & wear          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Post-Metal Anneal (PMA) Verification                |
| - Confirm anneal completed: 400°C, 30 min, N2/H2 (95/5)     |
| - Cool wafer to standard room temperature (22°C - 25°C)     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Four-Point Probe Loading & Alignment                |
| - Vacuum chuck engagement on blanket/test wafer             |
| - Establish 49-point / 9-point polar map with edge exclusion |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Current Injection & Voltage Measurement             |
| - Apply constant DC current (10 mA - 100 mA) via outer pins |
| - Measure differential voltage V across inner pins          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 5: Geometric Correction Factor & Rs Calculation        |
| - Apply correction F(t/s, d/s) based on wafer geometry      |
| - Rs = (pi / ln 2) * (V / I) * F; extract bulk resistivity  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Pre-Flight Inspection & Probe Qualification:**
   - Verify probe head pin spacing ($s \approx 1.0\text{ mm}$ or $1.587\text{ mm}$) and tip radius under optical inspection.
   - Run a NIST-traceable reference wafer to verify contact resistance and station calibration accuracy within $\pm 0.5\%$.
2. **Post-Metal Anneal (PMA) Verification:**
   - Confirm batch completion of forming gas anneal ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes) to ensure proper Al grain growth and barrier integrity.
   - Ensure the wafer has cooled to ambient metrology room temperature ($22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$).
3. **Wafer Placement & Recipe Selection:**
   - Mount the 180nm metallized wafer onto the automated probe station vacuum chuck.
   - Select the **M1/M2 Aluminum 350 nm Recipe** (49-point diameter map, 5 mm edge exclusion).
4. **Current Forcing and Dual-Configuration Measurement:**
   - Soft-land the four colinear tungsten carbide or osmium probe pins under controlled mechanical load (100–120 g per pin).
   - Inject calibrated forward and reverse DC test currents ($I$) through the outer pins (1 and 4) while sensing the induced potential drop ($\Delta V$) across the inner pins (2 and 3) to eliminate thermal EMF offsets.
5. **Geometric Correction Factor & Film Quality Computation:**
   - Calculate raw sheet resistance: $R_{\text{raw}} = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \times \frac{\Delta V}{I} \approx 4.53236 \times \frac{\Delta V}{I}$.
   - Apply geometric correction factor $F = F_1 \times F_2$ accounting for finite wafer thickness ($t \ll s$, $F_1 \approx 1$) and boundary edge proximity ($F_2$).
   - Determine derived film thickness or bulk resistivity ($\rho = R_s \times t$) using nominal deposition thickness ($350\text{ nm}$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **M1 Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | $\Omega/\Box$ | Dual-configuration Four-Point Probe Station |
| **Post-Metal Anneal Temperature** | $400 \pm 5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermocouple log (Forming Gas $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$) |
| **PMA Anneal Duration** | $30 \pm 1$ | minutes | Automated thermal recipe controller timer |
| **M1 Film Thickness Target** | $350 \pm 17.5$ ($\pm 5\%$) | nm | XRF / Optical Ellipsometry correlation |

---

### 5. Citations
- *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*
- *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
- *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-PKG-MET-001  
**Title:** Manual Analytical Die Probe Station & Multi-Pin Probe Card Procurement & Acceptance  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | Architecture & Integration > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > Manual Analytical Die Probe Station & Multi-Pin Probe Card Procurement  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the technical procurement, configuration, and verification steps for a manual analytical die probe station and custom multi-pin probe card assembly. The system performs characterization, parametric extraction, and wafer/die-level electrical verification (leakage current, bitline precharge, sense amplifier differential readout margin) for the 180nm open-source DRAM architecture.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           PROCUREMENT & VERIFICATION FLOW                         |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Mechanical & Thermal Specification Review (180nm pitch, 85°C chuck)     |
|                                       v                                           |
|  [Step 2] Probe Card & Low-Noise Triaxial / Coaxial Interface Configuration       |
|                                       v                                           |
|  [Step 3] Instrument Docking, Triaxial Calibration & Shielding Verification       |
|                                       v                                           |
|  [Step 4] Parametric Metrology & Acceptance Testing (Leakage, Margin, Retention)  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Tool Specification & Dimensional Sizing
1. Specify an anti-vibration manual analytical probe station equipped with a high-planarity vacuum chuck supporting bare die and wafer coupons up to 150/200 mm.
2. Ensure thermal chuck integration capable of steady-state heating to **85°C** (required for elevated-temperature retention and sub-threshold leakage validation).
3. Confirm high-magnification optical stereo/compound microscope optics capable of resolving metal pad pitches corresponding to 180nm design rules (interconnect pitch scaling from line/contact pitch of ~360 nm to 400 nm).

#### Step 2: Multi-Pin Probe Card & Manipulator Tooling Configuration
1. Design multi-pin probe card / cantilever or vertical needle array matched to die pad layout (pads for $V_{DD}$, $V_{SS}$, Wordline, complementary Bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$, and Sense Amplifier control signals $SAN$/$SAP$).
2. Require triaxial cabling and guarded needle fixtures for low-current measurement paths to isolate sensitive access-transistor sub-threshold and junction leakages.
3. Configure coaxial RF/high-speed lines for transient differential signal readout and pulse-based precharge testing ($V_{DD}/2$).

#### Step 3: Mechanical & Electrical Installation Calibration
1. Level the manual chuck to ensure planar contact across multi-pin probe tips with probe scrub mark depth not exceeding top-metal stack limits.
2. Connect triaxial shields to common instrument guards; verify that residual system floor noise with needles lifted is $\le 10\text{ fA}$ at ambient conditions.
3. Verify microscope illumination and micromanipulator $X\text{-}Y\text{-}Z$ backlash control (< 1 µm precision) to avoid pad tearing during touchdown.

#### Step 4: Physical Acceptance Run on Test Structures
1. Load a baseline 180nm test coupon containing access transistor arrays ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$) and 1T1C storage capacitor test elements.
2. Heat the chuck to **85°C** and run sub-threshold/junction leakage sweep down to target levels.
3. Execute differential readout margin extraction on test cells with cell capacitance $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ to verify precharge and readout behavior.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chuck Thermal Stability** | $85.0 \pm 1.0$ | °C | Integrated RTD/thermocouple surface measurement on heated vacuum chuck |
| **System Leakage Measurement Floor** | $< 1.0$ | fA/cell | Direct picoammeter / SMU measurement with triaxial guarding at 85°C chuck temperature |
| **Cell Capacitance Parametric Extraction** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | fF | Quasi-static / high-frequency C-V meter sweep on 1T1C stacked capacitor structures |
| **Sense Readout Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | mV | Oscilloscope / SMU pulse measurement across $BL$ and $/BL$ at precharge $V_{DD}/2$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

The physical parameters and operating conditions in this SOP are directly grounded in the provided literature:

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell (dielectric $\kappa > 15$).
   - Leakage target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Precharge condition: Equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Readout network dynamics: For cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, differential readout signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Storage capacitance bounds: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Interconnect scale: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document Code:** `SOP-180DRAM-MET-007`  
**Title:** Interconnect Contact Resistance & Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station [Back-End Packaging / Metrology]  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Overview
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Wafer Loading &     │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   TLM 4-Point Kelvin   │
│        Probing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Parameter        │
│  Extraction: Rc, Rs,   │
│         rho_c          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   EDP Die Functional   │
│    Screen & Leakage    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Electronic Wafer Map  │
│        Binning         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Alignment & Probe Card Setup:**
   - Mount the 180nm DRAM processed wafer onto the motorized thermal vacuum chuck of the automatic electrical probe station.
   - Adjust chuck temperature setpoint to $85^\circ\text{C}$ for hot-carrier and junction retention screening.
   - Perform optical two-point pattern recognition on the wafer alignment fiducials and planarize the probe needle tips onto the on-chip test structure pads ($100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ aluminum square bond pads and TLM test arrays).

2. **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) Probing:**
   - Step the probe tips onto the inline scribe-line TLM structure arrays consisting of identical rectangular contact pads (pad width $W = 100\,\mu\text{m}$, pad length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\,\mu\text{m}$) spaced at progressively increasing gaps:
     $$d \in \{5\,\mu\text{m},\, 10\,\mu\text{m},\, 20\,\mu\text{m},\, 40\,\mu\text{m},\, 80\,\mu\text{m}\}$$
   - Apply a 4-point Kelvin DC current sweep through adjacent pad pairs and record total loop resistance $R_T$ across each gap $d$.

3. **Contact Parameter & Resistivity Extraction:**
   - Execute a linear regression fit of measured total resistance $R_T$ against gap spacing $d$ based on the transmission line formulation:
     $$R_T = 2 R_c + \left(\frac{R_s}{W}\right) d$$
   - Extract the slope $m = R_s / W$ to calculate diffusion sheet resistance $R_s$.
   - Extract the Y-intercept at $d = 0$ to calculate twice the contact resistance ($2 R_c$), yielding contact resistance $R_c$.
   - Extract the negative X-intercept $-2 L_T$ to obtain transfer length $L_T$.
   - Compute specific contact resistivity:
     $$\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2 \quad [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$$

4. **Electrical Die Probing (EDP) Functional & Leakage Screening:**
   - Step the multi-pin probe card to each active DRAM die (access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$ with stacked capacitor over bitline / W-plug drain contact).
   - Perform capacitance parametric validation on the stacked capacitor structure to ensure the effective dielectric constant ($\kappa > 15$) yields the required cell storage capacitance.
   - Measure cell leakage current (sub-threshold and drain-substrate junction leakage) at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across memory cell arrays.
   - Generate an Electronic Wafer Map (EWM) classifying Known Good Die (KGD) ready for subsequent die sawing, silver-filled conductive epoxy die attach, and ultrasonic wedge / gold ball wire bonding.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░                                │
   Leakage (<1.0 fA)┤░░                                │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
      Die Void (<5%)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
Bond Pull (>=4.0 gf)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓                            │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓                            │
    C_cell (>=28 fF)┤██████████████████████████████████│
                    │██████████████████████████████████│
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0       7       14      21      28 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Multi-frequency C-V parameter analyzer on stacked capacitor test macro |
| **Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-picoamp precision parametric electrometer on bitline/cell array |
| **TLM Contact Pad Geometry & Array Gaps** | $W = 100 \pm 0.5$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50 \pm 0.5$; gaps $d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical inline metrology / calibrated probe station displacement |
| **Downstream Wire Bond Pull Strength** | $\ge 4.0$ (span break mode) | $\text{gf}$ (grams-force) | Calibrated wire bond pull tester (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011) |

---

### Verified Context Citations
1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Confirms unit cell dimensions ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline via tungsten plug (W-plug), effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, minimum storage capacitance budget of $\ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage current limit $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity:**
   - Establishes TLM contact pad dimensions ($W = 100\,\mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\,\mu\text{m}$) and spacing set ($d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80\,\mu\text{m}$), linear regression equations ($R_T = 2R_c + (R_s/W)d$), transfer length derivation ($L_T$), and specific contact resistivity formula ($\rho_c = R_c W L_T = R_s L_T^2$).
3. **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging:**
   - Establishes pad dimensions ($100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ Al pads), wire diameter ($25\,\mu\text{m}$), wire bond pull strength acceptance threshold ($\ge 4.0\,\text{gf}$ per Mil-Std-883 Method 2011), and die attach acoustic void area threshold ($< 5\%$).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Kelvin Force-Sense &  │
│      Cross-Bridge      │
│       Structure        │
│      Registration      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Contact Overdrive &   │
│    Electrical Scrub    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Chuck Mount & Thermal Equilibrium**:
   - Transfer the 180nm processed DRAM wafer onto the prober vacuum chuck.
   - Engage vacuum clamp (verify vacuum pressure $\ge 80\text{ kPa}$). Maintain chuck temperature stabilization at the test baseline ($25^\circ\text{C}$ or elevated temperature qualification up to $85^\circ\text{C}$ per DRAM retention and leakage testing context).

2. **Optical Global & Pattern Recognition (PR) Alignment**:
   - Position the dual-magnification microscope camera over the primary wafer alignment fiducials / notch.
   - Execute automatic pattern recognition across scribe line targets to correct rotational theta ($\theta$) skew ($\Delta\theta \le \pm 0.002^\circ$).

3. **Probe Tip Planarity & Z-Reference Touchdown**:
   - Perform probe card planarity mapping across all tungsten carbide / cantilever probe tips (tip radius: $50\text{–}100\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Set optical $Z_0$ clearance height and perform electric contact sensing against the alignment dummy pad to establish the $Z$-reference plane across all probes.

4. **Kelvin & Cross-Bridge Pad Structure Registration**:
   - Index the stage to the Process Control Monitor (PCM) scribe-line test insert containing:
     - 4-terminal Kelvin contact resistance structures (dedicated force/sense terminals for W-plug and interconnect contacts).
     - Cross-bridge sheet resistor structures ($R_s$ metrology).
   - Align the probe tips concentric with the landing pads to eliminate pad boundary scrub damage.

5. **Z-Overdrive & Electrical Scrub Verification**:
   - Apply recipe-specified vertical stage overdrive ($\Delta Z = 35\text{–}55\ \mu\text{m}$) to penetrate native oxide and achieve stable scrub marks.
   - Inject DC test current ($I = 1.0\text{ mA to } 10.0\text{ mA}$) between outer force terminals and verify potential measurement $V$ across sense terminals to validate contact integrity before triggering automated parametric testing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Tip Radius Range** | $50 \text{ to } 100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Metrology / High-Mag Inspection |
| **Wafer Chuck Test Temperature** | $85 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated Chuck RTD / Temperature Controller |
| **Kelvin DC Excitation Current Range** | $1.0 \text{ to } 10.0$ | $\text{mA}$ | Parametric SMU Constant Current Source |
| **Scrub Mark Center Travel Alignment** | $\le \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Automated Post-Touchdown Optical Image Analysis |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **`Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance`**:
  - Probe tip material and geometry: Tungsten carbide tips with radius $50\text{–}100\ \mu\text{m}$.
  - Operating principle: Constant DC current excitation of $I = 1\text{ mA to } 10\text{ mA}$ applied to force paths while inner floating potential difference ($V$) is recorded to resolve sheet resistance $R_s = 4.5324 \times (V / I)\ [\Omega/\square]$.
- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench` & `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - Interconnect and contact metallurgy: Tungsten plug (W-plug) contact integration.
  - Temperature validation: $85^\circ\text{C}$ thermal target established for DRAM cell junction leakage target ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$) and data retention ($> 64\text{ ms}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Four-Point Probe & Metal-1/Via-1 Kelvin Contact Resistance Characterization

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > Interconnect Contact Resistance & Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) > Four-Point Probe & Metal-1/Via-1 Kelvin Contact Resistance Characterization  
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Four-Point Probe    │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Current Injection:   │
│  Probes 1 and 4: 1 mA  │
│        to 10 mA        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Voltage Sense:     │
│    Probes 2 and 3:     │
│       measure V        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Sheet Resistance    │
│   Calculation: Rs =    │
│     4.5324 * V / I     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Kelvin and TLM     │
│   Contact Resistance   │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Measure RT across    │
│  Pad Spacings: 5, 10,  │
│     20, 40, 80 um      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Extract Rc from     │
│   Y-intercept and LT   │
│    from X-intercept    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Compute Contact     │
│  Resistivity: rhoc =   │
│      Rc * W * LT       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Probe Head Alignment & Tool Calibration
1. Mount a collinear four-point probe head fitted with four equally spaced tungsten carbide tips having tip radii of $r = 50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$ and uniform tip spacing $s = 1.0\ \text{mm}$.
2. Align probe tips orthogonal to the wafer plane and verify that edge proximity conditions are accounted for using geometric correction factor $F(d/s)$ if wafer diameter $< 40 \times s$.

#### Step 2: Collinear Four-Point Probe Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Measurement
1. Bring probe tips into soft mechanical contact with the Metal-1 / diffusion thin-film test area (film thickness $t \ll s/2$).
2. Force a regulated constant DC current of $I = 1\ \text{mA}$ to $10\ \text{mA}$ across the outer two probes (probe 1 and probe 4).
3. Concurrently measure the floating potential difference $V$ across the inner two sense probes (probe 2 and probe 3) using a high-impedance digital electrometer/voltmeter.
4. Calculate thin-film sheet resistance:
   $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right) = 4.5324 \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right)\quad [\Omega/\square]$$

#### Step 3: Metal-1/Via-1 Kelvin Contact & TLM Structure Alignment
1. Switch to the micro-probing station with motorized manipulators and locate the Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) test structure array on the wafer.
2. Verify test structure geometry: identical rectangular contact pads with width $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, pad length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$, and progressive test gaps:
   $$d \in \{5\ \mu\text{m},\ 10\ \mu\text{m},\ 20\ \mu\text{m},\ 40\ \mu\text{m},\ 80\ \mu\text{m}\}$$

#### Step 4: TLM Kelvin Resistance Extraction
1. Apply 4-wire Kelvin probing across adjacent pairs of pads for each spacing $d$ and record total resistance:
   $$R_T = 2 R_c + \left(\frac{R_s}{W}\right) \cdot d$$
2. Construct the linear regression plot of total measured resistance $R_T$ versus pad spacing $d$:
   - **Slope**: $\text{Slope} = \frac{R_s}{W}$ (extracts diffusion sheet resistance $R_s$).
   - **Y-intercept ($d = 0$)**: $Y_0 = 2 R_c$ (yields single contact resistance $R_c = \frac{Y_0}{2}$).
   - **X-intercept ($R_T = 0$)**: $X_0 = -2 L_T$ (yields transfer length $L_T = -\frac{X_0}{2}$).

#### Step 5: Specific Contact Resistivity Computation
1. Compute the specific contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) using:
   $$\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\quad [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$$
2. Log values into wafer lot tracking and cross-validate against Four-Point Probe thin-film data.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification & Tolerance | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **AC-01** | Probe Tip Spacing ($s$) | $1.0 \pm 0.01$ | $\text{mm}$ | Optical Micrometer / Calibration Reticle |
| **AC-02** | Probe Tip Radius ($r$) | $50 \text{ to } 100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Profilometry |
| **AC-03** | DC Injection Current ($I$) | $1.0 \text{ to } 10.0$ | $\text{mA}$ | Precision Source Measure Unit (SMU) |
| **AC-04** | TLM Contact Pad Dimensions | Width $W = 100 \pm 1$, Length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50 \pm 1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Automated Optical Metrology (CD-SEM / Microscope) |
| **AC-05** | TLM Inter-Pad Spacings ($d$) | $5,\ 10,\ 20,\ 40,\ 80$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Lithographic Mask & CD Metrology |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources

- **Source: Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**:
  - Probe geometry: 4 collinear tungsten carbide tips, tip radius $50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$, spacing $s = 1.0\ \text{mm}$.
  - Current excitation: $I = 1\ \text{mA}$ to $10\ \text{mA}$ across probes 1 and 4; potential $V$ measured across probes 2 and 3.
  - Formula: $R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot (V/I) = 4.5324 \cdot (V/I)\ [\Omega/\square]$ with edge proximity factor $F(d/s)$ for finite wafer dimensions ($< 40 \times s$).
- **Source: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**:
  - Structure layout: Rectangular contact pads with width $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$, spaced at $d = 5\ \mu\text{m}, 10\ \mu\text{m}, 20\ \mu\text{m}, 40\ \mu\text{m}, 80\ \mu\text{m}$.
  - Formulation: $R_T = 2 R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$, with slope $= R_s / W$, Y-intercept $= 2 R_c$, X-intercept $= -2 L_T$, and specific contact resistivity $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.

Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging (Harman, G. - Wire Bonding in Microelectronics: Materials, Processes, Reliability)

**Context & Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > Interconnect Contact Resistance & Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) > Four-Point Probe & Metal-1/Via-1 Kelvin Contact Resistance Characterization > **Four-Point Probe Station Calibration & Collinear Tungsten Carbide Tip Fixture Setup**

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Fixture & Tip Inspection:**
   - Mount the collinear probe head fitted with four equally spaced **tungsten carbide** tips onto the probe station Z-axis micromanipulator.
   - Inspect probe tip radii under an optical inspection microscope to verify tip radius is maintained within **$50\ \mu\text{m}\text{ to }100\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Verify collinearity and equidistant tip-to-tip pitch spacing of **$s = 1.0\ \text{mm}$** across probes 1, 2, 3, and 4.

2. **Substrate Placement & Co-Planarity Alignment:**
   - Load the calibration reference wafer / thin metal film sample onto the vacuum chuck. Ensure that the distance from the probe placement to the wafer edge satisfies geometric boundary criteria (boundary diameter $\ge 40s$; if $< 40s$, edge proximity correction factor $F(d/s)$ must be applied).
   - Verify sample film thickness $t$ meets the thin-film approximation condition ($t \ll s/2$).
   - Level the collinear fixture to ensure simultaneous, non-destructive planar contact of all four tungsten carbide tips upon engagement.

3. **Current Sourcing & Potential Sensing Interconnect:**
   - Connect outer probes (Pin 1 and Pin 4) to the precision DC current source.
   - Connect inner probes (Pin 2 and Pin 3) to the high-impedance digital floating voltmeter.

4. **Measurement & Calibration Routine:**
   - Lower the probe head until uniform mechanical contact is established.
   - Force a constant DC excitation current **$I$ between $1\ \text{mA}\text{ and }10\ \text{mA}$** through outer probes (1 and 4).
   - Measure the resulting floating potential drop **$V$** across inner probes (2 and 3).
   - Calculate sheet resistance:
     $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{V}{I} \approx 4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I}\ [\Omega/\Box]$$

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Blanket Metal-1 Thin Film Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Mapping & Geometric Correction
**Hierarchy / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > Back-End Packaging > Metrology > Four-Point Probe & Metal-1/Via-1 Kelvin Contact Resistance Characterization > Blanket Metal-1 Thin Film Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Mapping & Geometric Correction  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Four-Point Probe Station Metrology)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. Wafer Loading & Stage Vacuum Chucking    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. Collinear 4-Point Probe Head Alignment   │
│     (Tungsten Carbide, s = 1.0 mm)           │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. Constant DC Current Injection (Outer 1-4)│
│     (I = 1.0 mA to 10.0 mA)                  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  4. Floating Potential Sensing (Inner 2-3)   │
│     (Precision Differential Voltmeter)       │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  5. Sheet Resistance & Geometric Correction  │
│     (Rs = 4.5324 * (V/I) * F(d/s))           │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  6. Pass/Fail Decision vs Spec (< 0.08 Ω/sq) │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**:
   - Transfer the post-metallization blanket 180nm DRAM wafer (target film: 350 nm ± 5% Al or Al-0.5% Cu deposited via DC magnetron sputtering) onto the automated four-point probe vacuum stage.
   - Verify sample temperature equilibrium at 20°C–25°C.

2. **Probe Head Inspection & Engagement**:
   - Inspect the four collinear tungsten carbide probe tips (tip radius: $50\text{ }\mu\text{m}\text{ to }100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, fixed collinear tip pitch: $s = 1.0\text{ mm}$).
   - Soft-land probe assembly onto the blanket Metal-1 surface using calibrated contact force to minimize film puncturing.

3. **Current Sourcing & Potential Sensing**:
   - Force a constant DC test current between $I = 1.0\text{ mA}$ and $I = 10.0\text{ mA}$ through the outer probes (pins 1 and 4).
   - Simultaneously measure the resulting floating potential drop $\Delta V_{23}$ across the inner high-impedance sense probes (pins 2 and 3).
   - Reverse DC current polarity ($-I$) and average voltage readings to eliminate thermal electromotive force (EMF) offsets.

4. **Sheet Resistance Calculation & Boundary Correction**:
   - Compute base semi-infinite sheet resistance:
     $$R_{s,\text{raw}} = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{V}{I} \approx 4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I}\text{ }[\Omega/\Box]$$
   - When probing within proximity of the wafer edge where wafer boundary diameter $D < 40s$ or distance to boundary $d < 40s$, multiply $R_{s,\text{raw}}$ by edge proximity geometric correction factor $F(d/s)$.

5. **Multi-Point Automated Mapping & Recipe Check**:
   - Map across the standard multi-site pattern across the wafer diameter.
   - Verify all measured sites meet the post-anneal electrical qualification threshold.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Tip Pitch ($s$)** | $1.0 \pm 0.01$ | $\text{mm}$ | Calibrated collinear probe head micrometer stage |
| **Probe Tip Curvature Radius** | $50\text{ to }100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical comparator / Profilometer inspection |
| **Test Sourcing Current ($I$)** | $1.0\text{ to }10.0$ | $\text{mA}$ | Precision DC Source Measure Unit (SMU) |
| **Metal-1 Thickness Target** | $350 \pm 5\%$ ($332.5\text{ to }367.5$) | $\text{nm}$ | Sputter deposition calibrated rate verification |
| **Post-Anneal Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | $\Omega/\Box$ | Corrected Four-Point Probe ($4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I} \cdot F(d/s)$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited

- **[Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - Probe head configuration: Collinear tungsten carbide tips with radius $50\text{--}100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ and pitch spacing $s = 1.0\text{ mm}$.
  - Current injection operating range: $I = 1\text{ mA}\text{ to }10\text{ mA}$ across outer pins (1 & 4).
  - Floating potential equation: $R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{V}{I} = 4.5324 \cdot \frac{V}{I}\text{ }[\Omega/\Box]$ for thin films ($t \ll s/2$).
  - Edge boundary geometric correction: Proximity factor $F(d/s)$ when distance/diameter is $< 40s$.
- **[Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - Metal-1 film thickness target: $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - Post-metal anneal sheet resistance target: $R_s < 0.08\text{ }\Omega/\Box$ (annealed in 95/5 $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2$ forming gas at 400°C for 30 minutes).
- **[Four Point Probe Method](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - Tungsten carbide tip composition for non-destructive sheet resistance probe mapping.
citations: Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance (ASTM Standard F84 & Semiconductor Material Characterization)
Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects (Vossen & Kern - Thin Film Processes)

**Process Step / Domain:** Interconnect Contact Resistance & Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP)  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Station Configuration & Tool Inspection**
   - Clean the automated wafer chuck and inspect the four-point collinear probe card under an optical alignment microscope.
   - Verify that the four probe tips consist of tungsten carbide, with tip radius verified between $50\ \mu\text{m}$ and $100\ \mu\text{m}$, and standard probe tip pitch spacing $s = 1.0\ \text{mm}$.
2. **Wafer Loading & Fiducial Alignment**
   - Vacuum mount the 180nm processed DRAM wafer onto the thermal probe chuck stabilized at $25^\circ\text{C}$ (or $85^\circ\text{C}$ for high-temperature drift validation).
   - Perform automated pattern recognition (die-to-die optical alignment) targeting the Metal-1/Via-1 Kelvin cross-bridge resistor test structure in the scribe line / test vehicle block.
3. **Probe Touchdown & Contact Engagement**
   - Lower the probe assembly onto the landing pads of the Kelvin cross-bridge test module.
   - Apply a controlled overdrive ($30\text{--}50\ \mu\text{m}$) to displace native surface oxides and ensure ohmic contact without mechanically punching through the Metal-1 landing pad or damaging the underlying W-plug/dielectric stack.
4. **Current Forcing (Outer Probes 1 & 4)**
   - Connect the outer probe terminals (Probe 1 and Probe 4) to a low-noise constant DC source.
   - Force a constant DC bias current programmable between $I = 1\ \text{mA}$ and $10\ \text{mA}$ through the Metal-1 to Via-1 Kelvin path. Allow a 50 ms stabilization dwell time.
5. **Voltage Sensing & Kelvin Extraction (Inner Probes 2 & 3)**
   - Connect the inner probe pair (Probe 2 and Probe 3) to a high-input-impedance digital nanovoltmeter.
   - Measure the floating potential drop ($V$) directly across the isolated Via-1 contact interface, eliminating series parasitic resistance from probe needles, contact leads, and interconnect traces.
   - Calculate specific Kelvin contact resistance:
     $$R_c = \frac{V_{\text{inner}}}{I_{\text{outer}}}$$
   - For adjacent thin-film sheet resistance validation on co-located cross-bridge test structures, evaluate:
     $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right) = 4.5324 \cdot \left(\frac{V}{I}\right)\quad [\Omega/\square]$$
     Apply the edge correction factor $F(d/s)$ if probing near the wafer boundary (wafer diameter $< 40s$).
6. **Data Logging & Probe Retraction**
   - Record $I\text{-}V$ linearity across the $1\text{--}10\ \text{mA}$ sweep to verify true ohmic behavior.
   - Retract probe tips to safety height ($Z \ge 2.0\ \text{mm}$) before indexing the stage to the next site.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Tip Radius** | $50 \text{ to } 100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Tooling Microscope / SEM inspection |
| **Inter-Probe Spacing ($s$)** | $1.0 \pm 0.01$ | $\text{mm}$ | Collinear probe card calibration gauge |
| **DC Forcing Current Range ($I$)** | $1.0 \text{ to } 10.0$ | $\text{mA}$ | Parametric SMU Source Unit (Picoammeter/SMU) |
| **Sheet Resistance Scaling Factor ($R_s / (V/I)$)** | $4.5324$ | Dimensionless ($\Omega/\square$ factor) | Automated EDP Extraction Algorithm |

---

### 3. Literature Context Citations

- **Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**: Cited for probe geometry (tungsten carbide tips with radius $50\text{--}100\ \mu\text{m}$ and spacing $s = 1.0\ \text{mm}$), DC forced current operating range ($I = 1\ \text{mA}\text{ to }10\ \text{mA}$ across outer probes 1 and 4), thin-film sheet resistance formula $R_s = 4.5324 \cdot (V/I)$, and the edge correction requirement $F(d/s)$ when distance to wafer edge is $< 40s$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Cited for the 180nm technological framework including tungsten contact plug (W-plug) integration, interconnect geometry, and temperature reference ($85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Four Point Probe Method**: Cited for baseline probe material verification (tungsten carbide tips).

180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) & Parametric Yield Mapping

**Generation**: Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Segment**: Interconnect Contact Resistance & Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) [Metrology]  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Execution Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Wafer Loading &    │
│   Optical Alignment   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Probe Card Stepping  │
│    to Bonding Pads    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Parametric DC &    │
│   Leakage Screening   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Capacitance-Voltage  │
│     CV Extraction     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Wafer Map Binning &  │
│    Yield Synthesis    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chuck Loading & Coordinate Alignment**:
   - Transfer the fabricated 180nm DRAM wafer onto the automated probe station vacuum chuck.
   - Run optical pattern recognition using fiducial markers to align step-and-repeat coordinate axes ($X, Y, \theta$) to die pitch.
   - Verify probe card contact tips against the on-chip aluminum bonding pads ($100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ square pads). Set overdrive z-travel to ensure low contact resistance without puncturing pad metallization.

2. **System Metrology Baseline & Gauge R&R Verification**:
   - Perform probe system repeatability qualification over a designated 9-point wafer mapping grid.
   - Confirm measurement repeatability achieves a coefficient of variation $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$ across the 9 sampling points prior to production die indexing.

3. **Parametric DC Transistor & Cell Leakage Screening**:
   - Step probe card pins onto unit memory cell test structures ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ access transistors).
   - Apply test bias vectors at nominal temperature and screen at elevated temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Measure combined sub-threshold and reverse-biased junction leakage currents on the stacked capacitor drain contact/W-plug node; verify leakage does not exceed $1\ \text{fA/cell}$.

4. **Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) Parametric Extraction**:
   - Connect LCR meter/capacitance meter channels to the crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) test array.
   - Extract small-signal capacitance across the dielectric layer (ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack with effective $\kappa > 15$).
   - Confirm storage node capacitance meets or exceeds the required storage margin of $28\ \text{fF/cell}$.

5. **Parametric Yield Mapping & Die Binning**:
   - Record pass/fail bin states into the automated wafer map database.
   - Bin dies failing leakage, capacitance, or continuity as reject/inked dies.
   - Forward qualified passing dies meeting electrical criteria to back-end dicing and ultrasonic/thermosonic wire bonding assembly (verifying downstream wire bond pull force $\ge 4.0\ \text{gf}$ for $25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire).

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                       ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
     Min Wire Pull (gf)┤░░░░░░                             │
                       │░░░░░░                             │
 Max Leakage @ 85C (fA)┤▒▒                                 │
                       │▒▒                                 │
   Max Gauge R&R CV (%)┤▓▓                                 │
Capacitance Budget (fF)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                       │███████████████████████████████████│
                       └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                        0        7      14       21      28 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked capacitor (ONO / high-$k$ stack, $\kappa > 15$) |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold & junction leakage measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Metrology Gauge R&R** | $\text{CV} < 1.0$ | $\%$ | Coefficient of variation across 9-point wafer mapping |
| **Downstream Wire Pull Strength** | $\ge 4.0$ | $\text{gf}$ | Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 on $25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire at $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ pads |

---

### 4. Context Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Cell geometry: Channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\ \text{fF/cell}$ storage capacitance with ONO / high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Refresh leakage ceiling: Sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**:
  - Repeatability requirement: Gauge R&R measurement coefficient of variation $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$ across 9-point wafer mapping.
- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**:
  - Bonding pad dimensions: $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum squares.
  - Wire pull strength baseline: $\ge 4.0\ \text{gf}$ (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 for $25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## COTS Multi-Contact Probe Card & Test Fixture Procurement --- ### 1. Purpose & Scope This Standard Operating Procedure defines the engineering procurement, incoming inspection, and electrical acceptance verification for Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) multi-contact probe cards and test fixtures. These fixtures interface automated wafer-level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) stations with the DRAM Foundation VN Gen 2 (180nm open-source DRAM) test structures and die pads. --- ### 2. Workflow Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Pad Layout & Specification Audit
(Pitch, Array Geometry, Signal Mapping)"] --> B["COTS Vendor RfQ & Fixture Selection
(Cantilever / Vertical Probe Array)"] B --> C["Incoming Visual & Mechanical Metrology
(XY Alignment & Planarity Inspection)"] C --> D["Electrical Baseline & Leakage Verification
(Kelvin Contact Res & Isolation Leakage)"] D --> E["Docking & Overdrive Calibration on EDP Chuck
(Sign-Off for Wafer-Level Probing)"] ``` --- ### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure 1. **Test Pad & Pad-Pitch Extraction** - Extract bond-pad and test-pad coordinates from the 180nm DRAM GDSII layout. - Define multi-contact probe layout requirements matching bitline/wordline test pads, sense amplifier power rails ($V_{\text{DD}}$, $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ equalization bias), and periphery I/O pads. 2. **COTS Probe Card Specification & Vendor Sourcing (RfQ)** - Issue procurement specification for standard multi-pin cantilever or vertical probe card arrays compatible with the automated EDP probe station docking ring. - Specify low-leakage coaxial/triaxial cabling and probe card PCB dielectric materials to prevent leakage interference during sub-femtoampere cell retention evaluations. 3. **Incoming Mechanical Metrology & Planarity Verification** - Place probe card on the optical inspection station. - Measure tip positional alignment ($\Delta X, \Delta Y$) against nominal pad coordinates. - Verify needle planarity across all contact pins using laser non-contact displacement profiling. 4. **Electrical Isolation & Path Resistance Acceptance** - Connect the probe card fixture to parametric measurement units (SMU/LCR meter). - Perform two-wire/four-wire Kelvin contact resistance measurements on a gold-plated shorting substrate under standard overdrive ($Z$-travel). - Run open-circuit isolation tests between adjacent probe needles up to rated supply voltage ($V_{\text{DD}}$). 5. **Test Fixture Docking & EDP Chuck Integration** - Mount the probe card into the wafer prober head assembly. - Calibrate theta alignment and chuck touch-down sensor limits to prevent excessive scrub or pad punch-through on 180nm test structures. --- ### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria ```text Probe Card Acceptance Target Bounds ┌──────────────────────────────────┐ │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │ Tip Alignment XY┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │ │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│ Planarity / Coplanar┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│ Probe Leakage┤▓▓ │ │▓▓ │ Contact Res (Rc)┤█████ │ │█████ │ └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘ 0 3 6 9 12 ``` | Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Bounds | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Probe Needle Tip Alignment ($XY$)** | $\le 5.0$ | Max $\pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Automated Optical Coordinate Metrology | | **Needle Tip Coplanarity / Planarity** | $\le 12.0$ | Max $\pm 12.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical/Laser Depth Profiler | | **Path & Contact Resistance ($R_{\text{c}}$)** | $\le 1.5$ | Max $1.5$ | $\Omega$ | 4-Wire Kelvin Probing on Au Substrate | | **Inter-Pin Isolation Leakage Current** | $\le 0.5$ | Max $0.5$ | $\text{pA}$ | Parameter Analyzer @ 1.8 V ($85^\circ\text{C}$) | --- ### 5. Context Citations & Technical Alignment - **Cell Leakage & Noise Budget**: Sub-threshold and junction leakage targets must remain below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required refresh intervals for 180nm stacked capacitors ($C_{\text{s}} = 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$, minimum budget $28\text{ fF}$) (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*). The probe fixture isolation and guarding paths are specified with sub-picoampere leakage to prevent masking ultra-low cell leakage and retention decay. - **Sense Amplifier & Bitline Readout Constraints**: Folded bitline differential signal sensing operates at $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ with bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ and precharge equalization at $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ (*Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*). The contact resistance threshold ($R_{\text{c}} \le 1.5\ \Omega$) minimizes test fixture IR drop and prevents skew during parametric latch-up and sense-amplifier readout characterization.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
