nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-MET-180-042: Parametric Test Recipe & Low-Current Leakage Measurement Routine Setup

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Probe Card Align &  │
│    Thermal Chuck     │
│    Stabilization     │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Triaxial Guard &   │
│  Offset Calibration  │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│      Parametric      │
│   Interconnect Rs    │
│     Measurement      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Sub-fA Cell & Node  │
│       Leakage        │
│   Characterization   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Delta V Readout &   │
│    Signal Margin     │
│     Verification     │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Wafer Load & Thermal Chuck Stabilization**:
   - Transfer the 180nm processed DRAM wafer onto the automated wafer-level electrical die probe (EDP) chuck.
   - Program the thermal chuck controller to the target elevated operating temperature of **85°C** and allow a 15-minute thermal soak to reach thermal equilibrium across all wafer zones.
2. **Probe Alignment & Contact Scrub**:
   - Align the fine-pitch probe card tips to the wafer-level test structure pads (access transistor terminals, bitline contacts, and stacked capacitor test structures).
   - Set the Z-overdrive scrub depth to ensure stable ohmic contact across the Al-0.5% Cu interconnect probe pads without damaging underlying dielectric layers.
3. **Triaxial Guard & Instrument Zero-Calibration**:
   - Engage driven triaxial guarding on the Source Measure Unit (SMU) cables down to the probe tips to bypass parasitic cable capacitances and dielectric absorption.
   - Perform open-circuit probe lifted zero-offset correction to null out residual instrument and fixturing background currents down into the sub-femtoampere noise floor.
4. **Interconnect Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Verification**:
   - Apply a 4-point Kelvin current-force/voltage-measure routine across the Metal-1 (350 nm Al metallization) test van der Pauw / bridge structures.
   - Sweep forced current and record potential drop to compute sheet resistance $R_s$. Reject dies showing high contact resistance or metal thinning.
5. **Sub-Threshold & Junction Leakage Extraction**:
   - Connect the high-resolution SMU to the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) drain node and stacked capacitor bottom-plate node via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Bias bitline/source pads to $V_{DD}/2$ and assert wordline off-state gate bias ($V_{GS} = 0\text{ V}$).
   - Measure steady-state junction and sub-threshold leakage current at **85°C** across an integration period of 10 to 50 power-line cycles (NPLC).
6. **Bitline Capacitance & Readout Signal Margin ($\Delta V$) Routine**:
   - Execute C-V parametric sweeps to extract the cell storage capacitance $C_s$ and parasitic bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$.
   - Apply the folded bitline precharge potential equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Gate the access transistor to evaluate differential signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Validate that the developed differential voltage satisfies sense amplifier latching margins before moving the stage to the next step-and-repeat coordinate.

---

### 3. Key Physical Parameter Thresholds

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░                     │
   Chuck Temp (deg C)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░                     │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
      Readout dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
Bitline Cap C_BL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     Cell Cap Cs (fF)┤█████                            │
                     │█████                            │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    62.5    125.0   187.5 250.0 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Off-State Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SMU low-current integration (10–50 NPLC) at access transistor node |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ (typical nominal $\ge 25.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | High-frequency C-V parametric meter at stacked capacitor test pad |
| **Metal-1 Interconnect Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.08$ | $\Omega/\square$ | 4-point Kelvin probe across post-anneal 350 nm Al metallization test bridge |
| **Readout Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Folded bitline sense amp readout signal development ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) |

---

### 5. Contextual Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ stacked capacitor (with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric).
  - Target leakage budget: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain DRAM refresh retention intervals.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch folded bitline topology with bitline equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Bitline charge sharing formulation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Signal development target: $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
  - Metal-1 interconnect thickness: $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$.
  - Post-anneal (forming gas $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes) sheet resistance requirement: $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\square$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects (Vossen & Kern - Thin Film Processes)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Low-Noise Triaxial Guarding & SMU Measurement Chamber Calibration

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-LNTG-001`  
**Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Interconnect Sputtering & Die Packaging Probe Station > Interconnect Contact Resistance & Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) > Automated Wafer-Level Electrical Die Probing (EDP) & Parametric Yield Mapping > Parametric Test Recipe & Low-Current Leakage Measurement Routine Setup > Low-Noise Triaxial Guarding & SMU Measurement Chamber Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Procedure Sequence

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Chamber Purge & Dark  │
│       Enclosure        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Triaxial Guard     │
│   Potential Matching   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Open-Circuit      │
│   Residual Baseline    │
│         Sweep          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Chamber Calibration   │
│    & Wafer Hand-off    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Calibration Procedure

1. **Environmental Isolation & Thermal Equilibrium:**
   - Seal the probe station Faraday cage dark enclosure; verify interlock seals to suppress ambient photon-induced parasitic currents.
   - Initiate continuous dry Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) purge to achieve relative humidity $\le 10\%$ within the chamber, preventing surface dielectric condensation on probe card ceramic interfaces.
   - Ramp the thermal chuck to the qualification temperature of **85°C** (required for 180nm DRAM cell retention/leakage qualification) and allow 30 minutes for thermal stabilization ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).

2. **Triaxial Cable & Guard Network Verification:**
   - Connect the precision Source Measure Unit (SMU) force, sense, and guard lines via driven triaxial cabling (center conductor = Signal/Force, inner shield = Driven Guard, outer shield = Chassis Ground).
   - Ensure the probe card shielding plates and chuck guard rings are tied directly to the active low-impedance SMU guard buffer amplifier to eliminate potential difference ($\Delta V \approx 0\text{ V}$) between the core conductor and inner shield.

3. **SMU Guard Offset Voltage Verification:**
   - Execute zero-potential calibration on SMU channels: measure differential voltage between the driven guard and force lines under bias sweeps up to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Confirm guard-to-force potential discrepancy is nullified ($\le 0.20\text{ mV}$) across all channels to eliminate cable dielectric leakage currents.

4. **Residual Noise Floor & Zero-Contact Baseline Measurement:**
   - Retract probe tips to open-circuit park position $> 500\,\mu\text{m}$ above the chuck.
   - Execute a 100-point integration current measurement routine using maximum Power Line Cycles ($\text{NPLC} \ge 10$) in high-resolution fA mode.
   - Quantify background baseline noise floor; ensure residual open-circuit background current remains well below the sub-femtoampere limit ($\le 0.15\text{ fA}$) prior to loading production 180nm DRAM test wafers.

5. **Calibration Lock & Recipe Activation:**
   - Store baseline current offsets in the probe station metrology controller as compensation coefficients ($I_{\text{DUT}} = I_{\text{measured}} - I_{\text{cal}}$).
   - Hand off calibrated chamber to the *Parametric Test Recipe & Low-Current Leakage Measurement Routine Setup*.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                          ┌────────────────────────────┐
                          │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Target Leakage Margin (fA)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                          │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
Chuck Temp Accuracy (degC)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
         Guard Offset (mV)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
                          │▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
 Residual Noise Floor (fA)┤█████                       │
                          │█████                       │
                          └┬──────┬──────┬─────┬──────┬┘
                         0.00   0.25   0.50  0.75  1.00 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Calibration Target | Tolerance / Boundary | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Noise Floor Current** | $\le 0.15$ | Max $< 0.20$ | $\text{fA}$ (femtoamperes) |
| **Driven Guard Offset Voltage** | $\le 0.20$ | Max $\pm 0.50$ | $\text{mV}$ (millivolts) |
| **Thermal Chuck Temperature Stability** | $85.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ (Celsius) |
| **Cell Leakage Budget Ceiling Limit** | $< 1.0$ | Upper Limit $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Establishes the stringent leak-current target: *"Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval"*, directly mandating the sub-femtoampere triaxial chamber noise calibration threshold ($\le 0.15\text{ fA}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Dictates thermal stress calibration requirements: cell capacitor storage ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) must sustain retention time criteria at **85°C**, mandating thermal chuck qualification at $85.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - Verifies operating precharge and differential bias levels: baseline equalization centered at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ with differential signal swings ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$), establishing guard offset calibration limits within sub-millivolt accuracy ($\le 0.20\text{ mV}$).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Sub-Femtoamp Access Transistor Subthreshold & Junction Leakage Test Recipe Implementation
**Module**: Parametric Test Recipe & Low-Current Leakage Measurement Routine Setup  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Node)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Setup Low-Noise SMU   │
│  & Triaxial Guarding   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│        Thermal         │
│  Stabilization at 85   │
│      deg C Chuck       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Zero-Check Nulling &  │
│   Integration Offset   │
│       Correction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Subthreshold IV &    │
│    Junction Leakage    │
│         Sweep          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│  Screening: I_off <=   │
│     1 fA per cell      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Station & Shielding Preparation**:
   - Interconnect the wafer-level automated electrical die probe (EDP) station chuck and parametric analyzer using low-noise triaxial cabling and driven guard shields to suppress triboelectric and parasitic cable capacitance.
   - Enclose the probe station in a dark, EMI-shielded enclosure to eliminate ambient photoelectric carrier generation and inductive interference.

2. **Thermal Chuck Conditioning**:
   - Ramp the thermal chuck to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to replicate worst-case thermal leakage and standard retention stress conditions.
   - Allow a 15-minute thermal soak to prevent mechanical probe drift across test pads.

3. **Open-Circuit Calibration & Offset Compensation**:
   - Lift probes to the open position ($100\,\mu\text{m}$ clearance above wafer).
   - Execute automatic zero-check/nulling across the parametric measurement unit (PMU/SMU) to calibrate residual instrumentation leakage to $< 0.1\text{ fA}$.

4. **Die Pad Touchdown & Alignment**:
   - Align tungsten/beryllium-copper probe needles onto the test-element group (TEG) pads for the 180nm access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set contact overdrive to $30\,\mu\text{m}$ to ensure stable scrub on pad metallization.

5. **Subthreshold & Junction Leakage Test Recipe Execution**:
   - **Access Transistor Subthreshold Leakage ($I_{\text{off}}$)**:
     - Apply $V_{\text{DS}} = V_{\text{DD}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ at the bitline/drain terminal, tie substrate/well to $0\text{ V}$, source to $0\text{ V}$.
     - Step gate/wordline voltage $V_{\text{GS}}$ from $-0.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.8\text{ V}$ using a minimum integration time of $\ge 10$ power line cycles (NPLC) and 200 ms settling delay per point.
     - Extract subthreshold off-state leakage at $V_{\text{GS}} = 0\text{ V}$.
   - **Storage Node Drain Junction Leakage ($I_{\text{junc}}$)**:
     - Apply $V_{\text{drain}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ to the storage node node terminal, hold wordline at $0\text{ V}$ (off-state), substrate at $0\text{ V}$.
     - Measure current through the storage plug node.

6. **Screening & Yield Logging**:
   - Correlate recorded leakage values against the cumulative retention budget ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Flag and bin any die exceeding parametric limits on the wafer map.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Engineering Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Combined Leakage ($I_{\text{off}} + I_{\text{junc}}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | Max $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parametric SMU electrometer mode at $V_{\text{GS}} = 0\text{ V}, V_{\text{DS}} = 1.8\text{ V}$ |
| **Test Chuck Temperature** | $85$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Closed-loop RTD sensor on thermal probe chuck |
| **Transistor Geometry Verification ($W/L$)** | $220 / 180$ | $\pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / optical parametric TEG correlation |
| **Retention Interval Equivalent** | $> 64$ | Min $64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Parametric model calculated from $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ and leakage current at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor geometry parameters: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Leakage target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - Standard thermal and retention requirement: Data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ supported by cell capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$.
   - Gate oxide physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
   - Storage cell baseline capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and typical bitline loading $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ establishing charge retention boundary conditions.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.label: Automated Wafer-Level Parametric Leakage Mapping & Retention Yield Correlation
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Wafer-Level Parametric Leakage Mapping & Retention Yield Correlation

**Process Module:** Metrology / Back-End Electrical Die Probing (EDP) & Circuit Verification  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Cell Architecture:** Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB), $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ Folded Bitline Topology ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)  
**Action Type:** Make / Characterization Routine  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Chuck Load &   │
│   Thermal Soak at 85   │
│         deg C          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Automated Needle    │
│  Alignment & Contact   │
│      Verification      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Parametric       │
│  Low-Current Leakage   │
│    Measurement SMU     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Retention Time     │
│       Readout &        │
│  Differential Sensing  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Map Spatial    │
│  Yield Correlation &   │
│        Binning         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Thermal Stabilization & Chuck Environmental Conditioning:**
   - Mount the 180nm processed wafer onto the automated probe station hot chuck.
   - Set thermal chuck temperature to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to replicate standard elevated operating DRAM retention test conditions. Allow a 15-minute thermal stabilization soak.

2. **Probe Card Alignment & Contact Resistance Qualification:**
   - Execute pattern recognition optical alignment for fine-pitch probe needles onto test array pad groups (BL, /BL, WL, and cell node probe points).
   - Touch down probe card with controlled overdrive ($Z$-travel overdrive $\le 35\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Perform contact resistance sanity check across a 9-point baseline across the wafer; ensure Gauge R&R measurement repeatability reaches a coefficient of variation $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$.

3. **Parametric Leakage Current Mapping Routine:**
   - Connect Source Measure Units (SMUs) with triaxial low-noise fixturing to access transistor bitline and capacitor storage nodes.
   - Apply nominal precharge baseline ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$) to bitlines while holding wordlines in deactivated state ($V_{\text{WL}} \le 0\text{ V}$).
   - Sweep and measure storage node sub-threshold and junction leakage current at $85^\circ\text{C}$; enforce maximum per-cell threshold limit of $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$.

4. **Cell Charge Storage & Retention Time Testing:**
   - Write logic state `'1'` ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$) to unit cell stacked capacitor nodes ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$).
   - De-assert wordlines and apply variable pause delay intervals ($t_{\text{pause}}$) to evaluate retention degradation.
   - Equalize bitlines to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ via the equalization transistor network prior to readout assertion.

5. **Differential Signal Readout & Sense Amplifier Latching:**
   - Assert wordline to release cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ onto bitline capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Verify that signal development establishes differential bitline split $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$ within the valid sensing window ($100\text{ mV} \le \Delta V \le 150\text{ mV}$).
   - Strobe sense amplifier latch signals (SAN/SAP) to verify successful latching without read disturbances.

6. **Wafer-Level Spatial Correlation & Binning:**
   - Step probe chuck across entire wafer map (die-by-die / test macro sites).
   - Generate wafer heatmaps correlating physical cell leakage currents ($I_{\text{leak}}$) against bit retention fail counts ($t_{\text{ret}}$).
   - Flag and bin dice exhibiting excessive leakage tails (> 1 fA/cell) or collapsed sense margins ($\Delta V < 100\text{ mV}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Parametric SMU low-current integration routine |
| **Stacked Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Small-signal high-frequency $C$-$V$ meter |
| **Sense Readout Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Oscilloscope / high-speed digitizer differential probing across BL and /BL |
| **Measurement Repeatability (Gauge R&R)** | $< 1.0$ | $\%$ ($\text{CV}$) | 9-point wafer mapping standard deviation / mean |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**  
  *Direct Citation & Physical Parameters:* Cell access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$); sub-threshold and junction leakage target of $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**  
  *Direct Citation & Physical Parameters:* Metrology repeatability requirement stipulating Gauge R&R coefficient of variation $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$ across 9-point wafer mapping.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**  
  *Direct Citation & Physical Parameters:* Folded bitline precharge to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$; charge dumping relation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$; signal development $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; differential sensing margin of $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ based on nominal $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance (ASTM Standard F84 & Semiconductor Material Characterization)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

nodes.label: 9-Point Wafer-Level Gauge R&R Verification & Parametric Yield Mapping
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 9-Point Wafer-Level Gauge R&R Verification & Parametric Yield Mapping

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     9-Point Wafer      │
│  Alignment & Pre-Test  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Gauge R&R        │
│   Repeatability Loop   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Parametric       │
│     Electrical Die     │
│        Probing         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Yield Contour      │
│   Mapping & Binning    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Chuck Alignment & Thermal Equilibrium**:
   - Mount the processed 180nm DRAM wafer onto the automated wafer-level electrical die probe (EDP) chuck.
   - Set the chuck temperature to **85°C** and wait for thermal stabilization across the wafer substrate prior to probe landing.
2. **Coordinate Setup for 9-Point Metrology Mapping**:
   - Initialize the probe station coordinate system using wafer notch alignment.
   - Program the automated stepped routine across a standardized **9-point wafer mapping layout** (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right, and 4 quadrants at normalized radial distances).
3. **Gauge Repeatability & Reproducibility (R&R) Verification**:
   - Perform automated 10-cycle touchdown and lift sequences across all 9 designated sites using the collinear probe card setup.
   - Collect raw contact and sheet resistance data; verify that measurement dispersion conforms strictly to coefficient of variation tolerances ($CV < 1.0\%$) before proceeding to parametric die screening.
4. **180nm Stacked Capacitor & Access Transistor DC Parametric Testing**:
   - Probe the unit cell access transistor structures ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) to verify gate control and threshold characteristics.
   - Measure cell leakage across wordline-off states at **85°C** to ensure sub-threshold and junction leakages meet refresh preservation targets.
5. **Capacitance & Readout Signal Margin Probing**:
   - Measure stacked capacitor storage node capacitance ($C_s$) and bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$).
   - Evaluate signal margin development by verifying differential readout voltage ($\Delta V$) under $V_{DD}/2$ bitline precharge conditions.
6. **Wafer Yield Contour Mapping & Binning**:
   - Execute full-wafer die stepped probing based on the calibrated 9-point baseline.
   - Generate parametric wafer maps displaying $C_s$, leakage currents, and bitline signal differential bins for yield disposition.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Inspection Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gauge R&R Measurement Dispersion** | $CV < 1.0\%$ | $\%$ (Coefficient of Variation) | Automated 9-point collinear probe sequence |
| **Stacked Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated $C\text{--}V$ LCR meter at probe station |
| **Cell Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$) | High-precision parametric electrometer / SMU |
| **Readout Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Automated sense amplifier readout probing ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$) |

---

### 3. Context Citations

* **Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**:
  * *Repeatability Requirement*: Gauge R&R measurement coefficient of variation $CV < 1.0\%$ across 9-point wafer mapping.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  * *Unit Cell Geometry*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * *Capacitance Budget*: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance budget ensuring noise immunity against soft errors and bitline coupling.
  * *Leakage Current Target*: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh interval.
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  * *Precharge & Readout Differential*: Differential voltage $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \times (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$, developing an operating signal $\Delta V$ of approximately $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
citations: Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance (ASTM Standard F84 & Semiconductor Material Characterization)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
